Headline: Three Firearms and Ammunition Seized During New Year’s Eve Raid in Cashew Gardens
Summary: Police seized a Browning Short 9mm pistol and a Smith & Wesson 9mm pistol during a residential search in Cashew Gardens. The operation, conducted by officers of the Longdenville Police Post, also resulted in the recovery of several rounds of 9mm ammunition.

Headline: Man Shot in Head at Sangre Grande Home Near Local Church on Old Year’s Night
Location: HVHG+XC2 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man was shot in the head at his residence on Adolphus Cox Road while a nearby church prepared for New Year's Eve services. The victim was transported to the hospital and remains in stable condition following the targeted attack.

Headline: Dexter Griffith Gunned Down on Charles Street; Marabella Records Fourth Murder in Two Weeks
Summary: A man identified as Dexter “Bamboo” Griffith was fatally shot on Charles Street, Marabella, on Wednesday night. Griffith was found dead at the scene following a barrage of gunfire, marking a violent end to the year for the community, which has seen four homicides in a 14-day span.

Headline: Man Shot by Masked Gunman on Second Caledonia Road in Morvant Drive-By Attack
Location: MG4H+2MR San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man was walking along Second Caledonia Road in Morvant when a black vehicle pulled alongside him and an occupant opened fire. The victim sustained gunshot wounds to his arm and hip and was transported to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex by a relative.

Headline: Elderly Penal Laborer Found Dead With Head Wounds Near Heritage Pump Station
Summary: The decomposing body of 63-year-old Alan Singh was discovered by relatives in a bushy area near his home on Coqueran Drive. Police are treating the discovery as a homicide after the victim was found partially hidden under coconut branches with visible head wounds.

Headline: Homicide Investigation Launched After Nude Body of Ronald Richards Found in Morvant Junction River
Street Address: Morvant Junction near the T&TEC substation
Location: JGXH+4P7 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Authorities are investigating a suspected homicide after the body of Ronald Richards was discovered in a river near the Morvant T&TEC substation. Evidence of blood trails at the scene suggests a violent altercation occurred prior to the victim being found.

Headline: Gold Nissan Almera Stolen by Three Men in Chaguanas Wednesday Morning Vehicle Theft
Summary: Three men of Hispanic descent reportedly stole a Nissan Almera in the Chaguanas area during the early morning hours. The stolen vehicle carries the registration number PBZ 6348 and was taken on the final day of the year.

Headline: 76-Year-Old Stroke Survivor and Pholourie Vendor Executed by Bicycle-Riding Gunman in El Socorro
Location: JGQX+M25 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Gobin Deonarine, an elderly vendor from Diego Martin, was fatally shot while socialising at Persad Lane early Wednesday morning. Despite his son's previous warnings about "liming" with a younger crowd, Deonarine was targeted by a lone gunman on a bicycle who opened fire on the group, repeatedly shooting the pensioner after he fell to the ground.

Headline: Man Hospitalized Following Late Night Shooting on Benny Road in Valencia
Summary: Police responded to reports of a loud explosion on Benny Road where they discovered a man suffering from a gunshot wound to the face. The victim was stabilized by officers before being transported via ambulance to the Arima Hospital for emergency medical treatment.

Headline: Silver Nissan Wingroad Wagon Stolen in Tunapuna Morning Vehicle Theft Investigation
Summary: A silver Nissan Wingroad wagon was reported stolen from the Tunapuna area during the morning hours of New Year's Eve. The stolen vehicle is identified by the registration plate PCW 4326.

Headline: THA Sanitation Worker Jerome Woods Found Murdered in Delaford Tobago Community Search
Summary: The body of Jerome Woods, a dedicated sanitation worker for the Tobago House of Assembly, was discovered in the Delaford area. Authorities have identified the victim as a resident of King Street and are investigating the circumstances surrounding his death.

Headline: Goods Truck Operator Robbed at Gunpoint for $40,000 Cash and Jewelry at Macoya Market
Summary: A 52-year-old man was targeted by armed assailants while loading his vehicle at the Macoya Market during morning hours. The suspects escaped with a significant sum of cash, a high-value gold chain, and personal electronics in a getaway vehicle.

Headline: Man Found Murdered in Garden at Danpath Trace off Piarco Old Road in Redhill D'Abadie (Pooran Danpat aka Purkee, 53)
Street Address: Danpath Trace, Piarco Old Road, Redhill
Summary: Local authorities discovered the body of a man who had been murdered inside a garden area on Tuesday. The victim was located at Danpath Trace, situated off the Piarco Old Road in the Redhill district of D'Abadie.

Headline: Body of Missing Fireman Bruce Lezama Discovered Murdered Near Blanchisseuse Road in Arima
Summary: The search for missing fireman Bruce Lezama ended in tragedy on Tuesday when his body was found off the Blanchisseuse Road, just miles from his home. Police and forensic investigators are currently processing the scene to determine the circumstances surrounding his death.

Headline: Police Officer’s Silver Nissan Tiida and Bulletproof Vest Stolen in Retrench Village Theft
Summary: A silver Nissan Tiida, registration PDK 1992, was stolen from a residence in Retrench Village during the early hours of Tuesday morning. The vehicle, owned by a police officer, contained sensitive official documents and a bulletproof vest at the time of the theft.

Headline: Shawn McLean Shot and Killed Inside Vehicle on Wharton Street in Laventille Tuesday
Location: MG26+8V9 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 47-year-old man was fatally wounded while sitting in his black Kia Rio after being approached and fired upon by several men. The victim, identified as Shawn McLean, had reportedly gone to the area to visit his girlfriend when the deadly attack occurred on Wharton Street.

Headline: Elderly Man Hospitalized After Fall Targeted in Santa Flora Home Burglary and Vehicle Theft
Summary: Intruders broke into a Santa Flora residence by removing window panes while the elderly homeowner was receiving medical treatment at a hospital. The suspects stole a 42-inch television and a quantity of alcohol before fleeing the scene in the victim's white Nissan B12 Sentra.

Headline: Fatal Drive-By Shooting Claims Life of Laborer Gary Griffith on Derek Murray Drive in Tarouba
Summary: A 40-year-old man was shot and killed by unidentified assailants in a white Nissan Tiida just steps away from his Tarouba residence. Police discovered the victim, Gary Griffith, on the roadway with multiple gunshot wounds following the late-night attack.

Headline: Serving Fire Officer Bruce Lezama Abducted From Arima Home Prompting Urgent Public Appeal
Summary: Fire Officer #4107 Bruce Lezama, attached to the Ambulance Section North, was reported missing following an apparent abduction from his residence on Monday. The Fire Service Association Second Division described the incident as deeply troubling and issued an urgent call for information regarding his whereabouts.

Headline: Silver Honda CR-V Stolen from Arouca Area; Police Seek Information on Vehicle PCB 3618
Summary: A silver Honda CR-V with registration plate PCB 3618 was reported stolen from the Arouca district on Tuesday. Authorities have issued an alert for the vehicle as investigations into the theft continue.

Headline: Blue Honda Vezel Stolen During Early Morning Theft in Manuel Congo Arima District
Summary: A blue Honda Vezel was reported stolen from the Manuel Congo area in Arima during the early hours of Monday morning. The theft occurred at approximately 3:16 a.m., and authorities are seeking information to assist in the recovery of the vehicle.

Headline: Diamond Vale Pensioner Attacked and Robbed by Knife-Wielding Intruder Inside Home
Location: PCCQ+V8W Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 67-year-old retiree was forced to physically battle a six-foot-tall intruder who broke into his Diamond Vale residence on Monday morning. The suspect, armed with a knife, engaged in a struggle with the victim before stealing a gold chain, $3,300 in cash, and several personal identification documents.

Headline: Ride-Share Driver Brutally Attacked with Concrete Block During Robbery in Tunapuna
Summary: A 33-year-old driver from Chase Village survived a violent assault by three passengers near Dookie Lane on Monday night. After being choked and threatened, the victim was beaten and struck in the head with a red concrete block, which was also used to smash his windscreen. The driver managed to escape the attackers by sounding his horn and driving directly to the Tunapuna Police Station.

Headline: Pensioner Hospitalized After Sustaining Multiple Gunshot Wounds on Tecoma Boulevard La Horquetta
Summary: A 64-year-old man is recovering from injuries after being shot in the chest, arm, and leg near the Tecoma Boulevard playing field. Witnesses reported seeing a suspect dressed in black fleeing into nearby bushes immediately after the loud explosions were heard.

Headline: Electronics and Jewelry Worth $11,500 Stolen in Philippine Home Invasion Sunday Evening
Summary: Two armed men entered a home on Sunkist Drive through an open door and robbed a 43-year-old woman at gunpoint. The suspects, one wearing an orange coverall and the other dressed in black, made off with a PlayStation 5, a Samsung cellphone, and several pieces of jewelry.

Headline: Masked Trio Robs Couple and Locks Them in Room During Freeport Residence Raid
Summary: Three masked men, at least one of whom was armed, stormed a home in Chickland Village on Sunday afternoon. The suspects stole a quantity of local and Canadian currency, jewelry, and bank cards before confining the victims to a room and fleeing the scene.

Headline: Arima Man in Critical Condition After Being Shot Multiple Times at Demerara Road Residence
Summary: A 21-year-old man is fighting for his life after being shot at his home in Farm 5, Demerara Road, on Sunday night. The victim was found by a relative on the kitchen floor with multiple gunshot wounds to his back and was rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery.

Headline: Andrew Holder Hospitalized Following Violent Gunshot and Chop Attack Near George Street Health Centre
Street Address: George Street Health Centre and Chafford Court
Location: MF3V+Q34 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 52-year-old Laventille man was found with severe chop and gunshot wounds on the pavement outside the IATF Chafford Court Base on Sunday evening. The victim reported being attacked earlier that day near the George Street Health Centre before being transported to the Port of Spain General Hospital.

Headline: Woman Injured Attempting to Overpower Armed Robbers at Retro Palace Bar on Milford Road
Street Address: Retro Palace Bar, Milford Road, Canaan
Summary: A 58-year-old woman was struck on the head with a firearm while trying to defend her daughter's workplace during a late-night robbery in Canaan. Two masked suspects dressed in black entered the establishment and escaped with approximately $300 after a struggle with the victim.

Headline: Carenage Man Hospitalized After Being Stabbed With Scissors Following Domestic Dispute
Summary: A 36-year-old man was stabbed in the chest by his girlfriend during an argument at his Upper Abbe Poujade Street home early Sunday morning. The confrontation, which reportedly stemmed from a jealousy dispute at a party, resulted in the victim being transferred to the Port of Spain General Hospital for emergency care.

Headline: White Toyota Axio PCW 6056 Stolen From Shakir Trace Along Don Miguel Road in Barataria
Street Address: Shakir Trace, Don Miguel Road, Barataria
Location: JGVW+J6M San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white Toyota Axio with registration plate PCW 6056 was reported stolen from Shakir Trace on Sunday. The vehicle was taken from the Don Miguel Road area in Barataria, and police are currently investigating the theft.

Headline: Two Bystanders Injure, Tekay "TK" Hoyce Fatally Shot on Charlotte Street
Location: MF2R+8Q9 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Tekay Hoyce, also known as "TK" of Laventille and Morvant, was gunned down along Charlotte Street in Port of Spain on Saturday afternoon. The brazen shooting occurred in full view of the public, causing vendors and pedestrians to flee the area for safety. Hoyce sustained multiple gunshot wounds and died at the scene of the incident. Two other unidentified individuals were also injured during the gunfire and required medical attention.

Headline: Man Alias Poogie Hospitalized Following Shooting Attack on Pemberton Street in La Romaine
Summary: A 27-year-old man was shot while socialising with friends at a residence in La Romaine on Saturday evening. An armed suspect approached the group and opened fire, striking the victim in the hip and palm as he attempted to flee the scene.

Headline: Man Shot Dead in Marabella Intersection (Kijana Matthew Codrington, 35)
Street Address: Corner of Granada Terrace and Honda Drive, Harmony Hall, Marabella
Summary: A male victim was fatally shot at the corner of Granada Terrace and Honda Avenue in Harmony Hall, Marabella. The incident occurred on Saturday, December 27th, 2025, resulting in the man’s death at the scene. Emergency services responded to the street-level shooting in the residential area, which remains a developing story as investigators process the scene for evidence. No further details regarding the victim’s identity or the suspects have been released at this time.

Headline: Plum Mitan Man Charged After $40,000 Theft from Biche Home Office
Summary: A 33-year-old man was apprehended by Mayaro CID after stealing $40,000 and personal documents from a home in Newlands Village. Police recovered over $27,000 in cash and the victim's driver's permit from the suspect, who subsequently confessed to the crime.

Headline: Siparia Man Hospitalized With Collapsed Lung After Bar Fight Stabbing on Coora Road
Summary: A 41-year-old man from Queen Street is in critical condition after being stabbed multiple times during an altercation at a bar. The victim, who suffered wounds to his head, back, arms, and chest, returned home with the injuries early Saturday morning but was only taken for medical attention fourteen hours later when his condition worsened.

Headline: Maraval Man Shot by Gunmen Near South East Port-of-Spain Secondary School on Nelson Street
Street Address: Nelson Street near South East Port-of-Spain Secondary School
Location: MF3V+2C8 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 41-year-old motorist was shot in the hand and leg after stopping his vehicle to answer a phone call on Nelson Street. Two armed men approached the car and opened fire as the victim attempted to drive away, forcing him to seek medical treatment at the hospital.

Headline: Woman Carjacked at Gunpoint in Laventille Garage; Vehicle Recovered via Kill Switch on Pashley Street
Street Address: Stannis Clause Street and Pashley Street, Laventille
Location: MG39+5CM Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A woman was robbed of her Nissan AD Wagon by two armed men as she entered her garage on Stannis Clause Street Saturday night. While the victim and her son successfully tracked and recovered the vehicle on Pashley Street using a kill switch, the suspects escaped with her purse, identification, and electronics.

Headline: Teenager Hospitalized With Severe Head Wound After Attempting to Mediate Barrackpore Family Dispute
Summary: An 18-year-old man was struck with a cutlass while attempting to break up a physical confrontation between relatives at his Barrackpore home. The violent dispute, which reportedly stemmed from an argument over an alleged affair, resulted in the victim being transported to the hospital for a serious chop wound to his head.

Headline: Maloney Gardens Resident Survives Targeted Attack by Three Masked Gunmen Near Abandoned Building
Summary: A 23-year-old man was shot multiple times by three masked attackers while walking through the yard of an abandoned building near Building 20. The victim managed to escape by jumping a wall to reach his apartment and is currently in stable condition at the Arima Health Facility.

Headline: Massy Stores St Augustine Targeted by Thief Who Cut Glass Panel to Steal Alcohol
Location: JHXW+F24 St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Surveillance footage captured a suspect cutting a hole in the front glass panel of Massy Stores in St Augustine during the early hours of Friday morning. Employees later discovered that two cases of alcoholic beverages valued at $500 were missing from the establishment.

Headline: Bandits invade Valencia home, rob and beat occupants (51F, 32M)
Summary: A Valencia family suffered a violent home invasion shortly after midnight on Christmas night when two men, one armed with a cutlass, forced entry into the residence. The assailants stole cellphones from the 51-year-old woman and severely beat the 32-year-old male occupant, dragging him outside where he was struck by two additional men before the group escaped.

Headline: Couva man arrested after assaulting, threatening to kill officers (Police Officer)
Summary: A 25-year-old Balmain man was arrested early Boxing Day after he became aggressive towards police officers responding to a wounding report. The suspect hurled obscenities and threats before pushing one officer, causing him to stumble backwards. The assaulted officer later sought medical assistance.

Headline: Dijon Cottoy (23) killed in Christmas morning home invasion
Street Address: Wall Street, Sesame Street, Pinto Road, Arima
Location: JPJM+2M7 Santa Rosa Heights, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 5:00 a.m. on Christmas Day, armed assailants forced their way into a family residence along Wall Street, Sesame Street, Pinto Road in Arima. The gunmen opened fire on the occupants while they were inside the home, fatally wounding 23-year-old Dijon Cottoy. A 14-year-old boy was also killed in the attack, and an 8-year-old child was transported to the hospital with a gunshot wound to the shoulder. Senior police officers visited the scene and are currently investigating the motive behind the deadly assault.

Headline: Police seize illegal gaming machines in Sangre Grande
Location: HVP9+497 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: The Trinidad and Tobago Police Service’s Investigations and Operations Unit recently conducted an operation in Sangre Grande targeting illegal gambling establishments. Officers successfully seized gaming machines from several locations and forced the closure of multiple illegal operations. This action is part of a wider crackdown aimed at disrupting illegal gambling, which is linked to tax evasion and the financing of criminal gangs.

Headline: Four men arrested during ODPM facility break-in (Mausica)
Summary: Four men were arrested during the early hours of Christmas morning after police intercepted a break-in at the Office of Disaster Preparedness and Management (ODPM) facility along Pineapple Drive, Mausica. Officers recovered several stolen items, including mattresses and white plastic tables, which were found hidden in a Nissan Wingroad and nearby bushes. This incident was the third reported break-in at the critical national infrastructure facility within the past week.

Headline: Boy (8) injured after gunmen storm Arima home
Location: JPJM+2M7 Santa Rosa Heights, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: During a violent home invasion on Pinto Road, Arima, an 8-year-old boy was shot by gunmen who killed his older brother and a family friend. The boy was taken to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex (EWMSC) in Mount Hope and remained in stable condition following the traumatic attack.

Headline: $50,000 cash stolen out of car on Christmas night
Summary: Police are investigating a larceny in Curepe after a thief broke the window of a parked Honda CRV on Christmas night. The suspect stole two black bags containing $50,000 cash, along with a brown box holding a carbon tank valued at $5,000. The incident occurred around 10:20 p.m. in the parking lot on the western side of Persad’s.

Headline: PH Taxi Driver (40) robbed of Nissan Tiida at gunpoint in Diego Martin
Location: PCGP+255 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Between 1:00 p.m. and 2:00 p.m. on Christmas Eve, a 40-year-old PH taxi driver was hijacked by a group of men in Diego Martin. The driver had picked up a male passenger near West Bees Supermarket who requested to be dropped off at Roxborough Street. Upon arrival at Upper Roxborough Street, the passenger exited while three other men emerged from a nearby track and held the driver at gunpoint. The assailants then fled the scene with the victim's Nissan Tiida, registration number PDA 9096.

Headline: Nissan Tiida (PDD 504) stolen in Aranguez
Location: JGRX+RX2 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A Nissan Tiida, registration number PDD 504, was reported stolen from the Aranguez area during the early morning hours of Christmas Eve. The vehicle was removed from a property or street location between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. while the owner was presumably away or asleep. No suspects were seen at the time of the incident. Local authorities have been notified of the theft, and the owner is seeking the public's assistance in locating the vehicle.

Headline: Christmas Eve murder rocks Valsayn (Shaffina Hosein Madoo, 68)
Location: JHGC+Q4R San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Shaffina Hosein Madoo, 68, was allegedly beaten to death with a rolling pin by her 60-year-old common-law partner at her home on Nanan Street, Bamboo No 1, Valsayn. The suspect confessed the crime to the victim's daughter around 12:49 am, claiming infidelity was the motive. The suspect later ingested poison and was hospitalized under police guard.

Headline: Victim robbed of $12,000 in jewelry during Facebook Marketplace meet-up at Chaguanas Police Station
Summary: A planned transaction for gold jewelry valued at $12,000 turned into a brazen robbery on the compound of the Chaguanas Police Station. The victim had arranged to meet the suspect at the station for safety, but the individual snatched the jewelry and fled the premises on foot. The victim reported that an officer on-site instructed them to chase the fleeing suspect rather than providing immediate tactical intervention. The incident was highlighted on the Crime Watch program with Ian Alleyne, where the victim expressed shock at being targeted within a police facility.

Headline: Sunshine Snacks salesman (22) beaten and robbed in Valencia trap
Summary: A 22-year-old Sunshine Snacks salesman was lured to Gocool Lands, Valencia Old Road, by a fake customer posing on the phone around 1:40 p.m. Upon arrival, four masked men confronted him, striking him several times about the head. The assailants stole $600 cash and an iPhone 13 from the salesman, and then used a bolt cutter to steal approximately $12,000 in sales cash from the company truck's vault box.

Headline: Driver kidnapped at knifepoint during vehicle viewing (45)
Street Address: Sixth Avenue and Sparrow Avenue, near the Community Centre, Barataria
Location: JGVP+5VX San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 45-year-old driver was kidnapped and robbed at knifepoint after being lured to Barataria under the guise of a vehicle viewing for a Nissan NP300 van advertised on Marketplace. The victim was initially directed to Sixth Avenue near the Community Centre before being rerouted to Sparrow Avenue where the attack occurred.

Headline: Elderly mosque worshipper shot (66) during attempted carjacking
Street Address: La Solita Road Mosque, Islamic Missionary Guild, Caroni
Location: HJVP+V8P Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 66-year-old man was shot in the right foot during an attempted carjacking outside the La Solita Road Mosque in Kelly Village around 5 a.m. on Tuesday. Two masked, armed suspects demanded the keys to his Nissan Tiida, but after the victim struggled, one assailant fired a shot before both suspects fled the scene. The victim was subsequently taken to the St. Helena Health Facility for treatment.

Headline: Scrap dealer (53) chopped in Tobago home invasion
Summary: A 53-year-old scrap dealer in Mason Hall, Tobago, was severely chopped about the body after two neighbours stormed his home following an argument on December 23. The assailants robbed the victim of $1,200 in cash and $2,000 worth of jewellery before fleeing the scene. The victim was treated at the Scarborough General Hospital and later discharged.

Headline: Warehouse burglary at Taran Industrial Estate; Israel Picou confirmed as suspect
Summary: A warehouse at Taran Industrial Estate was broken into between the evening of December 23 and the morning of December 24, 2025. Tools and equipment valued at over $200,000 were stolen, and several vehicles on the compound were ransacked.||Israel Picou of Potato Street has been confirmed as the bandit responsible for the break-in.

Headline: Shop owner escapes gunfire during attempted robbery at Orchid Garden minimart
Summary: A 50-year-old shop owner narrowly avoided injury after being fired upon during an attempted armed robbery at his business on Aerides Drive, Orchid Garden. Around 10:30 a.m., two armed men entered the minimart while the owner was attending to customers. One suspect pointed a firearm at him and discharged two rounds, prompting the victim to flee to the back of the premises to seek cover. Realizing the victim had escaped, the suspects jumped over the front gate and fled the scene on foot. No items were reported stolen during the incident.

Headline: Tragic End to Search: Missing Laventille Man Jamaal Jessop, 28, Found Shot in Beetham Swamp
Location: JGR5+Q59 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A coordinated search operation on Monday, December 22, 2025, led to the discovery of the body of 28-year-old Jamaal Jessop in a swampy area near the WASA compound at Beetham Gardens. Jessop, who was from Eastern Quarry, Laventille, and suffered from mental challenges, had been reported missing by his mother following reports that he had been shot and his body dumped. Officers from the TTPS and the Hunters Search and Rescue Team located the body, which bore multiple gunshot wounds. The scene was processed by homicide investigators.

Headline: Media manager kidnapped and assaulted in case of mistaken identity on Beetham Highway
Street Address: Beetham Highway, Sea Lots and La Pena Drive, Laventille
Location: JGV5+RPP Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An ieTV station manager was kidnapped during rush hour traffic while driving his white Honda Vezel (PEK 9654) near the Sea Lots walkover. A gunman entered the vehicle and forced the victim to drive to Laventille, where he was led into a track and physically assaulted by a group of five men. The attackers reportedly intended to execute the victim for a TT$250,000 debt before realizing he was not their intended target. The suspects eventually fled with the victim's vehicle, which contained a Lenovo laptop and personal bank cards that were later used to withdraw cash.

Headline: Armed suspects rob Hi-way Heaven Restaurant and Bar in Freeport
Street Address: Hi-way Heaven Restaurant and Bar, Arena Road
Summary: Two men targeted the Hi-way Heaven Restaurant and Bar located on Arena Road, Freeport, during a daring night-time robbery around 9:00 p.m. One of the suspects, armed with a firearm, announced a hold-up while a staff member was conducting sales. The victim, fearing for his life, surrendered TT$900 in cash along with a quantity of alcohol and cigarettes. The assailants escaped the scene in a silver Mitsubishi wagon equipped with false registration plates, and their current whereabouts remain unknown to authorities.

Headline: Sales clerk robbed of $380,000 in cash moments after Siparia bank withdrawal
Summary: A 31-year-old sales clerk was the victim of a coordinated robbery with aggravation on Mary Street, Siparia, shortly after withdrawing $380,000 from a bank on High Street. The victim was a passenger in a white Honda Vezel when a silver Nissan Tiida intercepted and blocked the vehicle. Three suspects, wearing green coveralls and ski masks, emerged armed with a firearm and a hammer. They demanded a black backpack containing the cash before fleeing the scene in the Tiida. The funds were reportedly intended for the victim's workplace and a MoneyGram outlet located on Daisy Voisin Street.

Headline: 38-year-old man hospitalized after being stabbed by sister in Boston Street
Summary: A family dispute at a residence on Boston Street escalated into violence, leaving a 38-year-old man with serious internal injuries. Around 2:05 p.m., the victim was involved in a verbal altercation with his twin sister when she allegedly armed herself with a knife and stabbed him once in the lower right abdomen. The victim was rushed to the Roxborough General Hospital and subsequently transferred to the Scarborough General Hospital, where he underwent emergency surgery. Police are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the domestic incident.

Headline: Cashier robbed at gunpoint at Yufe's Limited in Arima
Summary: A cashier at Yufe's Limited was targeted in a bold daylight robbery around 11:00 a.m. while tallying bills behind the counter. Two men entered the store, with one suspect described as slim, of African descent, wearing a red jersey and dark grey jeans with distinct facial markings (tinea versicolor) on his nose and cheek. While the first suspect announced the robbery, the second suspect brandished a black handgun and demanded cash. Fearing for her life, the victim handed over an undisclosed sum of money in a white plastic bag before the pair fled the premises in an unknown direction.

Headline: Gasparillo man killed in Marabella drive-by shooting (Kreston Phillips, 33)
Summary: A 33-year-old Gasparillo resident, Kreston Phillips, was fatally shot in a drive-by attack on Manohar Street, Marabella, around 8 a.m. on Monday morning. Phillips was found bleeding from multiple gunshot wounds and was rushed to the San Fernando General Hospital, where he died while receiving treatment. Detectives from the Homicide Bureau are investigating the motive for the killing, and no arrests have been made.

Headline: Elderly American Retiree Robbed and Injured (80)
Street Address: Vulcan Mufflers car park, O’Meara Industrial Estate
Summary: An 80-year-old American retiree was injured after two men approached her vehicle at the Vulcan Mufflers car park, announced a robbery, and grabbed her handbag. During the struggle, the victim’s finger was cut when the bag strap broke, and the suspects fled with $9,000 cash and personal documents.

Headline: Veteran Beaten and Robbed in Port of Spain (70)
Location: MF2V+R8X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 70-year-old veteran of Belmont was beaten and robbed by four men, two armed with knives, while entering his Mazda 323 on Cockerton Street. The attackers pulled the senior citizen from his car, assaulted him, and stole $4,600 in cash, a cellphone, and his Defence Force ID.

Headline: Valsayn Man Robbed by Fake Police Officers (39)
Summary: A 39-year-old Valsayn man was the victim of a violent home invasion when four men, two armed with guns and wearing police camouflage, kicked in his door after posing as police officers. The intruders ransacked the apartment and fled the scene with $2,000 in cash.

Headline: Shipping Container Stolen from Job Site in Manuel Congo
Street Address: Job site, San Carlos Road, Manuel Congo
Summary: An 18-foot shipping container disappeared from a job site located at St Carlos Road, Manuel Congo. An employee discovered the container missing on December 22, having last seen it two days prior.

Headline: Burglars Cut Through Roof to Break Into Darryl’s Famous Food in Sangre Grande
Street Address: Darryl’s Famous Food, Foster Road and Brierley Street, Sangre Grande
Location: HVPC+JWR Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Burglars broke into Darryl’s Famous Food in Sangre Grande by cutting through the galvanised roof, a break-in discovered on the morning of December 22. Although the thieves damaged the establishment's $8,000 safe, they only managed to steal a BLU cellphone.

Headline: Toys stolen from home on eve of Christmas (7-year-old boy)
Street Address: Second Hamlet Trace, St Barbs, Laventille
Location: MG75+456 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Bandits pried open the front door of a home located at Second Hamlet Trace, St Barbs, Laventille, sometime on Sunday night. The thieves stole Hot Wheels toy cars valued at $300 and a train set valued at $400, which were intended as Christmas gifts for the homeowner's seven-year-old son. The criminals also caused damage to the windows before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Taxi driver (57) robbed and carjacked in Couva
Summary: A 57-year-old private hire taxi driver was attacked and robbed late on December 22 after picking up three male passengers in Chaguanas. Upon reaching Calcutta, one suspect, armed with an object resembling a firearm, struck the driver on the head and demanded valuables. The robbers stole his Samsung cellphone, wallet containing $130 cash, and fled the scene in his white Nissan Tiida valued at $45,000.

Headline: Murder at Beetham Gardens: (Kevon Tuitt) Found Dead with Dozens of Shell Casings Nearby
Location: JGW4+6QF Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A murder is being investigated following the discovery of (Kevon Tuitt) at 6th Street, Beetham Gardens, around 12:00 p.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. Officers on patrol responded to a report of gunfire and found the victim, described as an African male approximately 25 years old with his hair in cane rows, lying face down in a pool of blood. Forensic teams recovered 28 spent shell casings and five live rounds of ammunition at the scene. The victim was wearing a white T-shirt and black three-quarter jeans at the time of the discovery.

Headline: Arima Carjacking: White Hyundai SUV Stolen at Gunpoint Late Sunday Night
Summary: A violent carjacking occurred in Arima, Northern Division, at approximately 10:50 p.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. A white Hyundai SUV, bearing registration number PDU 9888, was taken at gunpoint by unknown assailants. The suspects confronted the victim and fled the scene with the vehicle shortly before 11:00 p.m.

Headline: Vehicle Theft in Tunapuna: Kia Pick-Up Reported Stolen Early Sunday Morning
Summary: A vehicle theft occurred in the Tunapuna, Northern Division, during the morning hours of Sunday, December 21, 2025. A Kia Pick-up, bearing registration number TED 2831, was stolen from the area. The owner discovered the vehicle missing from its parked location and reported the matter to the local authorities.

Headline: Maxi Taxi Driver Robbed at Gunpoint: 51-Year-Old Victim Targeted on Priority Bus Route
Summary: An armed robbery occurred along the Priority Bus Route at approximately 10:30 a.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. A 51-year-old driver was plying his red band maxi taxi for hire when he picked up a male suspect in Curepe. Upon reaching Dinsley, the suspect produced a firearm and announced a robbery. The assailant relieved the driver of $2,600.00 TTD in cash before exiting the vehicle and escaping on foot, walking north along the Eastern Main Road in Arouca.

Headline: Security Breach in Caroni: Surveillance Officer Assaulted and Bound During Group Robbery
Street Address: Old Southern Main Road, Frederick Settlement, Caroni
Location: JJ48+72M Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A violent armed robbery occurred at Patrick Young Singh and Company Limited in Caroni, Central Division, around 1:00 a.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. A surveillance officer on duty was ambushed by five suspects dressed in dark clothing and face coverings. Two of the assailants were armed with firearms. The suspects assaulted the victim, striking him multiple times, and restrained him with duct tape. They stole $200 TTD and a Samsung cellular phone valued at $1,600 TTD before fleeing the premises.

Headline: Shooting at Maloney Gardens: 23-Year-Old Man Hospitalized After Early Morning Attack
Summary: A shooting occurred at Building 19, Maloney Gardens, Northern Division, in the early hours of Sunday, December 21, 2025. Officers responded to reports of loud explosions in the area but found the scene empty upon arrival. It was later confirmed that a 23-year-old male victim had arrived at the Arima Hospital seeking emergency treatment for a gunshot wound to his right upper shoulder. The victim remains hospitalized while investigations into the motive and the shooter's identity continue.

Headline: Fyzabad Bar Brawl: Teenager and Auto Electrician Stabbed After Suspect Targets Gaming Machines
Summary: A violent stabbing occurred at the Full Tilt Sports Bar in Fyzabad, South Western Division, around 9:30 p.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. Three men entered the establishment, where one began behaving erratically and striking gaming machines. When staff intervened, a physical altercation ensued involving thrown bottles. Two victims—a 16-year-old student and a 29-year-old auto electrician—sustained stab wounds to the back and rib cage during the chaos. Both were transported to the Point Fortin Hospital where they remain in stable condition.

Headline: High-Value Robbery in Arima: 19-Year-Old Robbed of $30,000 Gold Chain at Recreation Grounds
Summary: An armed robbery occurred at the Mickey Trotman Recreation Grounds in Arima, Northern Division, around 8:14 p.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. A 19-year-old man from Sangre Grande was liming with a friend when a lone gunman approached and pointed a firearm at him. Under threat of violence, the victim surrendered a Spanish-link gold chain valued at approximately $30,000.00 TTD. The suspect immediately fled the scene on foot heading in a southerly direction.

Headline: Barataria Man Shot in Malick: 21-Year-Old Mikhail Moore Ambushed While Visiting Girlfriend
Street Address: Upper Sixth Avenue, Valley Drive, Malick
Location: MG6Q+4G4 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A shooting occurred at Upper Sixth Avenue, Valley Drive, Malick, at approximately 2:00 a.m. on Sunday, December 21, 2025. The victim, 21-year-old Mikhail Moore, was walking to his girlfriend's residence when he was confronted by two armed men. The assailants opened fire, striking Moore in the leg before fleeing the scene. Moore collapsed a short distance away while attempting to escape and raised an alarm. He was subsequently transported to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex for treatment.

Headline: Claxton Bay businessman extorted for $100,000 and home targeted in shooting
Summary: A Claxton Bay business owner was targeted in a violent extortion attempt that began with threatening WhatsApp messages demanding TT$100,000. The unknown sender threatened to harm the victim's children and prevent his business from operating if the demand was not met. Approximately thirty minutes after the messages were sent, gunmen opened fire on the victim's residence. Police responding to the scene discovered four spent 9mm shells on the roadway. Investigations are ongoing into the digital threats and the subsequent shooting.

Headline: Armed gunmen ambush homeowner at Aventura Gardens, steal white SUV
Summary: A brazen robbery occurred at a residence in Aventura Gardens, Arima, when two armed men who had been lying in wait inside the victim's yard launched an ambush. As the homeowner entered the property, the gunmen confronted them and demanded the keys to their vehicle. The suspects successfully made off with a white sport utility vehicle bearing registration number PDU 9882. Local police were notified of the incident and are currently reviewing any available neighborhood surveillance footage to track the direction of the stolen SUV's flight.

Headline: Woman fights off attempted robber outside her apartment
Location: MGJ2+9JV Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A woman successfully defended herself during an attempted robbery outside her apartment around 7:32 p.m. As she was exiting her home, she was approached by an unknown male, approximately 5ft 4 inches tall with a dark complexion, wearing a maroon t-shirt. The suspect grabbed her handbag and threatened to shoot her. A physical struggle ensued, during which the victim managed to fight off the assailant and retrieve her bag. The victim raised an alarm, causing the suspect to flee the scene empty-handed.

Headline: White Toyota Fielder Wagon (PEA 1198) stolen from Mid Centre Mall car park
Summary: A 41-year-old woman discovered her vehicle missing just 30 minutes after securing it in the Mid Centre Mall car park. The victim parked her white Toyota Fielder Wagon, registration PEA 1198, on the eastern side of the mall at approximately 12:00 p.m. to conduct business. Upon her return at 12:30 p.m., the vehicle had been stolen. The matter was reported to the local police, and authorities are expected to review mall surveillance footage to identify the suspects involved in the daylight theft.

Headline: Man’s burnt remains found in Reform Village
Summary: A man's severely burnt remains were discovered lying on Railway Road, Reform Village, near a completely burnt car around 5 am on December 21. The victim, who appeared to be of African descent, was difficult to identify due to the severe burns, marking the second murder in the area within days.

Headline: Maxi-taxi operator's (62) vehicles torched in Longdenville arson attack
Location: FMX4+V7Q Todds Road, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 62-year-old maxi taxi operator was awakened early Saturday morning to find her 24-seater green band maxi taxi engulfed in flames at her Ravine Sable Road residence. Surveillance footage showed a suspect pouring a flammable substance onto the vehicle, causing the fire to spread and destroy two other vehicles belonging to her adult son. Police are investigating the arson attack, which occurred around 12:30 a.m., though no injuries were reported.

Headline: Critical Condition: 37-Year-Old Man Stabbed Multiple Times at San Juan Bar
Location: MG2X+822 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A violent stabbing took place at the Silver Dollar Bar on 2nd Street, San Juan, at approximately 2:00 a.m. on Saturday, December 20, 2025. A 37-year-old man from Febeau Village was involved in a physical altercation inside the establishment, during which he was stabbed multiple times in his upper body. The victim collapsed on the roadway after exiting the bar and was transported to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex by a bystander. He remains in critical condition and is currently heavily sedated.

Headline: La Brea Shop Robbery Turns Fatal: 29-Year-Old Labourer Shaquille Daniel Shot Dead
Street Address: Rig Road, Chinese Village, La Brea
Summary: A murder occurred at a shop on Rig Road, Chinese Village, La Brea, at approximately 1:40 a.m. on Saturday, December 20, 2025. The victim, 29-year-old Shaquille Daniel, went outside to investigate barking dogs when two armed men stormed the premises. One suspect wore a colorful mask, while the other had a white jersey wrapped around his head. While one gunman chased and robbed another occupant of a gold chain and band, a shot was fired. Daniel was subsequently found motionless on the living room floor with a gunshot wound to his chest. He was pronounced dead at the scene.

Headline: Fatal Shooting in Montrose: Chivonne Millet Gunned Down Inside Vehicle on John Street
Summary: A homicide occurred at John Street, Montrose, Chaguanas, Central Division, in the early hours of Saturday, December 20, 2025. The victim, Chivonne Millet, was driving a vehicle along the roadway when he was targeted by unknown assailants. Millet was shot multiple times while inside the car and succumbed to his injuries at the scene. Police are currently investigating the motive behind the attack.

Headline: Home Invasion in Arouca: Elderly Man Found Bound Inside Lopinot Road Residence
Summary: An elderly man was the victim of a home invasion at his residence on Lopinot Road, Arouca, Northern Division, during the overnight hours of Saturday, December 20, 2025. The victim was discovered tied up inside the house by responders. He was found alive and was immediately transported to a medical facility for treatment. Police are currently investigating the circumstances of the entry and determining what items were stolen during the attack.

Headline: Vehicle Theft at Trincity Mall: White Toyota Fielder Stolen Near KFC
Summary: A vehicle theft occurred at the Trincity Mall Car Park, Northern Division, on Saturday, December 20, 2025. The victim parked and secured his white Toyota Fielder Wagon, bearing registration number PDY 236, near the KFC outlet around 3:00 p.m. When he returned approximately one hour later at 4:00 p.m., he discovered the vehicle had been stolen. This incident adds to a recent spate of robberies reported within the mall's parking facilities.

Headline: Man (33) injured in shooting that killed soldier
Street Address: John Street, near the New Testament Church of God, Chaguanas
Summary: A 33-year-old man sustained a gunshot wound to his left calf during the same incident where soldier Shevaughn Millet was fatally shot in Montrose, Chaguanas. The injured man was taken to the Chaguanas Health Facility for treatment shortly after the attack. Police were unable to conduct a full interview immediately due to his injuries.

Headline: Daylight break-in at Estate Constable’s home (64)
Summary: A 64-year-old estate constable was the victim of a daylight house breaking and larceny at his home on Sanford Street West, California, Couva. Thieves broke down the back door between 8 a.m. and 4 p.m. on December 20 while the owner was away, stealing items valued at $4,400. The stolen property included a gold necklace, two wristwatches, a leather bag, and a Samsung A16 mobile phone.

Headline: 76-year-old retiree robbed, hospitalised in city-centre attack (76)
Location: MF3R+VP5 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 76-year-old retiree was robbed and hospitalized after being attacked inside a food outlet along Charlotte Street, Port of Spain. Two suspects approached the victim, forced him to the ground, and stole his Samsung Galaxy mobile phone from a nearby counter. The victim, who is from East Dry River, was subsequently taken to the hospital by officers for medical treatment.

Headline: St. Augustine Stabbing: 36-Year-Old Man Wounded in Neck After Altercation with Group
Street Address: Corner of Freeman and Orange Grove Roads
Location: JJM2+MW3 St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A wounding occurred at the corner of Freeman and Orange Grove Roads, St. Augustine, around 10:30 p.m. on Friday, December 19, 2025. A 36-year-old man was liming when an argument broke out with a group of four men. One suspect, described as an East Indian male with a distinct tattoo of a scissors and razor blade on the right side of his neck, slashed the victim across the throat with a silver object. The assailant fled south along Freeman Road in a vehicle. The victim was observed clutching his neck as he bled from the injury.

Headline: 74-Year-Old Woman Targeted in St. Ann’s: Handbag Snatched During Home Ambush
Location: MFPW+JX4 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A robbery occurred at a residence on Fondes Amandes Road, St. Ann’s, around 5:45 p.m. on Friday, December 19, 2025. A 74-year-old woman was reversing into her garage when she was confronted by a slim-built male suspect wearing a red cap. The suspect forcibly grabbed her navy blue handbag after a struggle. He fled in a silver Nissan AD wagon (PDN 1047). The victim pursued the vehicle to Sydenham Avenue, where the suspect discarded the bag on the roadway. Upon retrieval, the victim found all items intact, including her iPhone 7, documents, and cash.

Headline: Vehicle Theft at Mt. Hope: Gold Nissan Almera Stolen from EWMSC Car Park
Location: JHXF+4WV San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A vehicle theft was reported at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex (EWMSC), Mt. Hope, on Friday, December 19, 2025. A gold Nissan Almera, bearing registration number PCM-1075, was stolen from the facility's car park. The owner discovered the vehicle missing after leaving it parked at the complex.

Headline: Armed Carjacking in California: Toyota Hilux Stolen at Gunpoint on Subram Street
Summary: A violent carjacking occurred at Subram Street, California, Central Division, around 8:30 p.m. on Friday, December 19, 2025. A lone gunman approached the victim and stole a black Toyota Hilux, bearing registration number TCW 2882, at gunpoint. The suspect fled the scene with the stolen vehicle immediately after the encounter.

Headline: Home invasion in Gasparillo: 3 robbed by gunmen (29)
Summary: Four armed men, carrying firearms and a cutlass, invaded a home on Victoria Street, Gasparillo, around 10:30 p.m. The suspects ordered three victims to the ground and stole cash, electronics, and jewellery, including a PS5 console, a drone, and a Rolex replica watch. One victim suffered several blows during the attack, which occurred while a 29-year-old man was visiting friends at the residence.

Headline: Teacher (49) robbed at cutlass-point in Chaguanas home invasion
Location: GHFP+5G8 St Charles, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 49-year-old teacher was awakened around 3 a.m. on Friday after an intruder gained entry to her Chaguanas home. The victim was confronted by a dark man wearing a ski mask and armed with a cutlass, who announced a robbery and demanded cash. Fearing for her safety, the teacher handed over $40,000 in cash before the suspect fled the residence.

Headline: Supermarket Robbery in Cunupia: Employee Assaulted During Brazen Heist at One Plus One Supermarket
Summary: A robbery occurred at One Plus One Supermarket, Munroe Road, Cunupia, Central Division, on Friday, December 19, 2025. Surveillance footage captured suspects exiting a silver Nissan Wingroad (PDT 8211) and violently pushing an employee at the rear of the building to facilitate the crime. Minutes later, the assailants were seen re-entering the vehicle and fleeing the scene.

Headline: Vehicle Theft in Woodbrook: Silver Nissan Almera Reported Stolen
Location: MF8C+PPG Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A vehicle theft was reported in the Woodbrook, Port of Spain, Western Division, on Friday, December 19, 2025. A silver Nissan Almera (PBY 4074) was stolen from the area. The theft took place during the day/night, and the owner discovered the vehicle missing from where it was parked.

Headline: Maraj Lane Raid: 40-Year-Old Man Arrested After Loaded Pistol Found on Kitchen Counter
Summary: Police officers conducted an operation at Maraj Lane, North Eastern Division, between 2:00 a.m. and 5:30 a.m. on Friday, December 19, 2025. During the search of a residence, a 40-year-old male suspect was arrested after officers discovered a pistol loaded with a magazine containing five rounds of ammunition on the kitchen counter. The suspect was taken into custody pending further investigations.

Headline: Cunupia Intelligence-Led Operation: 53-Year-Old Arrested for Illegal Firearm and Cannabis
Summary: Officers from the Cunupia Criminal Investigations Department (CID) executed an intelligence-led operation around 6:30 a.m. on Friday, December 19, 2025. The exercise resulted in the arrest of a 53-year-old man after he was found in possession of one pistol loaded with a magazine and a quantity of cannabis.

Headline: Daylight Robbery in St. James: Gold Chain Violently Snatched from Man on Quamina Street
Location: MFF8+8CJ Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A brazen robbery took place at Quamina Street, St. James, Western Division, on Thursday, December 18, 2025. Video footage captured a man crossing the road toward a residence when he was approached by a male suspect. The assailant violently snatched a gold chain from around the victim's neck before fleeing the scene on foot in the opposite direction.

Headline: Homicide in San Juan: Ishiyaho Eshban Williams, 34 "Papio" Shot Dead on Bagatelle Road
Location: MG6W+977 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A fatal shooting occurred at Bagatelle Road, San Juan, North Eastern Division, on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A man (Ishiyaho Eshban Williams, 34) known by the alias "Papio" was targeted and shot multiple times by an unknown assailant. Residents reported hearing several gunshots, and the victim was found deceased at the scene shortly after. Police are currently investigating the motive behind the killing.

Headline: Armed Robbery at Church’s Chicken: Staff Assaulted and $16,000 Stolen at Four Roads Location
Location: MCPW+GPM Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A violent armed robbery occurred at Church’s Chicken, Four Roads, Diego Martin, Western Division, at approximately 12:40 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A 21-year-old employee was emptying garbage through the rear door when four armed men exited a silver wagon (PBC 2928) and forced him back inside. The suspects robbed the establishment of approximately $16,000 TTD in daily sales and proceeded to rob other staff members of their mobile phones. During the incident, one male worker was kicked in the head before his Samsung S22 was stolen. The assailants fled the scene through the rear exit in the waiting vehicle.

Headline: Stolen Vehicle Alert: White Honda Vezel (PEE 62) Taken from Maturita
Location: JPJM+JF9 Santa Rosa Heights, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A vehicle theft was reported in the Maturita, Arima, Northern Division, during the early morning hours of Thursday, December 18, 2025. Between 2:00 a.m. and 3:00 a.m., a white Honda Vezel, registration number PEE 62, was stolen from the area. The owner discovered the vehicle missing shortly after the incident took place.

Headline: Stolen Vehicle Alert: Black Honda Vezel (PDR-1346) Stolen in Manuel Congo
Summary: A vehicle theft occurred in Manuel Congo, Arima, Northern Division, around 5:00 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A black Honda Vezel, bearing registration number PDR-1346, was reported stolen from the location.

Headline: San Fernando School Targeted: Cash and Electronics Stolen in School of Higher Education Break-In
Street Address: School of Higher Education, Rushworth Street
Summary: A burglary occurred at the School of Higher Education, San Fernando, Southern Division, between 5:00 p.m. on Wednesday, December 17, and 7:15 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. The owner discovered that the front glass door of the institution had been smashed to gain entry. Upon inspection, it was revealed that $1,000 TTD in cash and several electronic items were missing from the premises.

Headline: $342,000 Jewelry Heist in Princes Town: Clerk Assaulted and Bound During Brazen Store Robbery
Summary: A violent armed robbery took place at Ian Jewellery Shop, Maingot Road, St Julien Road, Princes Town, at approximately 9:00 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. Two armed men entered the establishment and accosted a 31-year-old sales clerk, slapping her multiple times before tying her hands and feet. The suspects stole over $342,000 TTD worth of jewelry and gold, including a gold bera valued at over $50,000, diamond rings, and 80 grams of scrap gold. The assailants fled the scene in a black Nissan Tiida along the Naparima Mayaro Road. The victim was subsequently treated for her injuries at the Princes Town Health Facility.

Headline: Shopper Targeted at Trincity Mall: Woman Dragged During Violent Handbag Robbery
Summary: A violent robbery occurred at the south-western carpark of Trincity Mall, Northern Division, around 7:30 p.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A woman from Belmont and her husband were walking to their vehicle near Tru Valu when two men exited a silver-grey Nissan Tiida (PDS 8490) parked nearby. The suspects accosted the woman and grabbed her handbag, leading to a struggle. During the altercation, the victim fell to the ground and was dragged a short distance before the thieves made off with the bag. The stolen items included a handbag valued at £500 (UK), a Samsung A11, US$300, TT$1,500, and various personal documents. The suspects fled the scene via the highway in an easterly direction.

Headline: Daylight Robbery in Port of Spain: 65-Year-Old Woman Robbed of $3,000 Gold Bera on Queen Street
Location: MF2Q+JHM Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A robbery occurred along Queen Street, Port of Spain, at approximately 10:26 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A 65-year-old woman from Valsayn was proceeding in her vehicle with the window down when a suspect snatched a gold bera valued at $3,000 TTD from her. The suspect is described as a man of mixed descent, approximately 5’7” tall, with a brown complexion, long black curly hair, and a distinct tattoo on the right side of his face. He was also noted to be bandy-legged and was wearing a blue T-shirt with a red print at the time of the incident. He fled the scene on foot.

Headline: Robbery on Nelson Street: 57-Year-Old Man Targeted Near Amalgamated Building
Location: MF3V+P9H Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A robbery occurred on Nelson Street, Port of Spain, in the vicinity of the Amalgamated building at approximately 3:30 p.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A 57-year-old man was walking along the street when he was approached by two male suspects. The assailants announced a robbery and ordered the victim to remain quiet while pressing an unidentified object against his back. The suspects searched the victim and stole his Samsung Galaxy A06 cellphone, valued at $850.00 TTD, and $900.00 TTD in cash. Both suspects fled the scene on foot following the encounter.

Headline: Four detained after police recover cannabis and large sums of cash in St Augustine
Location: MH4X+2WR St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Coordinated operations in St Augustine resulted in the recovery of 1,142 grammes of cannabis, along with $115,204 TTD and US$550 in cash. Four individuals were detained at the location following the execution of a search warrant.

Headline: Cashier Kaleisha Dean (21) stabbed during altercation in Diego Martin
Location: PC4W+XV4 Petit Valley, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Kaleisha Dean, 21, was stabbed and injured in the shoulder during a confrontation with a co-worker and another woman on Sierre Leone Street, Diego Martin. The incident occurred around 8:30 p.m. after Dean finished work. She was taken to the hospital by her boyfriend, treated for her injuries, and subsequently discharged.

Headline: Shooting in Champ Fleurs: Man Identified as "Chinee" Wounded at Mt. Dor Road
Location: MH7C+2F7 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A violent shooting occurred at Mt. Dor Road, Champ Fleurs, Northern Division, on the night of Wednesday, December 17, 2025. A man identified only by the alias "Chinee" was shot and wounded by an unknown assailant. The victim was transported for medical treatment following the attack.

Headline: High-Stakes Robbery in Preysal: $200,000 Cash Stolen from SUV Near Secondary School
Street Address: Gran Couva Main Road (vicinity of Preysal Secondary School)
Summary: A massive theft occurred on the Gran Couva Main Road, Preysal, Central Division, around 4:00 p.m. on Wednesday, December 17, 2025. A 52-year-old man parked his Kia Sportage SUV near the Preysal Secondary School to make a purchase from a roadside vendor, leaving a bag containing $200,000 TTD in cash in the rear of the vehicle. The victim observed a man of African descent open the rear door, snatch the bag, and throw it into a waiting silver Toyota Aqua (PDS 8733). The vehicle sped off south toward the Sir Solomon Hochoy Highway, while the suspect escaped on foot into nearby bushes.

Headline: Fatal Stabbing in Diego Martin: Peacemaker Stephen Roberts, 30, Killed Intervening in Fight
Location: PC4W+XV4 Petit Valley, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A tragic homicide occurred along Sierra Leone Road, Diego Martin, Western Division, at approximately 8:00 p.m. on Wednesday, December 17, 2025. Stephen Roberts, 30, of Agua Santa Avenue, was fatally stabbed while attempting to intervene in a physical altercation involving three women. Roberts, acting as a peacemaker, was wounded by one of the female participants during the dispute. He was rushed to the St. James Medical Complex, where he succumbed to his injuries while receiving medical treatment.

Headline: Jewelry and Cash Stolen from Senior Citizen: 68-Year-Old Cunupia Woman Robbed of Over $15,000
Summary: A theft involving high-value items was reported by a 68-year-old woman in Cunupia, Central Division, on Wednesday, December 17, 2025. The victim reported that she had secured $4,000 TTD and $320 USD in her handbag, along with five gold rings valued at approximately $10,000 TTD inside her jewelry box. The items were last seen on November 23, 2025, but were discovered missing when she checked again on December 17.

Headline: Tobago Mechanic Ambushed: 30-Year-Old Shakiel White Hospitalized After Shooting in Mary’s Hill
Summary: A shooting occurred near the home of Shakiel White, 30, a mechanic residing in Mary’s Hill, Tobago, on Thursday, December 18, 2025. White was seated in his vehicle when he was ambushed by an unknown assailant who opened fire. The victim sustained multiple gunshot wounds to his right leg, left forearm, left palm, and right jaw. He was transported to the hospital, where he is currently receiving medical treatment for his injuries.

Headline: Pre-Christmas Burglary in Port of Spain: Thieves Target Pembroke Street Building for Renovation Supplies
Location: MF6Q+CM8 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A burglary occurred at a residential building on Pembroke Street, Port of Spain, in the early hours of Tuesday, December 17, 2025. Around 7:45 a.m., a tenant discovered that storage rooms on the first and second floors had been ransacked. Further inspection revealed that an apartment had also been breached, with thieves stealing six gallons of Sherwin-Williams paint, lighting fixtures, vanity lights, and mirrors. Security footage showed two men removing the items. Investigators believe the suspects entered through a first-floor window before exiting via the ground-floor garage door.

Headline: Vehicle Robbery in Arouca: Suspects Caught in Black Tiida After Attacking Woman in Restaurant Car Park
Summary: A robbery occurred at a restaurant car park in Five Rivers, Arouca, Northern Division, around 3:15 p.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025. A woman was waiting in her husband’s vehicle when two men approached and entered through both the driver and passenger doors. The victim was struck during a struggle with one suspect while the other stole two envelopes containing bank documents and $80 TTD in cash. The suspects fled west along the Eastern Main Road into a black Nissan Tiida hatchback. Following a pursuit, officers from the Arouca Charge Room and the NCTF-E intercepted the vehicle (PCL 8643) on the Churchill–Roosevelt Highway near Maloney, discovering it was fitted with false registration plates.

Headline: Burglary in Cunupia: Over $50,000 Cash and Jewelry Stolen from Sandy Lane Residence
Location: HM58+C8X Madras Settlement, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A residential burglary occurred at a home along Sandy Lane, Boy Cato Road, Cunupia, Central Division, on Wednesday, December 17, 2025. The occupants were reportedly away from the premises when the incident took place. During the break-in, thieves made off with over $50,000.00 TTD in cash and a significant quantity of jewelry. The theft was discovered when the residents returned home.

Headline: Homemade shotgun recovered in San Raphael
Location: HPCQ+8CG San Rafael, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Officers from the San Raphael Police Station conducted a search operation in a forested area along Arena Road. During the exercise, they successfully recovered a homemade 16-gauge shotgun.

Headline: Schoolgirl steals mom's car (17)
Street Address: Southern Main Road, California, Couva (near Amalgamated Security Services compound)
Summary: A 17-year-old student stole her mother's white Nissan AD Wagon early Tuesday morning, driving without permission or a permit. The vehicle subsequently crashed into a T&TEC electricity pole and a parked security vehicle on Southern Main Road, California, Couva, seriously injuring the teenager.

Headline: Maloney Robbery: Soldiers Suspected in $7,000 Cash Theft
Summary: Four masked men, reportedly dressed in camouflage uniforms, robbed two victims of a total of $7,000 in cash. The suspects were seen entering a marked regiment vehicle, leading investigators to confine four serving members of the Regiment to barracks pending further enquiries.

Headline: Theft on Ariapita Avenue: 24-Year-Old Woman’s iPhone 11 Stolen While Waiting in Line
Location: MF6H+95R Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A case of theft occurred on Ariapita Avenue, Port-of-Spain Division, around 3:53 a.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A 24-year-old woman was standing in line at Yousef Gyro when a person bumped into her. She immediately checked her right-side pocket and discovered that her iPhone 11, valued at $3,500 TTD, had been stolen. The phone was not recovered.

Headline: Robbery of Church Proceeds: Pastor Robbed of $24,000 Cash by Brazen Thief in Couva
Summary: A brazen robbery occurred on Flamingo Avenue, Lisas Gardens, Couva, Central Division, around 2:25 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A Pastor was standing in front of his yard when he was approached by a man of Hispanic descent who attempted to engage him in conversation. The suspect then snatched an envelope containing $24,000 in church proceeds from the victim's hand and fled into a waiting silver Nissan Tiida (PDN-2035). The suspect is described as being approximately 5 feet 7 inches tall with a light brown complexion, wearing dark clothing and sneakers.

Headline: Theft and Car Break-In at Trincity Mall: 53-Year-Old Woman’s iPad Stolen After Window Smashed
Street Address: Trincity Mall Car Park (near Tru Value)
Summary: A theft involving a car break-in occurred at the Trincity Mall car park, Northern Division, between 11:15 a.m. and 12:10 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A 53-year-old woman from Tacarigua returned to her vehicle near Tru Value to find the front passenger window smashed. A grey Apple iPad valued at $5,500 TTD was stolen from inside the car.

Headline: Robbery with Aggravation: Cunupia Retiree Robbed at Gunpoint Following Staged Collision in Chaguanas
Summary: A violent robbery occurred on Narsaloo Ramaya Road, Endeavour, Chaguanas, Central Division, around 1:45 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A retiree was driving her Honda Vezel when a white station wagon (PDN-1047) intentionally collided with the rear of her vehicle. A suspect exited the wagon, placed his hands on the victim's neck, and announced a robbery. Fearing for her life, the victim handed over a gold bracelet ($5,000 TTD), a purse containing $500 TTD cash, her driver’s permit, and her ID card. The suspect fled the scene heading south.

Headline: Burglary in Chaguanas: 33-Year-Old Woman Robbed of Cash and Gold Jewelry After Home Ransacked
Summary: A burglary occurred at a residence in Woodford Gardens, Chaguanas, Central Division, during the early hours of Tuesday, December 16, 2025. The victim, a 33-year-old patient care assistant, was awakened around 4:00 a.m. by her car alarm and discovered a masked intruder fleeing through a southern window. The suspect, described as 5 feet 8 inches tall, escaped after ransacking the home and stealing $5,000 TTD in cash and various gold jewelry, including a chain with a pendant and earrings marked "Mick."

Headline: Home Invasion in Couva: 66-Year-Old Woman Robbed of Gold Jewelry and Cash by Two Men
Summary: A home invasion occurred at a residence on Palm Avenue, Couva, Central Division, around 1:15 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A 66-year-old woman observed a grey Toyota Aqua drive into her yard before two men entered her home and announced a robbery. The suspects forced the victim into the living room and stole a quantity of gold jewelry and $400 TTD in cash before fleeing the scene in the same vehicle.

Headline: Homicide in Ste. Madeleine: Jameer Mahabirsingh,44, Found Shot to Death on Reform Road
Summary: A fatal shooting occurred on Reform Road, Ste. Madeleine, Southern Division, late on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. Police discovered the body of (Jameer Mahabirsingh, 44), with multiple gunshot injuries to the body. He was pronounced dead at the scene.

Headline: Theft of Motor Vehicle: Orange Wagon (PDY 5843) Stolen from Winnie Mohammed Road
Location: MCWR+GFJ Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A case of theft of a motor vehicle occurred along Winnie Mohammed Road, Diego Martin, Western Division. Video footage captured a man approaching and stealing an orange wagon, registration number PDY 5843, from the location.

Headline: Violent Robbery at Arima Bar: Woman Attacked and Forced to Ground as Bystanders Watch
Summary: A violent robbery and assault occurred at 40 Bar in Arima, Northern Division, on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. Video footage shows a woman walking outside to use her phone when she was followed by a male suspect. The man attacked her, pushing her to the ground and forcing her back inside the establishment where the assault continued. Despite the presence of bystanders who did not intervene, the suspect completed the robbery and fled through the front door of the bar.

Headline: Shoplifting in San Juan: CCTV Captures Two Women Stealing Bandanas from Store
Location: MH23+5HC San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A case of theft occurred at a retail store in San Juan, North Eastern Division. CCTV footage captured two women caught red-handed as they removed several bandanas from the store display and concealed them before leaving the premises without making payment.

Headline: Massive Contraband Seizure: TTPS Intercepts Major Smuggling Operation at Carenage Pier
Summary: A significant law enforcement operation was executed by the Trinidad and Tobago Police Service (TTPS) at Shore Pier 3, Carenage, Western Division, around 8:15 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. Under the direction of Commissioner Allister Guevarro and DCP Suzette Martin, multiple specialized units intercepted a vessel offloading a massive shipment of contraband believed to be from Suriname. Police seized approximately 1,000 cases of vodka, 200 cases of Johnnie Walker, 200 cases of Hennessy, and 1,000 cases of ATLANTA cigarettes. Sixteen suspects were apprehended after attempting to flee, and four trucks involved in the transport were seized.

Headline: Larceny at East Gate Mall: Weso Foods Truck Looted of Over $2,100 in Frozen Goods
Summary: A theft occurred at the East Gate Mall car park, Northern Division, between 3:00 p.m. and 3:15 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A Weso Foods truck driver left his vehicle unsecured while entering the mall for fifteen minutes. Upon his return, he discovered several cases of food missing, including salt fish, fries, lamb, mixed vegetables, and cow heel. The total value of the stolen items is estimated at $2,118.50 TTD.

Headline: al Firearms and Police Gear Found: Shotgun and Bulletproof Vests Seized in Cumuto Raid
Summary: Officers from the Cumuto Police Station and the Northern Division North Task Force conducted an intelligence-led search of an abandoned property along Cumuto Main Road on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. During the operation, police uncovered a pump-action shotgun and two blue bulletproof vests clearly marked "Police." No arrests were made at the scene.

Headline: Cental Division Crackdown: Shotgun and Ammunition Recovered from Bushy Area in Charlieville
Location: GHVJ+795 St Charles, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: On Tuesday, December 16, 2025, officers from the Chaguanas CID and the Central Division Task Force carried out a coordinated operation along Connector Road, Charlieville. During a search of a dense bushy area, police successfully recovered a shotgun along with several shotgun cartridges. The exercise was led by Sgt. Samaroo, and further investigations are being conducted by PC Hosein.

Headline: High-Value Tool Theft in Arouca: $45,000 in Equipment Stolen from Smashed Panel Van
Summary: A significant theft from a vehicle occurred at Gannet Street, Bon Air, Arouca, Northern Division, between 11:00 p.m. on Monday, December 15, and 5:00 a.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A resident of Kelly Village returned to his panel van to find the left side door window smashed. Upon inspection, the victim discovered that tools valued at $45,000 TTD had been stolen from the vehicle.

Headline: Theft at Workplace: $4,000 Cash Stolen from Employee Locker at Trincity Business Park
Summary: A theft occurred at BM Electronics, Trincity Business Park, Northern Division, between 2:15 p.m. and 5:35 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. A female employee from Cunupia reported that she secured $4,000 TTD in cash inside her work locker at the start of her shift. When she returned later that evening, she discovered the money had been stolen.

Headline: Police officer's Toyota Aqua stolen from One Woodbrook Place
Location: MF9C+78H Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A police officer reported his Toyota Aqua, valued at $45,000, stolen from the basement carpark at One Woodbrook Place on Monday evening. The officer had securely locked the vehicle around 8:06 p.m., but discovered it missing when he returned approximately 9:30 p.m.

Headline: Home Invasion and Assault: Masked Thieves Tie Up and Injure 89-Year-Old Couple in Spring Garden
Summary: A violent home invasion occurred at a residence in Spring Garden, Port-of-Spain Division, around 1:00 p.m. on Monday, December 15, 2025. An 89-year-old man and his 89-year-old wife were accosted in their home by three masked men. The male victim was tied, gagged, forced to the ground, and assaulted, sustaining injuries to his back and head. His wife was also tied up. The thieves ransacked the home, stealing a wedding ring and other jewelry, two Samsung phones, a Samsung TV, a tablet, a wristwatch, TT$600 in cash, a bottle of coins, and a Stihl 250 brush cutter.

Headline: Daylight Robbery at Trincity Mall: Masked Men Rob 34-Year-Old of $42,000 Cash in Car Park
Street Address: Trincity Mall Car Park (near Pennywise outlet)
Summary: A daylight robbery occurred at the Trincity Mall car park, Northern Division, around 1:27 p.m. on Monday, December 15, 2025. A 34-year-old man from St. Madeleine was approached by two men wearing ski masks near the Pennywise outlet. The suspects announced a robbery and escaped with a grey backpack containing a large sum of TT$42,000 in cash, along with the victim’s ID card and driver's permit. The assailants fled the scene in a white Nissan AD wagon (PDW-8727), heading south.

Headline: Carjacking in Sangre Grande: 36-Year-Old Robbed of Silver Mazda 323 During Drop-Off
Location: HVR9+PG2 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A robbery of a motor vehicle (carjacking) occurred in the North Eastern Settlement, Sangre Grande, Eastern Division, around 10:45 p.m. on Monday, December 15, 2025. A 36-year-old man from Junction Road was hired by an acquaintance for a drop-off at Immortelle Crescent. Upon arrival, the suspect (later identified as Shakquan Parks, 22) switched off the engine, removed the keys, and ordered the victim out of the car, supported by several unknown individuals surrounding the vehicle. The victim fled. Police subsequently arrested the suspect and recovered the stolen silver Mazda 323 on Park Avenue Extension.

Headline: Robbery with Injuries: Two Men Robbed of $30K Air Rifle and Valuables During Facebook Meetup in Tunapuna
Summary: A serious robbery occurred at Upper Fairly, Bamboo Trace, Tunapuna, Northern Division, around 5:30 p.m. on Tuesday, December 16, 2025. Two men, both 45 years old (from Couva and Marabella), were meeting a buyer arranged via Facebook to sell an air rifle. Upon arrival, they were confronted by three armed men who stole the air rifle ($30,000 TT), a gold chain ($7,000 TT), two cellphones (Samsung S10, Redmi), and $500 TT cash. Both victims escaped, but one sustained injuries to both knees during the incident.

Headline: Robbery with Aggravation: Man Bound and Robbed of $40K Gold Chain, Phone by Armed Suspects in Toco
Summary: A robbery with aggravation occurred at a residence on Paria Main Road, Toco, Eastern Division, around 9:10 p.m. on Monday, December 15, 2025. The victim (age not specified) was confronted at his home by an acquaintance who lured him into conversation. A second suspect then emerged, pointed a firearm, and announced a hold-up. The suspects bound the victim's hands with leather belts before stealing a 10-karat gold chain ($40,000 TT) and a Samsung A-16 phone ($2,000 TT). The assailants fled east in a white Kia K-2700 (TBX 9925), prompting police to establish multiple checkpoints.

Headline: Theft of Pepper Sauce: Man Caught on Video Stealing Condiment from Curepe Bar Counter
Summary: An opportunistic theft occurred at Caps Bar in Curepe, Northern Division, on Monday, December 15, 2025. Video footage captured a man, after purchasing food, bagging his meal and then quickly swiping a bottle of pepper sauce from the counter before walking off with it.

Headline: $26,400 Alcohol Scam at Arima Supermarket: Suspect "Animal" Tricks Shopper with Fake Staff Discount
Summary: A fraudulent incident occurred at Maraj Westside Supermarket, Arima, Northern Division, around 12:39 p.m. on Monday, December 15, 2025. A man known only as "Animal" deceived a shopper by falsely claiming to be an employee who could provide a staff discount on alcohol. The victim handed over $26,400 TTD to the suspect, who in turn provided a fake invoice before leaving the premises. The victim realized the deception only after attempting to collect the goods and being informed that the man was not an employee of the supermarket.

Headline: 46-year-old Neil Ramnath killed after being beaten and thrown into traffic in Couva
Summary: Neil Ramnath, 46, lost his life following a violent assault at Otis Lane in Balmain, Couva. During the altercation, the victim was severely beaten before being intentionally thrown into the path of a moving vehicle. Ramnath sustained fatal injuries from the impact and was pronounced dead shortly after the incident. Police are currently investigating the circumstances of the assault and seeking those responsible for the physical attack and subsequent death.

Headline: Claxton Bay family robbed at gunpoint
Location: 9H66+66C Sum Sum Hill, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A family in Claxton Bay was subjected to a terrifying home invasion when two masked men, arriving in a grey Nissan Note with false plates, forced their way into their Soldad Road residence around 6:20 am. The assailants, one armed with a gun, held the 49-year-old man, his wife, and daughter captive while searching the house. The robbers successfully escaped in the waiting car after taking cash, jewellery, and cellphones.

Headline: Aggravated Assault in Belmont: Armed Robber Records Humiliating Video of 21-Year-Old Woman
Street Address: Lady Young Road, Belmont (near Textile Hill)
