Location: MG89+FM3 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An incident of aggravated assault and criminal recording followed the robbery of a 21-year-old female victim on Lady Young Road, Belmont, Port-of-Spain Division, on Sunday, December 14, 2025. After the robbery, the armed suspect compelled the woman to follow him up the hill, ordered her to remove some clothing, and recorded a video of her on his phone before allowing her and her companion to leave.

Headline: Murder on Ariapita Avenue: Morvant Man Shot Dead Inside SUV Near Woodbrook Police Station
Location: MF7H+7F4 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A murder of (Jalani George) occurred in Woodbrook, Port-of-Spain Division, on Monday, December 15, 2025, when a man from the Morvant community was shot inside a silver Hyundai Creta (PEE 2853). The shooting took place outside the Proper Ting Grill Hub, located between Fitt Street and Murray Street on Ariapita Avenue ("D Avenue"). The victim died at the scene. The location is notably close to the Woodbrook Police Station.

Headline: Attempted Shooting in Tableland: Jerome Joseph (22) Escapes Unharmed After Ambush
Summary: An attempted shooting incident occurred in Tableland, New Grant, around 1:30 a.m. on Sunday, December 14, 2025. Jerome Joseph (22) was walking north along Monkey Town 3rd Branch Road when he encountered Joshua Benjamin (24), who was armed with a firearm. Benjamin pointed the weapon and fired several shots at Joseph. Joseph managed to flee the scene unharmed, though his vehicle was later found damaged (see Incident 4). Two spent shells were recovered by police.

Headline: Armed Robbery on Lady Young Road: Two 21-Year-Olds Robbed of Cash, Jewelry, and Bank Card
Street Address: Lady Young Road, Belmont (near Textile Hill)
Location: MG89+FM3 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An armed robbery occurred in the Belmont, Port-of-Spain Division, around midnight on Sunday, December 14, 2025, targeting two 21-year-old victims. An armed suspect emerged from bushes on Lady Young Road near Textile Hill, forcing the victims to lie down. The suspect stole four gold rings ($4,000 TT), $300 TT cash, and a bank card. The robbery was counted as one incident, though it led to a separate crime against the female victim (see Incident 2).

Headline: Motor Vehicle Larceny: White Honda City (PDS 3074) Stolen from San Fernando Street
Summary: A case of motor vehicle larceny occurred in San Fernando, Southern Division, around 3:58 a.m. on Sunday, December 14, 2025. A white Honda City (PDS 3074) was reported stolen from Seukaran Street.

Headline: Chain Snatching Robbery: Man Robbed of Gold Chain While Socializing in D'Abadie
Summary: A street robbery involving a chain-snatching occurred in D'Abadie, Northern Division, on Sunday, December 14, 2025. The male victim (age not specified) was socializing, speaking with a woman and drinking a beer, when he was targeted. Video footage shows two men observing the victim, pretending to enquire about a nearby location, before one suspect walked up and forcibly snatched the gold chain from the victim's neck. The suspects then fled in the direction they arrived from.

Headline: 41-year-old man arrested in Southern Division drug probe
Summary: Police operating in the Southern Division arrested a 41-year-old man in connection with a recent find, likely related to the ongoing cannabis investigation mentioned in the headline. The operation was coordinated by several senior officers including Snr Supt Simon and Supt Bertie.

Headline: Man (28) arrested for cannabis possession in Indian Walk
Summary: During a coordinated police exercise in the Southern Division, officers arrested a 28-year-old man of Indian Walk for the possession of a quantity of cannabis. This arrest was part of a wider operation targeting illegal activities in the area.

Headline: Motor Vehicle Larceny: Silver Mazda BJ Hatchback (PCE 3682) Stolen from Gulf City Mall Carpark
Street Address: Gulf City Mall Carpark (near Fortune Shop), San Fernando
Summary: A case of motor vehicle larceny occurred at the Gulf City Mall, San Fernando, Southern Division, on Saturday, December 13, 2025. A silver-coloured Mazda BJ Hatchback (PCE 3682) was stolen from the Level 2 Car Park sometime between 2:00 p.m. and 8:20 p.m. The incident highlights security concerns despite the mall's infrastructure.

Headline: Carjacking in Caparo: Taxi Driver (45) Robbed of Vehicle by Masked Gunmen
Summary: Following the robbery of a local supermarket, two gunmen in Caparo, Central Division, committed a robbery of a motor vehicle (carjacking) around 6:30 p.m. on Saturday, December 13, 2025. The suspects targeted a 45-year-old taxi driver (name not specified), stealing his vehicle. The stolen car was later recovered by law enforcement a short distance away from the scene.

Headline: Wounding with Intent in Maloney: Richie Belcon (35) Shot in Upper Back at Gathering
Summary: A wounding with intent incident occurred in Maloney Gardens, D’Abadie, on Saturday, December 13, 2025, around 6:00 p.m. Richie Belcon (35) was at a gathering in Building 21 when he heard explosions and sustained a gunshot wound to his upper back. Belcon was treated at Arima General Hospital before being transferred to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex. Two 9mm spent shell casings were found at the scene, and investigations are ongoing to identify the suspect.

Headline: Motor Vehicle Larceny at Gulf City Mall: Brown Kia Sorento ($80K TT) Stolen from San Fernando Carpark
Street Address: Gulf City Mall Carpark (near Fortune Shop), San Fernando
Summary: A case of motor vehicle larceny occurred at Gulf City Mall, San Fernando, Southern Division, between Friday night, December 12, 2025, and early Saturday morning, December 13, 2025. A 42-year-old man from Claxton Bay parked his brown Kia Sorento (PCY 5169), valued at approximately $80,000 TT, near the Fortune Shop around 8:30 p.m. When he returned at 2:00 a.m., the key-start SUV was missing. The vehicle was reportedly not equipped with GPS tracking but was covered by a comprehensive insurance policy.

Headline: Carjacking in Cunupia: Silver Nissan B15 (PBX 8853) Stolen at Gunpoint on Southern Main Road
Location: GJWG+V67 Jerningham Junction, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A carjacking occurred in Cunupia, Central Division, around 5:30 a.m. on Saturday, December 13, 2025. A silver-coloured Nissan B-15 (PBX 8853) was taken away at gunpoint by a male suspect of Hispanic descent. The armed robbery took place on the Southern Main Road.

Headline: Robbery at Ramoutar Supermarket: Two Masked Gunmen Steal Cash and Cellphones in Caparo
Summary: A robbery occurred at Ramoutar Supermarket, Chickland Road, Caparo, Central Division, around 6:30 p.m. on Saturday, December 13, 2025. Two gunmen wearing surgical masks entered the premises and stole $400 TTD in cash and two cellphones. Following the supermarket robbery, the suspects proceeded to rob a nearby taxi driver of his vehicle

Headline: Carjacking in Chase Village: Grey Nissan Wingroad (PCH 9511) Stolen at Gunpoint
Summary: A carjacking occurred in Chase Village, Central Division, around 12:30 p.m. on Saturday, December 13, 2025. A grey Nissan Wingroad Wagon (PCH 9511) was taken away at gunpoint on Orangefield Road. The suspect was described as a man of fair complexion wearing a grey hoodie. The stolen vehicle was subsequently recovered by law enforcement at Palm Drive, Enterprise.

Headline: Robbery with Aggravation: 60-Year-Old Man Robbed of $45K Gold Chain and Cellphone at San Fernando Barbershop
Summary: A robbery with aggravation occurred at a barbershop on Coffee Street, San Fernando, Southern Division, around 8:00 p.m. on Saturday, December 13, 2025. A 60-year-old man from San Fernando was confronted and robbed by two gunmen of African descent. The suspects stole a Gold Cocoa Head Bera valued at $45,000 TTD and the victim's cellphone.

Headline: Two Brothers Suffering From Fatal Brain Disorder Allegedly Assaulted by Uncle With Iron in Barrackpore
Summary: Shakir Singh and his brother, both of whom suffer from the degenerative condition Huntington’s Chorea, were reportedly attacked by their uncle at their Somai Trace home. The victims were allegedly beaten with a clothes iron while one was seated and the other lay in a hammock, prompting a police investigation into the violent family assault.

Headline: Deadly Afternoon Ambush: Micah Annisette Dies, Two Injured in Drive-by Shooting in Sangre Grande
Street Address: Sand Road, Sangre Chiquito, Sangre Grande
Location: HV7W+QJC Sangre Chiquito, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: One person, Annisette (age not specified), was shot and killed instantly when three masked, high-powered gunmen ambushed a white Toyota Axio they were traveling in around 3:30 p.m. on Friday, December 12, 2025, in Sangre Chiquito. The gunmen, who emerged from an oncoming vehicle, fired multiple rounds, riddling the Axio's windscreen with bullets. The victim died at the scene.

Headline: Woman Robbed of Gold Chain by Assailants at Macaulay Park West
Summary: A woman (age not specified) was the victim of a robbery at Macaulay Park West, California, on Friday, December 12, 2025. Assailants, who had parked a vehicle on a nearby street, approached the woman and forcibly removed her gold chain before fleeing the scene in the waiting car. No injuries were reported. Police have been notified, and investigations are ongoing.

Headline: Bandits carry out daylight home invasion in Elizabeth Gardens
Location: MH5J+QF3 St Joseph, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Four bandits carried out a daring daylight home invasion between 1:30 p.m. and 2 p.m. in Elizabeth Gardens, St Joseph. The men entered the home of a young couple and their children, ransacked the premises, and fled in a white Nissan AD Wagon. No one was injured during the incident, and police are currently searching for the suspects.

Headline: Shooting Incident in Arima: Suspect Opens Fire on Two Victims in Vehicle in Wallerfield
Street Address: Blue Stone Extension, Demerara Heights, Wallerfield
Summary: A shooting with intent was reported in the Arima Police District on the night of Friday, December 12, 2025. Around 11:00 p.m., victims Jermelia Hazel (33) and Shorn Henry (41) were parked in their white Wingroad Wagon (PCX 2153) along Blue Stone Extension, Demerara Heights, Wallerfield. A man known to the victims, identified as Sheldon John, approached with an object resembling a firearm. After a confrontation, two loud explosions were heard. Although no injuries were sustained, two 9mm spent casings were recovered.

Headline: Robbery at Movie Towne Carpark: Elderly Couple Robbed of Handbag, Cash, and iPhone by Armed Suspects
Street Address: Movie Towne Underground Carpark, Invaders Bay
Location: MF59+95V Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A daylight armed robbery occurred at the underground carpark of Movie Towne, Invaders Bay, Port of Spain, on Friday, November 12, 2025, around 1:38 p.m. An elderly couple, a 63-year-old woman and a 71-year-old man, were approached by two armed suspects shortly after parking their white Hyundai Santa Fe. The suspects stole the woman’s navy blue leather handbag containing cash, keys, ID documents, and a dark blue iPhone. The assailants fled the scene in a dark blue Nissan Note (registration unknown).

Headline: Robbery with Aggravation in Diego Martin: 24-Year-Old Slashed and Robbed of $24K in Gold Chains
Location: PCHQ+FM9 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A serious robbery with aggravation occurred in Diego Martin, Western Division, around 8:15 p.m. on Friday, December 12, 2025. A 24-year-old man (name not specified) was confronted by two men of African descent along Mason Street. The victim was slashed on his right hand by one of the assailants while they stole his two gold chains, valued together at $24,000 TTD.

Headline: Street Robbery in Diamond Vale: 23-Year-Old Woman Robbed of Cash, iPhone, and Bank Cards
Location: PC8R+Q3W Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A street robbery occurred in Diamond Vale, Diego Martin, Western Division, around 2:00 p.m. on Friday, December 12, 2025. A 23-year-old woman (name not specified) was walking along Sapphire Drive when a silver-colored wagon (PDL) approached and stopped. A man of East Indian descent exited the vehicle and forcibly stole her property, including $300 TTD in cash, an iPhone, bank cards, and her lunch kit. The wagon was reportedly driven by a woman of African descent.

Headline: Hitchhiking bandit launches bloody attack on police officer
Street Address: Coalmine area, near a Hindu temple
Location: HVV9+9G2 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A police officer driving his white H100 vehicle in the Coalmine area was severely assaulted after picking up a hitchhiker who requested a lift. Near a Hindu temple, the suspect pulled a chopper, announced a hold-up, and struck the officer multiple times, causing injuries to his face, head, shoulder, and hand. The officer managed to escape and drive to the Sangre Grande Police Station before being taken to the hospital for medical attention.

Headline: Man, 70, attacked and robbed near US Embassy (70)
Street Address: Queen’s Park Savannah, near US Embassy, Marli Street
Location: MF8M+7FF Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 70-year-old man was robbed of his gold chain, valued at $3,000, while walking along the Queen’s Park Savannah on Friday evening. Around 6:35 p.m., two suspects, described as men in their twenties, accosted the victim near the US Embassy. The suspects held the victim in an arm-lock, stole the chain, and then escaped in a burgundy Suzuki Fronx motor vehicle.

Headline: Looter caught on tape clearing out doctor's apartment (35)
Location: MF6Q+CM9 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 35-year-old doctor reported a larceny after discovering numerous household items missing from her unsecured apartment on Pembroke Street. The theft, which occurred between December 6 and December 12, involved the removal of chairs, tables, coffee makers, bedding, and cleaning supplies. The victim has provided police with cellphone camera footage allegedly showing the suspect removing the stolen items.

Headline: One-eyed suspect leads home invasion and robbery (32)
Location: RWGX+RMR Grande Riviere, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 32-year-old victim was bound with belts and robbed of a $40,000 gold chain and a cellphone during a home invasion on Paria Main Road, Grand Riviere. The crime was reportedly spearheaded by an 18-year-old suspect identifiable by his missing left eye.

Headline: Police seize firearm and ammunition following Grande Riviere robbery
Location: R3P6+6WM Petit Trou, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Following the home invasion, police established checkpoints along the Toco Main Road, leading to the arrest of four suspects. During the operation, officers recovered a revolver and ammunition believed to have been used in the commission of the crime.

Headline: Armed Robbers Hit Dow Village Fast Food Outlet, Steal Cash and Phones from Staff and Customer
Summary: Two women staff members and a customer at Sharon’s Gyros, a popular eatery at #98 Dow Village South, were held up and robbed by two armed men in the early hours of Thursday, December 11, 2025, around 12:40 a.m. One suspect brandished a firearm while the other was armed with a knife and a firearm. The robbers stole a quantity of cash and electronics, specifically mentioning a Samsung S23 Ultra, an iPhone X, and a Samsung S21. The suspects escaped in a silver Fielder wagon, heading toward Mon Desir Junction.

Headline: Masked Gunmen Tie Up, Rob Chaguanas Family of Three in Violent Home Invasion
Summary: Police are investigating a violent home invasion in Chaguanas that occurred around 9:00 p.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025. A maxi taxi driver, his wife, and their 15-year-old child were confronted by three masked men, one armed with a firearm, as the driver attempted to exit his home. The suspects tied the hands and feet of the victims before ransacking the house. The robbers stole cell phones, laptops (including two Samsung A22 phones and two laptops), cash, and jewelry before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Housekeeper Confronts Intruder in Master Bedroom During Kelly Village House Breaking
Location: HJPM+Q3Q Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police are investigating a house breaking and theft that occurred at a duplex townhouse in Kelly Village, Caroni, on Thursday, December 11, 2025. The homeowner secured the premises around 7:15 a.m., but around 9:00 a.m., the housekeeper discovered a pried window downstairs. Upon investigating the upstairs master bedroom, she confronted a suspect who pushed past her and fled downstairs, escaping through the window. The homeowner later reported that two gold earrings valued at $1,000 were stolen from a handbag in the room.

Headline: Bursar Loses $90,000 Cash After Leaving Funds in Unattended Car in Cunupia
Street Address: Jerningham Junction Road, Marchin Road, Cunupia
Location: GJX6+WHG Jerningham Junction, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police in Cunupia are investigating a vehicle break-in and theft of $90,000 cash that occurred on Thursday, December 11, 2025, between 2:30 p.m. and 3:00 p.m. The victim, a bursar, had withdrawn the large sum from Scotia Bank at Price Plaza and secured it inside his Toyota Corolla before parking it along Jerningham Junction Road, Marchin Road, Cunupia. Upon returning, he discovered the vehicle was broken into and the cash stolen.

Headline: Courier (75) Robbed of $13,000 Cash by Armed Bandits in Barataria
Location: JHQ2+433 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 75-year-old courier was the victim of an armed robbery in Barataria around 8:45 a.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025, shortly after returning from a bank transaction in San Juan. Two men in dark clothing, one armed with a firearm, exited a silver Nissan Tiida and confronted the victim. One suspect cuffed the courier in the face before they stole an envelope containing $13,000 in cash. The suspects fled in the Nissan Tiida along Chootoo Road. Police later recovered the getaway vehicle, registered as PDJ 6595, in the Beverly Hills area and determined it was stolen in Gasparillo on December 10.

Headline: Woman alleges unlawful detention and sexual assault by boyfriend (22)
Location: MFG5+35X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 22-year-old woman reported that she visited her boyfriend's apartment on John Street, Cocorite on December 11th, 2025 around 8:00 p.m. When she attempted to leave later that night around 11:00 p.m., she was allegedly prevented from doing so after the man locked all doors and windows, trapping her inside.||The woman stated that over the following period, she made multiple attempts to escape but was unable to do so as she had no access to keys and was physically restrained whenever she tried to exit. During her unlawful detention, she alleged that she was sexually assaulted by the man without her consent.||Police are currently investigating the allegations and the circumstances surrounding the incident.

Headline: Police Seize Massive TT$56M Cannabis Shipment in Point Fortin; No Arrests Made
Summary: The Trinidad and Tobago Police Service (TTPS) seized an estimated TT$56 million worth of illegal cannabis in a major intelligence-led operation conducted on Thursday, December 11, 2025, in the Point Fortin district. Officers recovered 23 bales of marijuana from a remote, forested location off South Central Road, Cap-De-Ville, an area known for contraband and human-smuggling. Commissioner of Police Allister Guevarro stated that this seizure, along with a recent $117 million bust in the Caroni Swamp, means police removed 2.2 tonnes of marijuana from circulation within a 24-hour period. No arrests were made during the Cap-De-Ville operation.

Headline: One Armed Home Invader Killed by Police in Morvant Following Pre-Dawn Robbery
Location: JGVM+HQ5 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A large home invasion and robbery occurred at a Barataria residence around 3:10 a.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025, when seven armed intruders confronted two men returning home, forced them inside, and robbed multiple family members of cash, electronics, jewelry, and gaming consoles. Police responded and observed men running into a drain. During the attempt to apprehend them, one suspect, later identified as Antonio of Malick, pointed a firearm at officers, who then discharged their weapons. The suspect was pronounced dead at the hospital at 4:06 a.m. Three other suspects (ages 18 to 23) were arrested, and a firearm and ammunition were recovered at the scene.

Headline: Company Driver (47) Robbed of $40,000 Day's Sales at St. James Gas Station
Location: MFG4+2HQ Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police are investigating a daylight robbery that occurred around 3:07 p.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025, in St. James. A 47-year-old man was pumping gas into a white Nissan Caravan company vehicle at Peake’s One Stop when he was approached from behind by two suspects. One suspect pointed an object at the victim's waist while the other entered the vehicle and stole $40,000 in cash, representing the company's day's sales. The suspects then fled the scene.

Headline: Belmont Man (63) Tied Up, Beaten, and Robbed by Intruders; One Suspect Wore Santa Claus Mask
Location: MF9V+H28 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 63-year-old man was the victim of a late-night home invasion and robbery at his Archer Street, Belmont home around 10:00 p.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025. Three intruders entered the open front door, immediately bound the victim, beat him, and ransacked the house. The robbers stole his wallet (containing his ID and debit card) and a black Samsung A06 cellphone valued at $1,300. The victim later freed himself to report the incident. One of the suspects was notably described as wearing a Santa Claus mask and a red-and-white jersey.

Headline: $10,000 stolen from cargo truck vault
Street Address: Lohas Supermarket, Chin Chin Road, Cunupia
Summary: A midday theft occurred in Cunupia when $10,000 was stolen from a company cargo truck vault after a delivery run. The driver returned to the truck, parked near Lohas Supermarket on Chin Chin Road, to find the vault open and half the day's sales missing. Police officers visited the scene and are currently reviewing nearby CCTV footage.

Headline: Massive $171 Million Marijuana Stash Seized in Caroni Swamp
Location: HGVV+CX4 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police seized 1,560 kilogrammes of 'creepy marijuana' with an estimated street value of $171,205,320 during a raid in the Caroni Swamp on Wednesday night. Officers used a boat to access the stash, but no arrests were made as the suspects reportedly fled upon hearing the approaching vessel.

Headline: Theft of Motor Vehicle: White Nissan AD Wagon (PDB 8677) Stolen in El Socorro
Location: JHV2+RXJ San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A case of theft of a motor vehicle occurred along Mary Lane, El Socorro, North Eastern Division, around 4:45 a.m. on Thursday, December 11, 2025. A white Nissan AD Wagon (PDB 8677) was stolen from the location.

Headline: Three Men Shot in Chatham Attack; 42-year-old Labourer Left Critical After Six Gunshot Wounds
Summary: Three men were injured in a shooting attack in Chatham, Point Fortin, on the night of December 10, 2025. Around 42-year-old labourer of Belleview Road, a 35-year-old driller of Chatham Beach Road, and a 41-year-old labourer of Iros Forest were liming near the Chatham Junction when they heard multiple loud explosions. The 42-year-old victim received six gunshot injuries to his lower back, abdomen, and buttocks and was left in critical condition, requiring emergency surgery. The driller (35) was shot in his left hand, and the Iros Forest labourer (41) was shot in his left leg; the driller was later discharged. Police investigations are ongoing, and 12 spent nine-millimetre shells were recovered at the scene.

Headline: TTPS Seizes 7.62mm Ammunition During ‘Operation Festive Shield’ Exercise in Couva
Summary: During Operation Festive Shield exercises conducted between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. on Wednesday, December 10, 2025, officers from the Couva Foot Patrol and Crime Patrol Units searched an abandoned house on Anand Yankaran Extension, Couva. They recovered and seized 27 rounds of 7.62mm ammunition. No arrests were reported in connection with the seizure. Additionally, officers issued 20 fixed penalty notices in Couva and eight in Cunupia for various traffic violations, including not having a Certificate of Inspection and not wearing a seatbelt.

Headline: Man bound and robbed of $19,000 cash and phone in Cunupia
Street Address: Bholia Trace Extension, Munroe Road, Cunupia
Location: HH6W+X8M Munroe Settlement, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man leaving his home on Tuesday morning was violently robbed by three suspects, two of whom are believed to be Venezuelan nationals. The robbers demanded cash, bound the victim's hands with a tie strap, and fled with $19,000 in cash and a Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra cellphone.

Headline: Woman abducted, raped near dump after wedding ring taken (57)
Summary: A 57-year-old woman was robbed of jewelry and cell phones after entering a car at a traffic light in Vistabella. The suspect subsequently kidnapped her, driving to Cedar Hill Road where he sexually assaulted her, before she managed to jump from the moving vehicle near the Claxton Bay overpass to seek help.

Headline: Elderly taxi driver (72) abducted and held in car trunk
Summary: Following a violent robbery, two suspects tied the hands of a 72-year-old taxi driver near Circle Drive, Embacadere. The men then forced the victim into the trunk of his own white Nissan Tiida and drove off, before later releasing him, allowing residents to take him to the police station.

Headline: Apartment looted of everything in ten hours (Resident)
Summary: Police are investigating a massive house breaking and larceny after a resident returned home Tuesday afternoon to find her apartment completely emptied. The intruder entered through a northern side door between 5 a.m. and 2:30 p.m., stealing major appliances, including a fridge ($13,000), two washing machines ($23,000), a dryer ($7,000), and various furniture and electronics. The total value of the stolen items is yet to be fully determined.

Headline: Pilot loses $125,000 after Land Cruiser smashed open (36)
Location: JGWJ+3F9 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 36-year-old helicopter pilot reported the theft of $125,000 in cash and a manager’s cheque from his Toyota Land Cruiser parked at Maritime Centre. The victim had parked the vehicle around 12:15 p.m. and returned at 2 p.m. to find the front left window smashed and the glove compartment open. A dash cam valued at USD $250 was also stolen during the incident.

Headline: Security inspector loses service pistol after giving hitch-hiker a ride
Street Address: Abalone Circular near Triton Avenue, Bon Air Gardens
Summary: A security inspector reported the theft of his Sig Sauer P250 service pistol, along with one magazine containing 10 rounds of 9mm ammunition valued at $7,500. The theft occurred yesterday afternoon after the inspector offered a lift to a man he knew while driving along Abalone Circular. The inspector discovered the items missing from his black one-strap bag upon returning home after dropping the passenger off near the University of the West Indies.

Headline: 102-year-old woman and daughters victims in Santa Cruz home invasion
Location: MH92+M86 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Three armed suspects invaded a home in Lower Santa Cruz, tying up four occupants, including a 102-year-old dementia patient, her two daughters (aged 72 and 77), and two caregivers. The intruders ransacked the residence, stealing $2,500 cash, assorted jewellery, an iPhone 12 ($2,400 TT), and an iPhone 12 Mini before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Firearm Seizure: Loaded Pistol Recovered in Central Division Operation
Summary: During an anti-crime exercise conducted by the Longdenville Police Post between 9:00 p.m. and midnight on Monday, December 8, 2025, officers recovered a loaded pistol and one round of ammunition on Cemetery Street. The discovery was made after a male suspect tossed the object into the bushes and fled the scene upon seeing the police. No arrest was immediately made in connection with the firearm.

Headline: Drug Arrests: Two Men (23) Held for Cannabis and Cocaine Possession
Summary: Officers of the Princes Town Criminal Investigations Department arrested two 23-year-old men during an exercise conducted between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. on Monday, December 8, 2025. Based on intelligence, the men, who are residents of Princes Town and California, were arrested for Possession of Cannabis and Possession of Cocaine in the Southern Division.

Headline: Chaguanas taxi driver carjacked by armed suspects (64)
Street Address: Caroni Savannah Road, near Newaj Rustam Road, Chaguanas
Summary: A 64-year-old taxi driver was overpowered and carjacked by three armed men on Monday evening around 6:55 p.m. The suspects stopped the silver Nissan Almera, and the rear-seat passenger pointed a firearm at the driver and began choking him before announcing the robbery. The driver managed to exit the vehicle and flee while the suspects drove off in his car.

Headline: Pastor (68) shot during $119,400 robbery, cell phone stops bullet
Street Address: Boundary Road, near Aranguez North Secondary School, Aranguez
Location: JHR2+3Q2 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 68-year-old businessman and pastor was robbed at gunpoint around 8:30 a.m. while depositing $100,400 cash and $19,000 in cheques. During a struggle with the armed suspect, the victim was shot in the right thigh, but his iPhone 7, located in his front pocket, was struck by the projectile, potentially mitigating the injury.

Headline: Diego Martin resident scammed out of $4,300 in fake gold chain purchase
Location: PC5Q+VP7 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A Diego Martin resident was defrauded of $4,300 after purchasing a fake gold chain advertised on Facebook Marketplace. The buyer met with the seller's representative on Tuesday to complete the transaction, paying the full amount after a quick test. The following day, the chain was confirmed fake at a Port of Spain pawn center, and the incident was subsequently reported to the West End Police Station.

Headline: Cop, man arrested in Caroni gun case
Location: JJ48+4H9 Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A police constable and a civilian were arrested in the Caroni district on charges related to illegal firearms and ammunition possession. The officer was charged with transferring his service Glock 48 pistol and 9mm ammunition, as well as unauthorized use of TTPS equipment, while the civilian was charged with possessing the transferred items.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Pastor and Businessman (68) Shot, $119,400 Stolen
Street Address: Boundary Road near Aranguez North Secondary School
Location: JHQ2+XQ6 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 68-year-old pastor and businessman was the victim of a violent armed robbery and shooting around 8:30 a.m. on Monday, December 8, 2025, near the Aranguez North Secondary School. The victim, attempting to deposit funds for Real Tuff Builders Outlet Limited, was approached by an armed man in a reflective vest. During a struggle for the bag, the pastor was shot in the right thigh. The assailant escaped with the bag containing $100,400 in cash and $19,000 in cheques, totaling $119,400. The victim received medical treatment at a private hospital.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: Man (64) Choked and Robbed, Vehicle Recovered
Location: GHXM+CW4 St Charles, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 64-year-old man was the victim of an armed carjacking around 6:55 p.m. on Monday after stopping for three male suspects, described as Hispanic, along Caroni Savannah Road. Once inside his silver Nissan Almera, one suspect choked the victim with a gun while announcing a robbery. The man managed to escape, and while the suspects fled with the vehicle, it was later found abandoned on Cumberbatch Street.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Stolen Nissan Tiida Recovered, Two Suspects Arrested
Location: MH3H+CCF San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police conducted a successful operation in the North Central Division on Monday, December 8, 2025, resulting in the recovery of a stolen vehicle and the arrest of two suspects. Officers intercepted a silver Nissan Tiida (PCZ 405) on Hutton Street, St. Joseph, shortly after it was reported stolen from Tacarigua. The arrested suspects were identified as Isaiah Wanzer (23) and Anthony Stewart (22).

Headline: Armed Carjacking: PH Driver (72) Robbed of $135K Toyota Fielder
Street Address: Trincity Central Road, near Republic Bank
Summary: Two young men, aged 22 and 19, were arrested following a violent carjacking in Trincity on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The victim, a 72-year-old PH taxi driver, was robbed of his silver Toyota Fielder Wagon, valued at approximately $135,000 TTD, after the passenger seated behind him choked his neck and ordered him out of the vehicle. Police later recovered the stolen car near the Tacarigua Community Centre.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Pearl White Nissan Tiida Stolen
Summary: A pearl white Nissan Tiida with registration number PCX 8414 was reported stolen sometime between 9:30 p.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025, and 3:08 a.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The vehicle theft was witnessed after a man was seen near the car, which was soon after driven away.

Headline: Deadly Domestic Brawl in Moruga: Brian Figaro (45) Struck in Head by Elder Brother
Summary: On Monday, December 8, 2025, around 1:00 a.m., Brian Figaro (45) was involved in a violent altercation with his elder brother, Serviles Figaro (59), in the Moruga apartment they shared. During the dispute, Serviles allegedly struck Brian in the back of the head with a baton, causing a severe wound. Family members noted that Brian refused medical treatment and did not report the assault to the police.

Headline: Woman slain in Pranz Gardens murder-suicide (Angel Lutchman, 42)
Summary: Angel Lutchman, 42, was found dead inside her home on Abraham Street with her throat slit. Police believe her partner, Shazard Mohammed, killed her sometime during the night before dying by suicide. The discovery was made by Lutchman’s 13-year-old son.

Headline: Princes Town area Honda City stolen
Summary: A Honda City was stolen from the Princes Town area on December 8, 2025. No additional details about the suspect or circumstances were provided.

Headline: Ramlochan Drive man shot dead around 1am on Mon, (Kevon Phillip)
Street Address: Ramlochan Drive, Caroni South Bank Road
Location: HJMW+JXG Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An unidentified man was shot dead at Ramlochan Drive, Caroni around 1am on Monday, December 8th, 2025.

Headline: Man non-verbal after suffering multiple injuries (Errol McIntyre, 60)
Summary: Errol McIntyre, 60, was brought into the Siparia District Health Facility on Sunday night after sustaining multiple injuries to his head and left hand. Police officers investigating the incident reported that McIntyre was non-verbal and could not explain how he received the injuries, leading to his transfer to San Fernando General Hospital.

Headline: Suspects held for illegal drugs in Princes Town
Summary: During an anti-crime exercise in the Southern Division on December 8, police arrested two 23-year-old men for possession of illegal drugs. The suspects, one from Princes Town and one from California, were held after officers conducted comprehensive searches for narcotics and illegal guns.

Headline: Loaded gun recovered in Central Division
Summary: Officers of the Longdenville Police Post recovered a loaded pistol during an exercise conducted late on December 8 in the Central Division. Police found the weapon, loaded with one round of ammunition, in bushes on Cemetery Street after witnessing a man toss the object and run off.

Headline: Wife survives house fire after husband threatens to burn home (Asha Norman, 48)
Summary: A 48-year-old woman, Asha Norman, was endangered when her husband, Amarnath Ramnarinesingh, threatened to burn down their home in Princes Town around 5:45 p.m. Sunday. The subsequent blaze gutted the two-storey house and destroyed a parked vehicle, resulting in the death of Ramnarinesingh, whose remains were found near the staircase. Police are investigating the incident, as the husband reportedly suffered from mental illness.

Headline: Robbers dressed as soldiers steal $7,000 from two men (19, 32)
Summary: Four armed men, disguised in Trinidad and Tobago Defence Force camouflage uniforms, stormed an apartment complex in Maloney Gardens late Monday night. The assailants ordered residents to lie down before robbing a 19-year-old man of $6,000 and a 32-year-old man of $1,000 in cash. The robbers, who identified themselves as soldiers, fled the scene in a marked vehicle resembling a TTDF unit.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Maraval Church's Chicken Robbed of Over $18,000 Cash
Street Address: Church's Chicken, Maraval Road, St. Clair
Location: MF8J+M99 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A Church's Chicken restaurant on Maraval Road, St. Clair, was the target of a daring armed robbery around 9:29 p.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025. Four men entered the business, announced a robbery, and one suspect struck the manager before forcing her to open the safe, from which they stole $18,544 in cash. The bandits also robbed two customers of their cellphones before fleeing in a waiting vehicle.

Headline: Armed Robbery: 'Fake Police' Use Blue Lights to Rob Courier Driver in Valencia
Street Address: Nearing the second round-a-bout, Valencia Bypass Road
Summary: Police are investigating a brazen daylight armed robbery that occurred around 3:50 p.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025, on the Valencia Bypass Road. A courier driver was pulled over by a heavily tinted black Nissan X-Trail fitted with flashing blue lights, leading the victim to believe the occupants were police officers. Two men, described as East Indian and wearing masks, then robbed the driver of an undisclosed sum of cash (sales from deliveries) and an iPhone 11. One suspect also slapped the victim before they fled in the X-Trail.

Headline: Burglary: Valuables Stolen from Egypt Village Home
Summary: A resident of Warner Road, Egypt Village, reported a burglary at her home, discovered around 5:00 a.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The victim found her back door open and several items missing, including a Ninja Blender System valued at $1,500 TTD, a Swiss Gear Work Bag ($420 TTD), an Amazon Kindle Fire, and a pack of lighters. Authorities noted there were no visible signs of forced entry, suggesting the intruder used an unsecured side door.

Headline: Grand Theft: $154,000 USD in Huawei Batteries Stolen from TSTT Tower
Summary: Police are investigating a case of grand theft after an estate constable discovered that seven high-value Huawei batteries, totaling $154,000 USD in value (or approximately $1,040,058.00 TTD based on standard exchange rates), were stolen from a TSTT cell tower site in Palo Seco. The theft occurred sometime between November 24 and December 7, 2025, from the secured battery cabinets at the Central Crescent, Beach Road location.

Headline: Assault with a Weapon: Two Men Stabbed After Intervening in Bar Fight
Location: JJWC+FHJ El Dorado, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two men, aged 47 and 36, both from El Dorado, were the victims of an assault with a weapon around 12:30 a.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025, while liming at Captains Bar in Tunapuna. The victims intervened in a fight and, during a struggle with one suspect, felt cuts to their necks and began bleeding. Both men were treated for their injuries at the Mt Hope Hospital.

Headline: Homicide: Tevin Diaz Shot Dead During Downpour in Enterprise
Summary: A man identified as Tevin Diaz was fatally shot and killed along Freedom Street in Enterprise on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The homicide occurred during a heavy downpour.

Headline: Homicide: Nicole Ovid (56) Found Dead on Pavement After Altercation
Location: MFC7+9GV Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police in St. James are investigating the killing of 56-year-old Nicole Ovid, whose lifeless body was discovered on a pavement near Finland Street in the early hours of Sunday, December 7, 2025. The discovery followed a report of a physical altercation between Ovid and a known man. The male suspect later walked into the police station, confirmed the altercation, and was subsequently arrested and cautioned in connection with the death.

Headline: Aggravated Assault: Bobby Sankar (39) Chopped in Sleep, Two Fingers Severed
Location: JHFC+MVF San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police are investigating a brutal aggravated assault that occurred around 2:10 a.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025, at a fruit shed on Bamboo #3 Boulevard. The victim, 39-year-old Bobby Sankar of Mt. Lambert, was chopped several times by a masked man while he slept in a chair. Sankar suffered severe injuries, including the severing of two fingers. He was transported to the EWMSC, where he was listed in critical condition.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Santa Cruz Taxi Driver Robbed of $1,050 Cash
Location: PGJC+QXM La Pastora Settlement, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A taxi driver plying the San Juan/Santa Cruz route was the victim of an armed robbery around 9:15 a.m. on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The suspect, described as a man of African descent with a kinky afro hairstyle, boarded the taxi in San Juan. While on Orange Field Road, Santa Cruz, the man placed an object on the driver's neck and stole $1,050 TTD in cash before escaping on foot. North Eastern Division Police are searching for the suspect.

Headline: Maxi-Taxi driver robbed along Priority Bus Route (42)
Street Address: Priority Bus Route (PBR), near Olton Road, Arima
Summary: A 42-year-old maxi-taxi driver was attacked and robbed by four men while driving his red-band maxi near Olton Road around 6:45 a.m. The attackers, one armed with a knife, struck the driver on the back of his head and stole $5,300 before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Chaguanas man Shakeel Darlington (age) stabbed during altercation at De Kourt bar
Summary: A man identified as Shakeel Darlington was stabbed on the hand and right thigh around 3am this morning during an altercation with a security officer at Kourts bar in Chaguanas.

Headline: Robbery with Violence: Man (43) Beaten with Iron, Cellphone Stolen in Arima A 43-year-old man was the victim of a robbery with violence while liming at O’Meara Boys bar in Arima around 1:30 p.m. on December 6th. Three suspects, each wielding pieces of iron, approached the victim, dealt him several blows about the body, and stole his Samsung J2 Pro cell phone, valued at $1,700 TTD.
Summary: A 43-year-old man was the victim of a robbery with violence while liming at O’Meara Boys bar in Arima around 1:30 p.m. on December 6th. Three suspects, each wielding pieces of iron, approached the victim, dealt him several blows about the body, and stole his Samsung J2 Pro cell phone, valued at $1,700 TTD.

Headline: Robbery with Violence: Elderly Man Robbed of Gold Chain, Cash by Group
Location: MF3V+8GW Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Moments after the initial theft on Prince Street, the same 67-year-old victim was confronted by the original suspect, now accompanied by three additional assailants. The group violently attacked the victim, ripping a gold chain valued at $6,000 TTD from his neck and stealing $120 TTD in cash from his vehicle's passenger seat before escaping.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: Gunman Steals White Nissan Pulsar in Valencia (PBM 8131)
Street Address: Outside a bar along the Valencia Old Road
Location: MV5F+V67 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man was the victim of an armed carjacking around 1:40 a.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025, outside a bar on Valencia Old Road. Two suspects, one armed with a 9mm firearm which was placed to the victim's neck, stole his vehicle keys, wallet, cellphone, and personal documents before escaping with his white Nissan Pulsar.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Silver Nissan Tiida Stolen in Woodbrook
Location: MF7G+8W4 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A silver-coloured Nissan Tiida with registration number PDA 5095 was reported stolen from Carlos Street, Woodbrook, this morning. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: White Nissan Tiida with Gold Bumper Stolen in D'abadie
Summary: A white-coloured Nissan Tiida (PDB 8245), distinctive due to its gold-coloured bumper, was reported stolen this morning from the Bon Air West area of D'abadie. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Silver Nissan Wingroad Stolen in Woodbrook
Location: MF8C+36H Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A silver-coloured Nissan Wingroad (PBX 8571) was reported stolen from Taylor Street, Woodbrook, around 12:30 a.m. on Saturday. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Financial Fraud: Taxi Driver (39) Swindled Out of $5,100 in Forex Scam
Location: JHXW+55J St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 39-year-old taxi driver from Rio Claro was reportedly the victim of financial fraud and theft on Saturday, December 6, 2025, after being hired for a trip to Port-of-Spain. The driver handed the suspect $3,600 TTD and a subsequent $1,500 TTD (totaling $5,100 TTD) for a promised exchange for U.S. currency. After taking the victim's cellphone, the suspect exited the vehicle near Massy Stores in Curepe and fled with the cash.

Headline: Major Drug Bust: $14M Marijuana Haul Found in Piarco Airport Restroom
Summary: A major drug bust was recorded after approximately $14 million TTD worth of high-grade marijuana was discovered abandoned in a restroom at the Piarco International Airport. Investigators suspect the contraband may have arrived on a North American flight sometime between Friday, December 5th, and Saturday, December 6th, 2025.

Headline: Robbery: Man (67) Has $9,000 Wristband Snatched in Port-of-Spain
Location: MF3V+8GW Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 67-year-old man from Morvant was the victim of a snatch-and-grab robbery around 8:30 a.m. on December 6, 2025, on Prince Street in Port-of-Spain. As the victim returned to his vehicle, a suspect yanked a wristband valued at $9,000 off his left wrist before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Larceny: 'Kleptomaniac Kyle King' Steals Projector and TV Box in Chaguanas
Street Address: Mubarak Aleem Marketing Ltd in Bally's Plaza
Summary: Police are investigating a case of larceny that occurred around 1:12 p.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025, at Mubarak Aleem Marketing Ltd in Bally's Mall, Chaguanas. A known thief identified as Kyle King entered the establishment and stole a projector and a programmable TV box before fleeing. Police are seeking public assistance to locate King and recover the stolen items.

Headline: Drive-by Shooting: Man (20) Injured in Black Almera Attack
Summary: A 20-year-old man from Lamont Street was injured in a drive-by shooting around 1:30 a.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025. While traveling south in a white Nissan Almera, the victim's vehicle was approached by a black Nissan Almera, whose occupants opened fire. The victim sustained a gunshot wound to his right leg and was transferred to the EWMSC for treatment.

Headline: Attempted Burglary: Penal Welder (27) Fired Upon, Three Suspects Arrested
Summary: A 27-year-old welder, Sanjeev Roopchan, was the victim of an attempted burglary and shooting at his home on Mohess Road, Penal, around 1:00 p.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025. Roopchan was awakened by barking dogs and confronted three intruders in his yard. While Roopchan pursued them in his car, the suspects fired a shot at him near the Mathura Development Bridge. Police, with Roopchan's assistance, intercepted the suspects' getaway vehicle (a white Kia Optima) and arrested Anderson Taylor (28), Kerton Edwards (37), and Brandon Travis Khan (26).

Headline: Attempted Robbery: Jamir Daniel (27) Shot During Struggle with Assailant
Location: PFQ5+9M3 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 27-year-old resident, Jamir Daniel, is recovering after being shot during an attempted robbery at his home on Blue Basin Road on Saturday night, December 6, 2025. Around 10:05 p.m., Daniel was confronted by two unknown men, one armed with a firearm, who demanded entry to his home. A struggle ensued, during which a shot was fired, striking Daniel under his right arm. The suspects fled, and Daniel was transported to the Westshore Accident and Emergency Department for treatment.

Headline: Robbery: Mini Mart Proprietor (76) Assaulted, Cash and Goods Stolen in St. James
Street Address: Edward’s Mini Mart, corner of Bombay and Jameson Street, St James
Location: MFH9+M4H Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 76-year-old proprietor of Edward’s Mini Mart in St. James was the victim of a robbery around 10:50 a.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025. While at his establishment, he was accosted by three men. One suspect pushed the victim to the floor before the group stole several packs of cigarettes, bottles of alcohol, and a quantity of cash before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Larceny and Assault: Man Fights Police After Stealing $25 Blouse in Penal
Summary: A male suspect was arrested after committing larceny and then violently resisting arrest in Penal around 4:00 p.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025. The man stole a cream-coloured blouse valued at $25 from Indira’s Fashion Store. When officers located the suspect nearby and attempted to arrest him after recovering the stolen item, he resisted violently, leading to a physical struggle where both officers and the suspect sustained minor injuries. The suspect is expected to face charges including Larceny, Assaulting Police Officers, and Resisting Arrest.

Headline: Homicide: Gabriel Simon (38) Shot Dead Outside Kelly Village Bar
Location: HJVJ+JXV Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A homicide occurred in the early hours of Saturday, December 6, 2025, when 38-year-old Gabriel Simon was shot and killed outside Safe Landing Bar in Kelly Village, Caroni. Police responded to reports of loud explosions around 2:45 a.m. and found Simon's body in the car park with gunshot wounds to his face. Investigations suggest Simon had been outside smoking after intervening in an argument involving his brother inside the bar moments earlier.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Unsecured Toyota Fielder Stolen from Port-of-Spain
Location: MF5R+W9R Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A silver-coloured Toyota Fielder with registration number PDZ 7745 was reported stolen from Henry Street, Port-of-Spain, around 2:00 a.m. on Saturday, December 6, 2025. The vehicle was reportedly unsecured at the time of the theft, with the doors open, windows down, and the engine running.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: White Toyota Fielder Stolen in Belmont
Location: MG65+P89 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white-coloured Toyota Fielder with registration number PDZ 6479 was reported stolen on Saturday night, December 6, 2025, from the Belmont area. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Steel Restaurant waitress (20) abducted and robbed by three men
Location: 7GJP+4W3, Pointe-à-Pierre Rd, San Fernando, Trinidad & Tobago
Summary: A 20-year-old waitress was abducted around 3:40 a.m. after boarding a gold Nissan Cube near Royal Castle in San Fernando, believing it was transportation home. The three male suspects diverted the vehicle to Tropical Plaza where they threatened her with a knife, stole $1,000 in earnings, and later ordered her out near the Petrotrin Roundabout.

Headline: Man kidnapped from home (Luke Rampersad)
Summary: Luke Rampersad was kidnapped from his Dow Village home around 8 p.m. after two armed men forced entry by kicking open the front door. The assailants, one armed with a long metal pipe, dragged the victim outside and forced him into a waiting vehicle. The vehicle then sped north along Seventh Street.

Headline: David Pascal (27) killed in La Horquetta shooting; Regiment ammo suspected
Street Address: Terrel’s Stop and Eat, De Freitas Boulevard, La Horquetta
Summary: David Pascal (27), an employee at Terrel’s Stop and Eat, was shot multiple times during a late-night shooting just after 11 p.m. on Saturday. He was rushed to the hospital where he succumbed to his injuries the following day. Investigators recovered spent casings stamped 'TTR,' suggesting the use of Regiment-issued ammunition.

Headline: Carenage couple missing after US$2.5m ransom demand (Derrick Tardieu, 70)
Summary: Derrick Tardieu, 70, was kidnapped from his home in Monas, Carenage, after which relatives received a voice note demanding a US$2.5 million ransom for his safe return. Police are investigating the disappearance of the couple, whose home was found ransacked.

Headline: Driver loses thousands to trickster (39)
Summary: A 39-year-old driver was defrauded of $5,100 cash and his KXD smartphone after being hired for a trip from Mayaro to Port of Spain. The suspect convinced the driver to hand over the money under the pretense of exchanging it for US currency. The suspect exited the vehicle near Massy Stores in Curepe and failed to return.

Headline: Barataria man's white Nissan Tida stolen from 1st Ave
Location: JGXW+65W San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white Nissan Tida was stolen from 1st Ave, Barataria in the early hours of Saturday, December 6, 2025. No additional details about the suspect or circumstances were provided.

Headline: San Juan man shot dead (David Patrick, 42), Man wounded by stray bullet
Street Address: King Style Bar, corner of Bridge Road and Eastern Main Road
Location: MH23+5RG San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: During the fatal shooting of Mickel Browne near King Style Bar, another man was wounded by a stray bullet to his lower back. The victim remains hospitalized following the incident.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Silver Nissan Tiida Stolen
Summary: A silver-coloured Nissan Tiida with registration number PDC 3732 has been reported stolen. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: White Nissan B12 Stolen in Aranguez
Location: JHP3+W72 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white Nissan B-12 (PBG 2534) was reported stolen from Mahelal Street in the Aranguez area. The vehicle theft occurred sometime between 7:00 p.m. on November 27, 2025, and 9:30 a.m. on December 1, 2025.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Brown Nissan Tiida with Red Bumper Stolen in Arima
Summary: A brown-coloured Nissan Tiida with a distinctive red front bumper and registration number PDK 7921 was reported stolen on Sunday night, December 30, 2025.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: Two Men Assaulted, Nissan Almera Stolen (PBU 7639)
Street Address: Diggity Road, near the Volcano Guest House
Summary: A violent armed carjacking and assault occurred around 11:30 p.m. on Friday, December 5, 2025, on Diggity Road, Penal. Four armed suspects exited a white vehicle, beat two men about their bodies, stole an undisclosed amount of cash, and took their silver Nissan Almera, valued at approximately $25,000. Both victims sought medical treatment for their injuries.

Headline: Homicide: Mckel Browne (31) Shot Dead Outside San Juan Bar
Street Address: Outside King Style Bar, Corner of Bridge Road and Eastern Main Road
Location: MH23+5RG San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A homicide occurred on Friday night, December 5, 2025, when 31-year-old Mickel Browne was shot and killed during a brazen gun attack outside the King Style Bar in San Juan. A gunman approached Browne and his friends and opened fire, striking Browne multiple times. An off-duty police officer gave chase and discharged his firearm but the suspect escaped. Browne was pronounced dead at the hospital at 9:10 p.m.

Headline: Burglary: Air Rifle and $2,000 Cash Stolen from Tobago Retiree
Summary: A burglary was reported at the Piggot Street, Scarborough, Tobago, home of a 77-year-old retiree. The victim discovered his house broken into on Friday, December 5, 2025. Thieves stole a Magnum 500 Air Rifle fitted with a scope and $2,000 TTD in cash.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Waitress, 20, Robbed at Kinfepoint in Fake Taxi
Summary: A 20-year-old female waitress was the victim of an armed robbery after boarding a gold Nissan Cube (PCL 1433) that was operating as a fake taxi in San Fernando around 3:40 a.m. on Friday, December 5, 2025. The vehicle contained three male suspects, who later took the victim to the Tropical Plaza Car Park in Marabella and robbed her at knifepoint of $1,000 TTD in cash. She was then dropped off at the Petrotrin roundabout.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Silver Nissan Tiida Stolen in St. Helena
Location: HMG4+2M3 St Helena, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A silver-coloured Nissan Tiida with registration number HCR 9153 was reported stolen on Thursday night, December 4, 2025, from the St. Helena area. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Assault: Man (35) Violently Stabbed and Robbed in Port-of-Spain Restaurant
Location: JFXR+RHV Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 35-year-old man from Morvant was the victim of a violent assault and stabbing by a group of four men at a Chinese Restaurant on Independence Square, Port-of-Spain, around 9:30 p.m. on Friday, December 5th. The attack, stemming from a prior dispute over a cup, saw the victim struck on the head and attacked with bottles and chairs. The assailant known as "Moses" stabbed the victim three times in the upper chest. During the assault, the victim's dark grey Samsung A05 cell phone was also stolen. The injured man was subsequently treated at the Port of Spain General Hospital.

Headline: Financial Crime: Teen (16) Detained with Nine Counterfeit $100 Bills
Summary: A 16-year-old boy from Penal was detained by officers of the San Fernando Police Station after being allegedly found in possession of counterfeit currency. Around 8:05 p.m. on Friday, December 5, 2025, the teen voluntarily handed over nine (9) counterfeit TT$100 bills to officers at the station. He was subsequently taken to the Oropouche Police Station as investigations into the financial crime are ongoing.

Headline: Powder Magazine Man (22) Defrauded of $6,000 TTD Attempting to Buy iPhone 17 Online
Location: MCHW+M5P Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 22-year-old man from Powder Magazine reported being defrauded after attempting to purchase an iPhone 17 online. Around 4:54 p.m. on Friday, December 5, 2025, the victim deposited $6,000 TTD into a Republic Bank account at the West Moorings branch as payment for the advertised smartphone. Following the deposit, the victim never received the device and was unable to recover his funds.

Headline: Homicide: Drive-by Shooting Victim Dies of Injuries Weeks Later
Location: FG6F+P9W Orange Valley, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in the Couva area on November 20 has tragically succumbed to his injuries, elevating the incident to a homicide. The victim, 45-year-old Vishram Polay, was seated outside a bar when two armed occupants of a silver Nissan Tiida (PDS-1732) opened fire. Polay was rushed to the hospital but died on Thursday, December 4.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Car Stolen from Driveway in Las Lomas

Summary: A woman in the Cumuto area was awakened by an alarm around 2:36 a.m. on Thursday, December 4, after two masked men smashed the rear window of her parked SUV in an attempt to enter the vehicle. CCTV footage showed the suspects fleeing the scene. The damage to the vehicle is estimated at $18,000.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Car Stolen from Driveway in Morvant (PDZ 2433)
