CCTV footage showed the suspects fleeing the scene. The damage to the vehicle is estimated at $18,000.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Green Nissan Almera Stolen from Secured Yard (PBX 8461)
Summary: A woman in the Cumuto area was awakened by an alarm around 2:36 a.m. on Thursday, December 4, after two masked men smashed the rear window of her parked SUV in an attempt to enter the vehicle. CCTV footage showed the suspects fleeing the scene. The damage to the vehicle is estimated at $18,000.

Headline: Homicide: Man Killed in Enterprise Shooting (Shakeem Breedy)
Street Address: Chinese Drive off Mano Trace, Crown Street, Enterprise
Summary: A man, known only by the alias "Wet Money," was the victim of a homicide following a shooting incident around 9:00 p.m. in the Enterprise area. This fatal event occurred near the site of a previous killing in the same district, and authorities are actively investigating the circumstances.

Headline: Shooting Assault: Woman Injured in Enterprise Incident
Street Address: Chinese Drive off Mano Trace, Crown Street, Enterprise
Summary: A woman sustained injuries during a shooting incident that occurred around 9:00 p.m. in the Enterprise area. The victim was near the scene where a man was killed, but she is currently listed in stable condition at the hospital.

Headline: Car Theft: Woman Narrowly Escapes Injury as Thief Steals Car
Street Address: Agnes Street near Modern Electrical Supplies Limited, Marabella
Summary: A woman was forced to jump from a moving vehicle in the Marabella area after a thief stole the car while she was still inside. The incident occurred around 2:12 p.m. on Thursday when the criminal, wearing a mask and a hoodie, entered the driver's door of the idling silver Nissan Latio (PDZ 5577) and drove off. The victim narrowly escaped injury by tumbling out of the vehicle as the car sped away.

Headline: Violent Robbery: Doubles Vendor Attacked and Tied Up in Penal Home
Summary: A 50-year-old self-employed doubles vendor in Penal was the victim of a violent armed robbery inside her ground-floor home around 2:45 p.m. on Thursday. Two men, both armed with cutlasses, entered her kitchen, struck the victim multiple times, tied her hands, and covered her eyes and mouth before stealing $2,800 in cash, representing the day's business earnings.

Headline: Corner Store Robbery: Thief Steals Cash and Knife
Summary: A corner store in the La Romaine area was the target of a robbery around 10:30 a.m. on Thursday. A suspect entered the shop, announced a robbery, and ransacked the cash register, managing to steal only $40 in cash and a silver-colored knife before fleeing the scene.

Headline: Attempted Robbery: Suspect Steals $20 Scissors from Shop
Summary: Just five minutes after the first incident, the same suspect committed a second crime at a nearby shop on Alice Street in La Romaine. The thief announced a robbery and stole a pair of red-and-black handle scissors valued at $20, before fleeing again after the shop owner raised an alarm.

Headline: Armed Robbery and Shooting: Man Critically Wounded, $30,000 Stolen
Location: JPR7+QX6, Sorzano St, Arima, Trinidad & Tobago
Summary: A man was the victim of a violent armed robbery and shooting around 11:05 a.m. in the Arima area, leaving him in critical condition. Three men confronted the victim, struck him multiple times, and stole $30,000 in cash. While attempting to flee, the victim was shot in the lower back. He was later transported to a health facility by a passerby.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: Couple Robbed, $260,000 Toyota Yaris Stolen
Street Address: Outside Yousef Gyro, Eastern Main Road
Location: MG2R+53X San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A couple was the victim of a violent armed robbery and carjacking around 8:05 p.m. in the San Juan area. Three suspects in an unknown vehicle targeted the couple outside a restaurant, where two armed men held them up. The criminals stole a gold chain valued at $1,600 and forcibly removed the female passenger before stealing the silver and black Toyota Yaris Cross (PEG 1226), valued at $260,000, which also contained an iPhone 12 valued at $8,000.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: $60,000 Cash Stolen in Staged Collision Robbery
Summary: A 42-year-old Arouca man was the victim of an armed carjacking and robbery around 4:45 p.m. on Thursday in the Tacarigua area, which police suspect was a staged collision. After his black Nissan Tiida was struck from behind by a white Toyota Axio, an armed passenger from the Axio pointed a gun at the victim and stole his vehicle, a gold chain valued at $13,000, and $60,000 in cash. Although the stolen Nissan Tiida was later recovered, the money and jewelry remain missing.

Headline: Vandalism and Attempted Theft: SUV Window Smashed in Cumuto
Summary: A woman in the Cumuto area was awakened by an alarm around 2:36 a.m. on Thursday, December 4, after two masked men smashed the rear window of her parked SUV in an attempt to enter the vehicle. CCTV footage showed the suspects fleeing the scene. The damage to the vehicle is estimated at $18,000.

Headline: Larceny: Cash and Jewelry Stolen from Unlocked Vehicle in Caroni
Location: HJQM+V69 Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police are investigating a larceny report after a vehicle parked overnight at an apartment complex in Kelly Village, Caroni, was broken into. The owner reported that $4,000 in cash and jewelry was stolen, noting the vehicle had been left unlocked.

Headline: Man wakes to find his parrots being carted off in wheelbarrow (Gary Martin, 39)
Street Address: Dow Village South, near S.M. Jaleel car park, Oropouche
Summary: Gary Martin, 39, reported a larceny from his dwelling in Dow Village South late Thursday night after he was awakened by barking dogs. Thieves ripped open a secured enclosure and stole a brush cutter, a wheelbarrow, and two Amazon parrots valued at $1,200. Martin observed a relative pushing the stolen items in the wheelbarrow near the S.M. Jaleel car park before the suspect fled.

Headline: Rancho Quemado businessman chopped and robbed outside home
Summary: A businessman was attacked and robbed outside his home around 9:15 p.m. by two armed men, one wielding a cutlass and the other a firearm. The victim was struck several times by the cutlass-wielding suspect before the men stole $5,000 in cash and keys representing the day’s business sales.

Headline: Attempted Break-in: Suspects Try to Force Gate Lock
Location: MG2M+RM4 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two men were captured on video around 1:48 a.m. attempting an unsuccessful break-in at a residence. The suspects were seen lurking, checking for cameras, and using a crowbar in an attempt to break the gate lock to gain entry.

Headline: Armed Home Invasion and Carjacking: Retired Man Assaulted and Trapped in Trunk
Summary:
A violent armed home invasion and carjacking occurred around midnight on Wednesday, targeting a 63-year-old retired man in his Signal Hill residence. 
Two intruders, one armed with a firearm, assaulted and beat the victim, then bound his hands and mouth with duct tape. 
The criminals forced the man into the trunk of his own black Nissan X-Trail (PBX 4785) before driving him to the Bacolet area, where they expelled him from the vehicle and fled with the stolen SUV.

Headline: Foreign Exchange Fraud: Business Owner Swindled Out of $28,000
Location: MFC7+XVM Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A business owner in the St. James area was the victim of a significant foreign exchange fraud after being swindled out of $28,000 TTD. The victim conducted two separate transactions with a female customer, accepting forty $100 bills believed to be $4,000 USD. A bank teller later verified that all the US notes were counterfeit. Multiple attempts to contact the female suspect have been unsuccessful.

Headline: Online Fraud: Woman Robbed of $5,250 in Black Friday Marketplace Scam
Street Address: Corner of Eastern Main Road and 4th Avenue, near Furniture House
Location: MG2R+5MJ San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 30-year-old Couva resident was the victim of an online fraud and robbery after attempting to purchase a washer and dryer advertised on Facebook Marketplace as a Black Friday deal. Around midday last Friday in the San Juan area, the victim's relative handed over $5,250 in cash to a man who claimed to be collecting payment on behalf of the seller. After the money was exchanged, all contact with the fraudulent seller was lost.

Headline: Residential Burglary: $14,445 in Electronics and Valuables Stolen
Location: MHG4+FPW San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A resident of Grand Curacaye Road, San Juan reported a residential burglary after returning home around 6:00 p.m. on Wednesday to find their apartment broken into. Thieves gained entry through a sliding window and stole approximately $14,445 TTD in valuables. The stolen items include a 47-inch LG television, a Sony PlayStation console with controllers, a Lenovo laptop, a dash camera, sneakers, and two bottles of high-value cologne. Police are investigating the break-in.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Preacher Robbed and Assaulted on Bus Route
Location: JGXX+X47 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A preacher was the victim of an armed robbery and assault while plying his maxi-taxi on the Bus Route. The suspect, a passenger, not only beat the victim but also attempted to crash the vehicle before fleeing the scene by boarding another maxi-taxi.

Headline: Burglary: Community Centre Hit, Electronics and AC Units Stolen
Street Address: Chatham Community Centre, Chatham Rd S
Summary: The Chatham Community Centre was the victim of a burglary discovered late Wednesday morning after a council member found signs of forced entry, including a broken glass door pane. The thieves stole a large quantity of government property, including two large Comfort Star air-conditioning units and a condenser, ten computers, a printer, a projector, and even a wooden door. The investigation into the theft is ongoing.

Headline: Burglary: Westmoorings Home Ransacked and Electricity Meter Stolen
Location: MCMQ+8PR Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A resident of Westmoorings returned home Wednesday night to find their house had been ransacked and broken into, with the rear backdoor lock forced open. The intruders not only searched the property but also committed an unusual act of theft, removing the electricity meter from its base. The victim is currently unaware of what other valuables were stolen during the burglary.

Headline: Theft: ‘Egg Bandit’ Steals $2,740 Worth of Eggs from Unlocked Vehicle
Street Address: Vicinity of Massy Stores, Sellier Street
Location: JHXV+HR4 St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A vehicle owner in the St. Augustine area was the victim of a straightforward theft around 12:10 p.m. on Wednesday, December 3rd. An opportunist thief stole five boxes of eggs, valued at $2,740 TTD, from the victim's Kia K2700 after the vehicle was left unlocked and unsecured near a Massy Stores location.

Headline: Theft: Man Steals Cigarettes, Alcohol, and Energy Drink
Location: HVP7+CMR Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Video footage captured a man committing theft at the Hang Fai Chinese Supermarket. The suspect was seen placing other items at the register and then requesting cigarettes from behind the counter. The thief then walked out, failing to return to pay, making off with the cigarettes, a bottle of Puncheon rum, and a Sting energy drink.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Nissan Almera Stolen from Cost Cutters, Eldorado
Location: JJWH+C63 El Dorado, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A Nissan Almera with registration number PCP 8269 has been reported stolen from the vicinity of the Cost Cutters supermarket in Eldorado. Police are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Gasparillo woman stabbed by ‘mentally ill’ man (44)
Summary: A 44-year-old woman was attacked and stabbed multiple times in her head, neck, and back by a man believed to be mentally ill while walking near the Anglican church along Caratal Road around 2 am. She reported the incident to the Gasparillo Police Station and was treated at the San Fernando General Hospital for non-life-threatening injuries.

Headline: Workplace Theft: Suspect Steals Employee Phone from Counter
Summary: Video footage captured a man committing an act of theft at a counter of Massy in La Romaine, San Fernando. The suspect was seen lurking and pretending to make an enquiry before quickly leaning over the counter and stealing an employee's cellphone.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Maxi-Taxi Driver Gun-Butted and Robbed
Location: MH2G+483 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A maxi-taxi driver was the victim of an armed robbery and physical assault along the Bus Route in Mt. Hope. A fake passenger gun-butted the driver, causing a laceration to the head, before committing the robbery and escaping in a separate maxi-taxi along the Eastern Main Road.

Headline: Armed Robbery: Pensioners and Man Robbed at Cemetery
Street Address: St Joseph public cemetery, King Street
Location: MH3M+59R St Joseph, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Three men, including two pensioners (aged 70 and 65), were the victims of an armed robbery inside the St. Joseph public cemetery around 11:30 a.m. on December 2. Three masked bandits held up the men, stealing over $1,000 cash, cellphones, IDs, and other personal documents before escaping on foot.

Headline: Violent Armed Robbery: Doubles Vendors Tied Up
Summary: Four people, including two doubles vendors and their workers, were the victims of a violent armed robbery at a private residence in Tableland around 1:30 a.m. Three masked men armed with guns and knives entered the home, tied up the victims, and ransacked the house. The criminals stole jewelry valued at over $17,000, $500 cash, cellphones, IDs, and bank cards.

Headline: Burglary: Alcohol, Cash, and Speaker Stolen in Diego Martin
Location: PCCJ+Q78 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A burglary was reported in the Diego Martin area after a resident discovered his home had been broken into while he was away on December 2. The thieves made off with an LG speaker, an undisclosed amount of cash, and a substantial quantity of alcohol, including multiple bottles of Carib, Stag, White Oak rum, Black Label rum, and Absolut Vodka, collectively valued by police at around $1,000.

Headline: Commercial Burglary: Two Men Arrested for $25,000 Tool Theft
Street Address: D. Rampersad Company Limited, Industrial Park, Couva
Summary: Two men, aged 39 and 36, both residents of the California area, were arrested in connection with a commercial burglary at D. Rampersad Company Limited in Couva. The suspects are linked to the theft of over $25,000 TTD worth of tools during the break-in, which occurred around 4:00 a.m. on Tuesday, December 2, 2025.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Blue Toyota Altis Stolen While Idling in Marabella
Summary: A blue Toyota Altis (PCJ 2076) was reported stolen from Battoo Avenue in Marabella around 9:25 a.m. on Tuesday, December 2, 2025. The vehicle theft occurred after the owner reportedly left the car idling.

Headline: Armed Carjacking: Hyundai Accent Stolen by Four Gunmen in Laventille
Location: MG29+2M2 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A light blue Hyundai Accent (PDJ 6254) was the victim of an armed carjacking around 7:45 p.m. on Tuesday, December 2, 2025, on Old St. Joseph Road in Laventille. The vehicle was violently taken away at gunpoint by four armed suspects.

Headline: Burglary: Contractor Robbed of $50,400 in Tools from Tobago Site
Street Address: Shirvan Road, near the Grafton Hotel
Summary: A 34-year-old contractor reported a burglary at a newly constructed dwelling on Shirvan Road, Grafton, after discovering that over $50,000 worth of power tools had been stolen. The contractor secured the site on Tuesday, December 2, 2025, and upon returning the next morning, found a window tampered with and numerous high-value tools missing, including a Dewalt impact drill, Makita mitre saw, and multiple battery sets.

Headline: Elderly woman (Chandra Jury, 74) found dead in Gasparillo home
Summary: Homicide detectives were called to a residence in Springlands after 74-year-old Chandra Jury was found dead on the upper floor of her home. Jury was discovered in a pool of blood shortly after 3 p.m. with visible injuries to her head and neck, prompting a murder investigation.

Headline: Enterprise woman's Suzuki Vitara stolen from Trincity Mall (46)
Street Address: East Car Park near ATM, Trincity Mall
Summary: A 46-year-old woman from Enterprise had her green Suzuki Vitara stolen from the east car park near an ATM at Trincity Mall. The SUV was parked around 6 pm, and the theft was discovered approximately 90 minutes later when the owner returned. Investigations into the vehicle theft are ongoing.

Headline: Sando man hospitalized after violent early-morning attack (Marvin Barkley)
Summary: Marvin Barkley, the partner of 63-year-old Kissoondaye Khadaroo, was hospitalized after being pelted with large stones and bottles by a group of neighborhood men around 2:30 am. The attack occurred after Barkley confronted the men who were hurling objects at his home on Lady Hailes Avenue, leaving him with an arm injury requiring a sling and drips.

Headline: Vehicle Theft: Silver Mazda Wagon Stolen Overnight
Summary: A silver Mazda Wagon (PDJ 5821) was stolen from the Mon Repos, San Fernando area during the early morning hours. Authorities are investigating the vehicle theft.

Headline: Siparia man beaten, robbed in home invasion (44)
Summary: A 44-year-old Siparia man was severely beaten and robbed during a violent home invasion around 9 pm. Four men, two armed with guns, barged into his Fyzabad Branch Road home, assaulted him when he attempted to flee, and stole $5,000 cash and his yellow B14 vehicle.

Headline: Burglary: Crosby's Music Center Hit, Over $20,000 Cash Stolen
Location: MFC9+FJ2 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Crosby’s Music Center in the St. James area was the target of a burglary over the weekend. Thieves ransacked the office and stole over $20,000 TTD in cash from a safe. The theft was discovered by the manager around 7:15 a.m.

Headline: Car Theft: Vehicle Stolen After Driver Exits in Marabella
Summary: A car theft occurred in the Marabella area when a man, who had been lurking nearby, seized an opportunity after the driver exited the vehicle to visit a store. The thief then entered the vehicle and drove away. Footage shows a passenger being pushed out just before the vehicle was stolen.

Headline: Illegal Firearm Seized in San Juan Operation
Street Address: Residence at Hunte Road, San Juan
Location: MG5X+5FX San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An Anti-Crime exercise under Operation Festive Shield in the San Juan district led to the discovery of an illegal Smith & Wesson 9mm pistol and eleven rounds of ammunition. The discovery resulted in the detention of two male suspects for the unlawful possession of the firearm.

Headline: Loaded Beretta Pistol Seized in Maracas Bay
Street Address: Track leading to Old Bay Road, North Coast Road
Location: QH54+FPQ Maracas Bay Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police conducting Operation Festive Shield in the Maracas Bay district arrested a 34-year-old man after recovering a loaded Beretta 9mm pistol and sixteen rounds of ammunition during a stop-and-search exercise. The arrest targeted the illegal possession of a firearm along the North Coast Road.

Headline: Shooting Assault: Jose Cedeno (35) Shot by Robbery Suspect
Street Address: Non Pareil Cocoa Estate, Comparo Road
Summary: During the same criminal incident in Sangre Grande on Monday morning, 35-year-old Jose Cedeno was injured after a suspect fired a shot in his direction as he arrived on the scene. Cedeno sustained injuries to his right shoulder and was transported to the hospital, where he is listed in stable condition.

Headline: Robbery: Teenage Suspect Steals iPhone from Student in San Juan
Street Address: Corner of Saddle Road and Eastern Main Road
Location: MG2X+37Q San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 14-year-old student of Trinity College was the victim of a robbery around 3:20 p.m. on December 1st in the San Juan area. The suspect, a teenager believed to be 16-17 years old and known to the victim, forcibly grabbed the student's iPhone 12 cellphone, valued at $2,200.00 TTD, before escaping the scene.

Headline: Grand Theft: $50,000 Carbon Cleaner Stolen in Chaguaramas
Street Address: Coral Cove Compound, Western Main Road, Chaguaramas
Summary: A grand theft occurred at the Coral Cove Compound on Western Main Road, Chaguaramas, where a Motovac Carbon Cleaner valued at $50,000 TTD was reported stolen. The victim left the specialized equipment under a boat around 4:00 p.m. on December 1st and discovered the theft when he returned the following morning.

Headline: Homicide Attempt: Daeby Guedez (33) Shot in Groin During Home Invasion
Street Address: Non Pareil Cocoa Estate, Comparo Road
Summary: A violent home invasion and armed robbery occurred around 8:00 a.m. on Monday in the Sangre Grande area, during which 33-year-old Daeby Guedez was seriously injured. Two masked men, one armed with a suspected shotgun, shot Guedez in the groin upon forced entry. The attackers stole a Samsung cellphone and $700 in cash before fleeing. The suspect was arrested in connection with the drug find and also faces charges of Driving with No Driver's Permit and Driving with No Certificate of Insurance.||The operation was coordinated by ACP Simon, W/Snr. Supt. Wilson, Supt. Etienne, ASP Pitt, ASP Ablacksingh, ASP Jones and Insp. Estrada, and involved personnel of the Arima Intel/Operations Unit.

Headline: Valencia: Three Masked Gunmen Rob Home, Steal Vehicle & iPhones from Family with Child Present
Summary: Three armed, masked men stormed a Valencia residence around 3:15 p.m. on Saturday, holding an 11-year-old boy hostage while his father was confined to a bedroom. The suspects, dressed in dark clothing and armed with firearms, entered through an open front door and announced a robbery, ordering the father to remain in the bedroom while they kept the child outside.||The bandits stole a grey Toyota Taisor valued at $195,000 from the home's garage area, along with two iPhones and vehicle keys that had been left on the dining table.||After the suspects fled, the father emerged and alerted a police party that was passing nearby on the roadway.||Officers from the Valencia Police Station are investigating the home invasion and vehicle theft; no arrests have been made at this time.

Headline: Wallerfield: Toyota Raize Stolen from Roadway After Police Impound (Aug 2)
Summary: A Toyota Raize was stolen from Antigua Road in Wallerfield on August 2nd, 2025, one day after being impounded at Arima Police Station following a wreck on August 1st.||The vehicle had been locked and parked along a desolate roadway when it disappeared.||A WPC from Sangre Grande, who had rented the SUV from a Central company, reported it stolen on August 2nd.||The stolen vehicle was later recovered and used in a fatal police-involved shooting at Orange Grove Road South on Wednesday, August 7th.||Arima CID is investigating the theft.

Headline: El Socorro: AR-15 Rifle Seized in Police Operation on Girez Lane
Summary: Police officers recovered an AR-15 rifle concealed in an abandoned lot on Girez Lane, El Socorro on Thursday, August 1st, 2025 during a coordinated operation between the Northern and North Eastern Divisions.||The operation, conducted between 11:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m., was led by Senior Superintendent Maynard-Wilson, Superintendent Ettienne, and Assistant Superintendent Pitt, with operational command by Inspector Gadar and Sergeant Persad.||Officers from the NDTF Area South and a specialist TTPS unit searched an abandoned house and its adjoining lot, discovering a suspicious bundle wrapped in black cling wrap hidden in grass behind an old sofa at approximately 12:25 p.m.||Police Constable Mahabir retrieved and unwrapped the package, revealing an unmarked AR-15 rifle with one magazine.

Headline: Tacarigua: Brutal Cutlass Attack Captured on CCTV (August 1)
Summary: A brutal cutlass attack was recorded on CCTV in Tacarigua on Friday, August 1, 2025. The footage captured the assault as it occurred, providing visual evidence of the incident. The identity of the victim and attacker have not been disclosed in the report. Police are investigating the attack; the CCTV footage is being used as evidence in the enquiry.

Headline: Arouca: Robbers Block Road with Debris, Tie Up Driver, Steal Vehicle
Street Address: Garden Road, Garden Village / Cemetery Street
Summary: A man was ambushed and robbed on Garden Road, Garden Village, Arouca around 1:15 a.m. on August 1st while driving his silver Mitsubishi Lancer. Two armed men dressed in dark clothing with partially covered faces forced him to stop by placing debris on the roadway, then announced a robbery and ordered him into the back seat of his own vehicle.||The suspects drove the victim against his will to a bushy area along Cemetery Street, Arouca, where they tied his hands and gagged his mouth with a nylon strap before fleeing with the stolen vehicle.||The victim eventually freed himself and walked to the Arouca Police Station to report the incident.||Arouca police are investigating the case of robbery with aggravation, kidnapping, and carjacking; no arrests have been made.

Headline: Las Lomas: Firearm and Ammunition Seized in NSOU Raid; Man Shot (22)
Summary: A 22-year-old labourer from Chin Chin Road, Las Lomas No. 1 was shot in the upper thigh during a pre-dawn police raid on Friday, August 1st, 2025 at approximately 4:45 a.m. Officers from the National Special Operations Unit (NSOU) and Defence Force Special Forces Unit executed a search warrant under Section 12 of the Emergency Powers Regulations targeting illegal firearms and ammunition at the suspect's residence.||Upon entry and announcing their presence, the suspect became hostile and attempted to wrestle a firearm away from one of the soldiers, resulting in a struggle during which the magazine of the soldier's weapon was dislodged and the officer sustained injuries.||Fearing for his colleague's safety, another soldier discharged a single round, striking the suspect in the upper thigh.||A subsequent search of the suspect's room recovered one black Luger revolver. Both the injured soldier and the suspect were treated at Chaguanas Health Facility; the suspect was later transferred to Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex, discharged, and placed in custody at Caroni Police Station.

Headline: Scarborough: 37-Year-Old Female Arrested with LSD, Ecstasy and Mushrooms
Summary: A 37-year-old female owner of a business establishment in Scarborough, Tobago was arrested on Friday, August 1, 2025 during an Inter-Agency Task Force operation conducted between 2:30 pm and 7 pm. Officers conducted a search of the business place with assistance from the Canine Branch and discovered quantities of LSD, Ecstasy and dried mushrooms concealed in a counter. The suspect was arrested in connection with the drug finds.||The operation was spearheaded by ACP Hazel, ACP Subero, Snr. Supt. Elie, Snr. Supt. Spence and Snr. Supt. Montrichard.

Headline: Cunupia: 22-Year-Old Shot During Struggle with Officers at Las Lomas
Summary: A 22-year-old suspect was shot in the upper thigh during an anti-crime exercise conducted by the National Special Operations Unit at Las Lomas No. 1, Cunupia on Friday, August 1, 2025 around 4:45 am. Officers proceeded to the suspect's home to conduct a search, during which the suspect allegedly became hostile and held onto one officer's firearm, resulting in a physical struggle. An officer sustained injuries during the altercation when a colleague, in keeping with the Use of Force Policy, discharged his firearm in the direction of the suspect to stop the assault.||The suspect was taken to hospital for treatment of the gunshot wound, and the injured officer also sought medical treatment.

Headline: Cunupia: Female Police Officer Assaulted by Ex-Boyfriend with Cell Phone
Summary: A female police officer was struck repeatedly on the head with a cell phone by her ex-boyfriend, Keston Augustus Williams, at an apartment in Cunupia around 11:50 p.m. on August 1st. The officer was at home with her sister, infant son, and Williams when an argument broke out after she asked him to leave the premises and he refused.||During the altercation, Williams allegedly used the bottom corner of his cell phone to strike the woman multiple times on the head while making certain utterances.||Officers from the Cunupia Police Station responded and observed the victim with a swollen head, a 3cm laceration, and visible bleeding on her head and left shoulder.||The incident is classified as a domestic dispute involving an intimate partner; police are investigating the assault.

Headline: San Fernando: Nissan B-13 Stolen from Blanche Fraser Street
Summary: A Nissan B-13 with registration number PBG 7606 was stolen from Blanche Fraser Street in San Fernando on Friday, August 1st, 2025.||The vehicle was reported missing on the date of the theft.||Police are investigating the incident; no arrests have been made at this time.

Headline: Curepe: Pressure Washer Stolen from Vehicle by Two Thieves
Summary: A pressure washer was stolen from a vehicle parked on Southern Main Road, Curepe on July 31, 2025.||CCTV footage captured the theft, showing one thief initially leaving the scene before returning with an accomplice.||The two individuals then removed the pressure washer from the vehicle and fled.||Police are investigating the incident; the CCTV evidence has been documented as part of the investigation.

Headline: Sangre Grande: Six Arrested in Warrant Operations, Eastern Division
Summary: Six persons were arrested in the Sangre Grande district of the Eastern Division on July 31st, 2025 between 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM.||Officers executed seven warrants during the coordinated anti-crime operation.||The arrests were conducted as part of the Trinidad and Tobago Police Service's focused efforts to apprehend individuals wanted on outstanding warrants.||Police continue operations to maintain law and order during the ongoing State of Emergency.

Headline: Naparima Mayaro Road: 11.2 Grams of Cocaine Seized, One Arrested
Summary: Officers from Princes Town CID seized 11.2 grams of cocaine from a man along the Naparima Mayaro Road on July 31st, 2025.||The seizure was conducted during a separate anti-crime exercise as part of coordinated operations across multiple divisions.||The arrested individual is expected to appear before the South Masters' Court on Monday, August 4th, 2025 for drug trafficking offences.||Police continue efforts to disrupt drug trafficking and maintain law and order during the State of Emergency.

Headline: Matilda Road: 1,200 Grams of Cannabis Seized, One Arrested
Summary: Officers from Princes Town CID discovered 1,200 grams of high-grade cannabis during a search at a Matilda Road residence on July 31st, 2025.||The seizure was conducted during a separate anti-crime exercise as part of coordinated warrant operations across multiple divisions.||The arrested individual is expected to appear before the South Masters' Court on Monday, August 4th, 2025 for drug trafficking offences.||Police continue efforts to disrupt drug trafficking and maintain law and order during the State of Emergency.

Headline: Morvant: Man 'Pitbull' (36) Shot Inside Home After Refusing Call-Out
Summary: A 36-year-old man known as 'Pitbull' was shot inside his home on Morvant Old Road around 5:00 p.m. on Thursday evening. Two armed men approached the residence and called out to the victim, attempting to lure him outside; when he refused to step outside, one gunman opened fire through the home, striking him in the left hand.||The suspects fled the scene in an unknown direction immediately after the shooting.||Officers from the North Eastern Division Task Force, including Cpl. Daniel and his team, responded and transported the injured man to Port of Spain General Hospital, where he was treated for his injuries.||Crime Scene Investigators recovered a 9mm spent shell casing and a blood swab from the scene. No arrests have been made and investigations are ongoing.

Headline: Penal: Four Venezuelan Nationals Detained, Shotgun and Ammo Seized at Camp
Summary: Four Venezuelan nationals were apprehended at a makeshift camp off Snail Trace, Scotts Road, Penal on Wednesday, July 30, 2025 at approximately 1:30 p.m. during a police operation led by Sgt. Boodlal and including Cpl Gaffar, Ag/Cpl Nanan, and PC Boodhan.||Officers observed a shotgun resting against a wooden post in the center of the camp, with a plastic bag containing shotgun cartridges nearby.||Upon announcement of police presence, the four men fled into nearby bushes but were apprehended a short distance away.||The suspects were identified as Neso Medina (20), Moy Edwardo (23), Antonio Bolino (28), and Hariel Gonzales (19), all unemployed and from Tucupita, Venezuela.||The shotgun and ammunition were seized during the operation. The Penal CID and Penal Police Station conducted the operation based on intelligence.

Headline: Carenage: Man Chopped with Cutlass by Former Worker Over Unpaid Wages
Summary: A 40-year-old man was brutally attacked with a cutlass at his auto garage on Beard Street Extension, Carenage on Wednesday, July 30, 2025 around 12:30 p.m. during a wage dispute with a former employee known as 'Marcus' of Scorpion Alley.||The attacker arrived in a black Toyota Prius and approached the victim, then suddenly declared 'keep the money' before striking him with the cutlass.||The victim sustained severe injuries to his right hand, including a 10cm laceration with exposed bone, muscle, ligament, and tissue.||He was rushed to St. James Medical Facility for stabilization and later transferred to Port of Spain General Hospital, where medical personnel confirmed the extent of the injuries and provided police with a medical report.||The suspect fled the scene in the same vehicle. Police are investigating the wounding incident; no arrests have been made.

Headline: Chaguanas: Home Invasion & Robbery at Edinburgh Village Apartment; iPhone 13 Pro Max Stolen
Summary: Two Venezuelan nationals, ages 25 and 28, were victims of a home invasion and robbery at their apartment in Edinburgh Village, Chaguanas on Wednesday, July 30, 2025 at approximately 8:38 p.m.||The victims discovered a man inside their living room in the process of stealing an iPhone 13 Pro Max valued at $2,000 TTD.||When confronted, the suspect pulled a black object resembling a firearm from his waistband and announced a robbery; the victims quickly realized the object was made of plastic.||A struggle ensued during which the intruder was overpowered and detained until police arrived.||The suspect, identified as Joel Modeste of Enterprise Street, Chaguanas, was arrested by officers of the Freeport Police Station and taken to Chaguanas Police Station; he was also taken for medical attention.

Headline: Arima: Troy Pollard Beaten, Robbed by Five Bandits; Extortion Demand Follows
Summary: Troy Pollard was tied up, beaten and robbed by five bandits while cutting grass at his Arima home on Wednesday, July 30, 2025.||The attackers fled with his vehicle and other property during the assault.||On the same day, Pollard's mother received a call from a man demanding $8,000 in exchange for the stolen car, indicating a coordinated extortion scheme.||Police met with Pollard and his mother at their Arima home on Thursday, July 31, 2025 to document the incident; investigation status and arrests pending.

Headline: Arima: White Mazda Wagon Stolen at Gunpoint by 5 Armed Men
Summary: A white Mazda Wagon was stolen at gunpoint from the Demera Area in Arima on Tuesday, July 29, 2025 at approximately 2:00 PM. Five armed men forcibly took the vehicle from its owner using firearms as a threat.||The carjacking occurred in broad daylight in a residential area of Arima.||Police are investigating the incident; no arrests have been made at the time of reporting.

Headline: Moriah: 22-Year-Old Trevon Walker Shot Dead at Highlands
Summary: Trevon Walker, 22, was shot and killed at Highlands in Moriah, Tobago early on Tuesday, July 29, 2025.||The victim was gunned down in what marked Tobago's fourth murder of the year.||Emergency responders attended the scene; Walker was pronounced dead.||Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting; no arrests have been made.

Headline: Barataria: Gunman Robs Subway of $2,010 at Dawn
Summary: A gunman robbed a Subway restaurant on 6th Avenue, Barataria of $2,010 in cash at approximately 6:39 a.m. on Tuesday, July 29, 2025. Three female employees were present when the armed suspect entered, ordered two workers to sit on the ground, and demanded the supervisor hand over the day's cash from both the register and vault.||The supervisor complied out of fear for her safety and handed over $2,010 in Trinidad and Tobago currency.||The suspect then calmly exited the restaurant and was last seen walking west along Eastern Main Road, Barataria.||Police responded swiftly and interviewed two employees on scene, reviewed surveillance footage, and canvassed the area for additional witnesses and evidence.

Headline: Malabar: Man Shot with Shotgun After Charging Neighbour with Cutlass
Street Address: Kellewan Avenue and Train Line Road, Malabar
Summary: A 37-year-old resident of Kellewan Avenue, Train Line Road, Malabar was shot on Tuesday, July 29, 2025 around 9:30 p.m. during a heated dispute with a female relative and neighbour Anthony Balkaran, 47.||The victim allegedly charged at Balkaran while armed with a cutlass; Balkaran responded by pointing a shotgun and firing a single round.||The victim sustained gunshot injuries to his left thigh, knees, and lower leg and was rushed to Arima Health Facility where he was listed in stable condition.||Police recovered no illegal weapon at the scene; the shotgun remains unaccounted for. Officers from the Arima Police Station are investigating the incident.

Headline: Curepe: Police Seize $305,910 Worth of Cannabis in Apartment Raid
Summary: During a hybrid patrol exercise on Tuesday, July 29, 2025, between 8 AM and 2 PM, officers conducted a narcotics operation at an apartment in Valsayn, Curepe based on intelligence of a storage location.||The canine unit's K9 'Choco' indicated heightened interest in the washroom area of a downstairs apartment, prompting a search that led to the discovery of four bags containing 100 rectangular packages of cannabis.||The seized items were transported to Charford Court Base and confirmed to weigh 55.62 kilograms with an estimated street value of $305,910 TT.||The operation resulted in the recovery of a significant quantity of narcotics; further investigation details were not disclosed.

Headline: Curepe: FUL Holder Shoots Robber During Wallet Theft at Chinese Restaurant
Street Address: Xing Hui Chinese Restaurant, #117 Southern Main Road
Summary: A 69-year-old licensed firearm holder was robbed and assaulted at Xing Hui Chinese Restaurant on Southern Main Road, Curepe on Tuesday, July 29, 2025 around 8:15 p.m. when a male suspect reached into his pants pocket and grabbed his wallet while demanding 'Gih meh wah yuh have dey.' The victim drew his Glock 19C pistol and ordered the suspect to freeze, but the suspect lunged forward and grabbed the firearm, resulting in a physical struggle. During the tussle, a round was discharged, striking the male suspect, Ijah Boothman, 22, of Morvant, in the right arm.||Boothman was transported to Mt Hope Hospital for treatment and is reported to be in stable condition under police guard. The female suspect, Nyesha Carrington, 20, of Real Springs, Valsayn, was taken into custody and transported to the St Joseph Police Station.||Officers from the St Joseph Police District, the North-Central Division Task Force (West), and Emergency Health Services responded to the scene.

Headline: Moruga: Man Shot in Hand While Harvesting Yams at Big Hill
Street Address: Big Hill, forested area near Edward Trace, Moruga
Summary: 29-year-old Shaquille Silverton of Edward Trace, Basse Terre, Moruga was shot in the right hand while harvesting yams in a forested area known as Big Hill on Monday, July 29, 2025 at approximately 4:30 p.m.||Silverton heard a loud explosion and moments later felt a burning sensation in his right hand, realizing he had been injured.||When he turned around, he saw a man running away in the opposite direction but could not provide a description due to the distance.||Silverton reported the incident to Moruga Police Station, where PC Horseford escorted him to Moruga Health Centre for treatment; he was later transferred to Princes Town District Health Facility for further care and a medical report was obtained.||Moruga police are investigating the shooting; attempts to revisit the scene were hindered by dense forestry requiring a 15-minute walk from the nearest roadway.

Summary: An iPhone 15 Pro Max was stolen from the uniform section upstairs at Charran's Bookstore, located at 24 Eastern Main Road, San Juan on Monday, July 28th, 2025 at approximately 12:12 p.m.||The theft occurred during business hours at the retail location.||The suspect's identity remains unknown; a photo or description of the individual has been circulated for public recognition.||San Juan Police are investigating the incident; no arrests have been made.

Headline: Beetham Highway: Three Robbed of $6,500 & Valuables After Vehicle Breakdown
Street Address: Beetham Highway near WASA station, outside Beetham Landfill
Summary: Three East Dry River residents were robbed of $6,500 in cash and jewelry valued at $4,000 on Beetham Highway near the WASA station outside Beetham Landfill on Monday, July 28, 2025 at approximately 1:20 a.m. Their vehicle had stalled while heading west along the highway when six men emerged and announced a hold-up.||The first victim lost a silver Samsung Neo cellphone worth $2,000, a gold hand band valued at $2,000, and $2,000 in cash. The second victim was robbed of a gold chain with a butterfly pendant valued at $2,000. The third victim lost $500 in cash.||The six suspects fled the scene on foot, heading north into Beetham Gardens.||No injuries were reported. Police are investigating the robbery; no arrests have been made.

Headline: Barrackpore: Six Masked Intruders Invade Home, Beat Two Men, Sexually Assault Woman
Summary: A family in Barrackpore was subjected to a brutal home invasion by six masked, armed intruders at approximately 1:00 a.m. on Monday, July 28, 2025, when one suspect climbed through a bedroom window and assaulted the first victim with a firearm.||The intruders forced the first victim to summon his brother from a nearby structure; upon exiting, the second victim was beaten by multiple suspects while two unarmed intruders entered the second house, confined two children to a bedroom, and sexually assaulted a female victim in the living room.||The suspects stole multiple Samsung cell phones and a black Nissan Pulsar motor vehicle before fleeing southward in the stolen vehicle.||Both male victims were treated at Princes Town Health Facility for injuries sustained during the assault, while the female victim was medically examined and treated by the District Medical Officer. Police are investigating the incident; no arrests have been reported.

Headline: Couva: Teen Robbed of $3,500 Gold Chain Outside Police Station
Street Address: Republic Bank Couva vicinity, outside Couva Police Station
Summary: An 18-year-old student of the National Energy Skills Centre (NESC) was robbed of a gold chain valued at $3,500 outside the Couva Police Station on Monday, July 28, 2025 at approximately 2:30 p.m.||The victim was seated in a green-band maxi taxi named Exodus when the vehicle stopped near Republic Bank Couva to drop off a passenger.||A male passenger in the same maxi allegedly snatched the chain from around the teen's neck and exited the vehicle.||The victim immediately raised an alarm, alerting nearby police officers who pursued the suspect on foot.||A 30-year-old resident of California was swiftly apprehended and taken to the Couva Police Station pending further investigation.

Headline: St. James: British Psychiatrist Beaten, Robbed of Gold Jewelry Near Cemetery
Street Address: Mucurapo Road near Woodbrook Cemetery, St. James
Summary: A 55-year-old British national was violently robbed on Mucurapo Road near Woodbrook Cemetery in St. James on Monday, July 28, 2025 at approximately 6:10 p.m. Two men accosted the victim while he was walking west along the road, assaulting him by beating him about the body before stealing his belongings.||The stolen items included an iPhone 7, a gold chain, a gold bracelet, his side bag containing his UK driver's permit, ID card, €80 in cash, and TT$150.||The suspects fled the scene by entering the back seat of a silver motor vehicle, which then drove east along Mucurapo Road.||Police are investigating the robbery and assault; no arrests have been made at the time of reporting.

Headline: Arima: Mikhail Campbell (23) Shot Dead Outside Home After Gunman Called Out
Street Address: LP 51, Maturita Extension, By-Pass Road, Arima
Summary: Mikhail Campbell, 23, was shot and killed outside his home at LP 51, Maturita Extension, By-Pass Road, Arima on Monday, July 28, 2025 at approximately 11:35 p.m.||An unidentified gunman approached the premises and called out to Campbell, who was liming with friends and relatives at the time. Campbell walked towards the individual when several loud explosions were heard.||Campbell was found bleeding from multiple gunshot wounds to the body and was rushed to Arima Health Facility at 11:40 p.m.||He was pronounced dead at 11:44 p.m. Officers from the Pinto Police Post responded to the E-999 report; the identity of the gunman remains unknown and no arrests have been made.

Headline: Tobago: Three Armed Men Rob Kads Supermarket at 9:30 PM
Summary: Three armed and masked men robbed Kads Supermarket in Tobago at approximately 9:30 p.m. on Monday, July 28, 2025.||The robbery occurred during the ongoing State of Emergency declared across the country.||The suspects were armed and wore masks during the incident.||Police response and investigation status have not been detailed in available reports.

Headline: St Joseph: Ministry Driver Robbed of $9,000 After Bank Withdrawal; Two Arrested
Street Address: Farm Road, Ministry of Agriculture compound, St Joseph
Summary: A 46-year-old Ministry of Agriculture driver was robbed of $9,000 in cash at the Ministry's compound on Farm Road, St Joseph on Monday, July 28, 2025, after withdrawing the money from First Citizens Bank in Diego Martin around 11:38 a.m.||The victim placed the envelope containing the cash under the driver's seat of his Ministry vehicle and parked it at the compound. Moments after he walked away, he heard a loud noise and observed a heavily tinted white Hyundai Accent speeding out of the compound.||Upon inspection, the victim discovered the right front window of his vehicle had been smashed and the envelope with the cash was missing.||Officers from the St Joseph Police Station intercepted the suspect vehicle along Wrightson Road, Port of Spain shortly after an emergency call was made. Inside the vehicle, police found two male suspects and the stolen envelope containing the recovered cash. Suspects Husayn Hassan, 35, of Diego Martin, and Daniel Roberts, 31, of Mt Hope, were arrested and taken to the St Joseph Police Station pending further investigation.

Headline: Port of Spain: Man Defrauded of $3,000 in Massy Finance Loan Scam
Summary: A 27-year-old man was defrauded of $3,000 TT on Monday, July 28, 2025, after being contacted via Facebook by a woman claiming to be Natasha Millington, a loans officer with Massy Finance.||The victim was promised a $50,000 loan and transferred $3,000 TT to an account at Scotiabank, Independence Square, Port of Spain, as a purported processing fee.||When the victim attempted to contact Millington to follow up on his loan application, he was unable to reach her.||The scammer has not been apprehended and the funds remain unrecovered.

Headline: Claxton Bay bar owner gunned down (Kimo Narcis, 37)
San Fernando: Man and Woman Shot During Park Robbery; $802 and Items Stolen
relatedCrimeTypes: Assault,Robbery, Attempted Murder, Assault,Robbery, Attempted Murder
Summary: A 31-year-old man from Arima and a 36-year-old woman from Marabella were robbed at gunpoint around 4:10 AM on Sunday, July 27, 2025, while sitting on a bench at a park in Arima.||The male victim was relieved of a wallet, $700 in cash, a Scotia Bank card, national ID, and driver's permit; the female victim lost a black side bag, $102 in cash, an AnsaBank card, national ID, and a cellphone valued at $900.||During the robbery, a struggle broke out between the male victim and the armed female suspect, during which the firearm discharged, striking both victims in the legs.||Both victims were transported to San Fernando General Hospital for treatment of their gunshot wounds.||The two suspects—a man and an armed woman—fled the scene; police investigation status and arrest details were not reported.

Headline: Valencia: Garvin Patterson (46) Found Murdered in Vehicle on Balisier Road
Summary: Garvin Patterson, 46, of #9 Aripo Road, Smith Lands, Wallerfield, Arima, was found murdered in the backseat of his vehicle parked along Balisier Road in Valencia on Saturday, July 26, 2025.||His body was discovered inside the car in a location known as Smith Lands within the Arima Police district.||The circumstances surrounding the murder remain under investigation by Arima Police.||Investigations are continuing to identify the perpetrator and establish the motive for the killing.

Headline: El Dorado: Elderly Women Abused for Years; Suspect Shot Dead After Stabbing Officer
Summary: Two elderly women were held hostage and abused for several years at a residence on Lovers Lane, El Dorado, with the situation escalating violently on Saturday, July 26, 2025, around 1:30 p.m.||Officers from the North Central Division Task Force (West) responded to a domestic disturbance call and found the suspect, 42-year-old Mustapha Rawlins, had barricaded himself and the two elderly victims inside a locked room.||When officers forced entry through a side door, Rawlins attacked Corporal Persad with a large knife, stabbing him repeatedly.||Officers opened fire on Rawlins in accordance with TTPS Use of Force Policy to neutralize the threat; Rawlins was pronounced dead on arrival at Mt. Hope Hospital.||Cpl Persad was treated for multiple stab wounds and discharged in stable condition.||Both elderly victims were safely rescued and are receiving care and support; police sources confirmed this was not the first report of abuse at the address.

Headline: Port of Spain: Man Robbed of $3,500 Samsung Phone on Park Street
Street Address: Park Street, near Republic Bank carpark
Summary: A 20-year-old man from Debe was robbed of his Samsung S24 cellphone valued at $3,500 on Park Street near the Republic Bank carpark in Port of Spain on Saturday, July 26, 2025 at approximately 12:00 p.m. The victim had travelled to meet a prospective buyer he contacted through Facebook Marketplace. A man of African descent, approximately 6'1" tall, light in complexion, wearing a white jersey and black three-quarter jeans, snatched the phone and fled east along Park Street.||The victim pursued the suspect but was intercepted near Bath Street by three additional men of African descent who robbed him of $900 in cash, a black wristwatch, and a pair of ear pods.||Police have descriptions of the suspects involved in both robberies but no arrests have been reported.

Headline: Chaguanas: Businesswoman Robbed of $46,000 Outside Scotia Bank After Taser Attack
Summary: A businesswoman was robbed of $46,000 in cash outside Scotia Bank on Southern Main Road, Chaguanas on Friday, July 25, 2025 at approximately 9:45 a.m. after being attacked with a taser-like device during a violent struggle over her purse.||The suspect ran up and grabbed her purse, and during the ensuing struggle she was shocked twice with an electric device before collapsing to the ground; the attacker then fled with the purse containing the day's sales.||A passerby witnessed the attack and attempted to intervene, but the suspect escaped in a white Nissan Note; the purse was later recovered nearby during the commotion.||Surveillance footage and witness statements revealed that two suspects had earlier trailed the victim into Republic Bank before the robbery at Scotia Bank.||Four men were intercepted in Couva as they attempted to return the rented getaway vehicle: Isiah Chow (24), Tyrese David (30), Joel Charles (26), and Arlon Reid (18), who is reportedly a suspect in ongoing taxi robberies in Chaguanas.

Headline: Siparia: Man Stabbed Twice in Altercation on George Street (Kern Coutou, 30)
Summary: Kern Coutou, 30, of Robert Hill, Siparia, was stabbed twice during an altercation with 23-year-old Terril Straker on George Street around 7:45 a.m. on Friday, July 25, 2025.||Straker allegedly stabbed Coutou once in the neck and once in the abdomen during a struggle between the two men.||Coutou was initially taken to the Siparia Health Facility for medical examination before being transferred to San Fernando General Hospital (SFGH).||Coutou is currently warded in stable condition at SFGH. Straker has been identified by police in connection with the incident.

Headline: San Juan: Two Men Robbed of $30,000 in Facebook Vehicle Sale Scam
Summary: Two men were robbed of $30,000 and personal valuables on Zaman Avenue, San Juan on Friday, July 25, 2025 at approximately 3:15 p.m. after responding to a Facebook advertisement for a silver Nissan Y12 Wingroad. Victim #1 had been communicating with the seller via Facebook and WhatsApp since June 2025, but could not recall the exact profile name or contact details used. Upon arrival at the meeting location, the two victims were accosted by two armed suspects who robbed them of the cash and other items before fleeing on foot via a narrow track.||On July 27, 2025, Akim Pereira, also known as Jimbo, of Calvary Hill, Maitagual, San Juan, was arrested and subsequently charged in connection with the robbery. The second suspect remains at large.

PDZ 9718, valued at TTD 63,000) was stolen from the yard of a residence along Southern Main Road, Claxton Bay, between 9:00 p.m. on July 2 and 5:00 a.m. on July 3.||The vehicle had been parked securely and was discovered missing early the following morning.||Police are investigating.

Headline: Blue Nissan Wingroad Wagon stolen from home
Location: JGXQ+XG9 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A blue Nissan Wingroad Wagon (Reg. PCR 3615, valued at TTD 30,000) was stolen from outside a home on Third Street, Barataria, between 10:00 p.m. on July 2 and 6:00 a.m. on July 3.||The vehicle was not outfitted with GPS and its alarm system was non-functional at the time of the theft.||Police are investigating.

Headline: White Nissan Tiida carjacked at gunpoint
Location: MH26+PQM San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white Nissan Tiida (Reg. PCR 9103, valued at TTD 40,000) was stolen in an armed robbery in Petit Bourg between 12:30 a.m. and 1:30 a.m. on July 3.||The victim returned to the vehicle to find two suspects by the front door. One suspect threatened to shoot, prompting the victim to flee.||The suspects then escaped with the vehicle. Police are investigating.

Headline: Red Nissan Tiida carjacked at knifepoint
Summary: A red Nissan Tiida hatchback (Reg. PBT 7504) was taken at knifepoint around 11:15 p.m. on July 3 in Chaguaramas, Carenage.||Two masked men, one armed with a firearm and the other with a knife, ordered the driver out of the vehicle near the C.D.A. Police Post.||The suspects then escaped in an easterly direction with the vehicle. Police are investigating.

Headline: White Honda City carjacked; electronics and cash stolen
Location: MF97+594 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A white Honda City (Reg. PEB 6900, valued at TTD 165,000) was stolen along the Audrey Jeffers Highway around 7:05 p.m. on July 3 during an armed robbery.||Three armed and masked men approached two occupants in the parked vehicle and forced them out.||In addition to the car, the suspects made off with two iPhones, a Kindle, a Lenovo tablet, a DG1 drone, and cash. Police are investigating.

Headline: Man loses $7,000 in Facebook car scam impersonating 'Marshalls Automotive' (38-year-old)
Street Address: First Citizens Bank, Woodford Street, Arima
Summary: A 38-year-old man of River Road, Arima, responded to a Facebook listing for a white Hyundai Elantra (PDL 418) advertised by a company called 'Marshalls Automotive' and made a $7,000 payment at First Citizens Bank, Woodford Street, Arima, around 1:00 p.m. on Thursday, July 3rd, 2025.||After the transaction, the seller became unreachable.||The victim was deceived into transferring money for a vehicle that was never delivered.

Headline: Flanagin Town: Boat Engine Valued at $20,000 Stolen from Property
Summary: A boat engine valued at $20,000 TT was stolen from a property on D'Abadie Road, Flanagin Town on Thursday, July 3rd, 2025 around 11:15 p.m. Three men entered the premises and removed the engine from a vessel before escaping.||Police have identified a primary suspect—a slim, dougla male from Flanagin Town with initials M.M., who is known to law enforcement and allegedly orchestrated the theft.||Investigators believe the suspect is linked to a criminal gang operating out of Claxton Bay and Couva, and intelligence suggests the stolen engine may have already been transported to Claxton Bay for use on another vessel. No arrests have been made.

Headline: 1 dead, 3 on the run after police-involved shooting in south Trinidad
Chain snatched in broad daylight on High Street
Street Address: High Street, opposite Leann's Fresh Styles clothing store
Summary: A woman was robbed of her chain on High Street in San Fernando in broad daylight. The incident occurred directly opposite Leann's Fresh Styles clothing store when a man snatched the woman's chain and fled on foot.||It is unclear whether the suspect has been apprehended or if the woman sustained any injuries.

Headline: Two men and motorist robbed after stopping for mechanical assistance (ages 21, 22)
Street Address: Beetham Highway near John John Flyover
Location: JGV6+V5X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 6 p.m., two men aged 21 and 22 stopped to assist a motorist whose car had broken down near the John John Flyover on Beetham Highway. Eight men confronted them and announced a robbery.||The 21-year-old was struck in the head and chest by one attacker and robbed of his cellphone and Crocs. The 22-year-old was robbed of his white Suzuki Swift (registered PCJ 554) and $100. The motorist experiencing mechanical issues was also robbed of his cellphone.||The suspects fled in the stolen vehicle.

Headline: Man and woman robbed at gunpoint during roadside tyre repair (armed robbery)
Location: JGV6+V5X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: At approximately 10:30 p.m., a man and woman driving a blue Kia Rio stopped to repair a tyre near the WASA pipelines on Beetham Highway. Six bandits ambushed them, one armed with a firearm.||The group announced a robbery and took two cellphones, an engagement ring, a wallet containing $1,000 TT, and other personal belongings from the victims.||The suspects fled into the Beetham area.

Headline: Armed robbery at Flower Pot Beach (38-year-old male victim)
Street Address: Flower Pot Beach, Southern Main Road
Summary: Around 1:00 a.m. on Wednesday, July 2nd, 2025, a 38-year-old man from Montrose, Chaguanas was liming with a female companion known as "Zion" on the shore at Flower Pot Beach when three men accosted them. One assailant was armed with a firearm and demanded money.||The victim was beaten about the face and body after his feet were bound. The assailants fled with TT$200 in cash, a Samsung cellphone valued at TT$1,000, and his silver Nissan Tiida (registration PCY 4865).||The victim reported the incident at St. Margaret's Police Station and was taken to San Fernando General Hospital for medical attention.

Headline: Kia vehicle stolen (Reg # PDP 3210)
Summary: A Kia vehicle with registration number PDP 3210 was stolen from St Andrews Avenue in Cocoyea on Wednesday, 2nd July, 2025.||No victim name or additional details provided in the report.

Headline: Vehicle stolen in La Romaine, a Nissan Tiida PCT 6215
Summary: A vehicle was stolen from the La Romaine community on Thursday, July 2nd, 2025.||The stolen vehicle was discovered a short distance from the La Romaine Police Post.

Street Address: Chittar Trace, off Mohess Road, Penal

Headline: Homicide probe after man's body found tied and gagged in Belmont (Dacarai Jafari Dickson)
Location: MG97+744 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 3:55 p.m. on Tuesday, July 1st, 2025, first responders discovered the lifeless body of an unidentified male of African descent in a grassy area along Lady Young Road in Belmont, approximately 21 feet south of the roadway behind a metal crash barrier.||The deceased was approximately 6 feet tall, medium build, with a brown complexion, wearing black three-quarter pants and a brown camouflage-pattern t-shirt. Both hands were bound behind his back using a belt, rope, and tie strap; his ankles were tied together with a black strap. A rope was tied around his neck, and a piece of white cloth was wrapped around his face.||Police are conducting a homicide investigation into the circumstances of the death.

Headline: Woman robbed and carjacked outside home (67)
Summary: A 67-year-old woman was exiting her silver Hyundai Ioniq from her driveway when confronted by two armed men. One suspect pushed her to the ground, robbed her of an iPhone 11 valued at approximately $2,000 TT, and threatened her with a firearm.||The suspects then entered the woman's Hyundai Ioniq, valued at $185,000 TT, and fled the scene in convoy with a dark-colored motor vehicle. The stolen vehicle was subsequently recovered by police.
