Woman robbed at gunpoint in workplace car park (32)
Street Address: Recharge Bar car park, St Joseph Road
Summary: A 32-year-old woman was seated in her vehicle in the car park of Recharge Bar in St Joseph Village around 3:30 AM when she was approached by four masked men armed with guns.||The suspects announced a robbery and took $6,700 in cash (the night's sales), her wallet containing $1,194, her driver's permit, and a Samsung cellphone.||The suspects fled in a cream-coloured Hyundai Elantra.

Headline: Three Chinese nationals robbed and assaulted at supermarket (ages 20, 49, 49)
Summary: Three Chinese nationals aged 20, 49, and 49 were asleep at E-Day Supermarket on Wilson Road, Scarborough when they were awakened by loud banging on a door around 2 AM on Monday, June 30, 2025.||Approximately six armed men wielding cutlasses entered the bedroom area, demanded cash, and chopped the victims about their bodies, causing injuries.||The assailants stole TT$200,000 and US$15,000 in cash before fleeing through a southern door. Police were notified and all three victims were treated at Scarborough General Hospital and discharged.

Headline: Belmont man scares off robbers with licensed gun
Location: MF7G+3VC Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago

Headline: Break-in at Carenage preschool; TV, ice cream, popcorn stolen
Summary: The Ark Preschool at #1 Amowsville, Carenage was broken into sometime between Sunday afternoon June 29th and early Monday morning June 30th, 2025. A 57-year-old volunteer principal secured the facility at 12:45 p.m. on Sunday and returned at 6:35 a.m. Monday to find multicoloured linens scattered on the floor and items missing.||Stolen items included a black 32-inch TCL flat screen television mounted on a classroom wall, a bucket of Sundae brand strawberry cheesecake ice cream (valued at $50 TTD), and a pack of microwave butter popcorn (valued at $6 TTD).||Suspects pried open a black burglar-proof door with a glass panel to gain entry and exited through a grey wooden door on the northern side of the preschool, which was found closed but unlatched. Police are investigating.

Headline: PH driver charged with raping passenger
Man seriously injured during assault outside bar in Arouca
Summary: A man was seriously injured during an assault outside a bar in Arouca early on Saturday, June 28th, 2025.||The victim sustained serious injuries from the attack.||Police response and investigation details were not provided in the article.

Headline: Man killed behind Market in Chaguanas
Summary: A man was killed behind the Market in Chaguanas early on Saturday, June 28th, 2025.||No additional details provided in the article.||Police investigation status unknown.

Headline: Teen stabbed in neck and face during domestic altercation (19-year-old victim)
Summary: A 19-year-old man was seriously wounded during a domestic altercation at a home in Cunupia on Saturday morning, June 28th, 2025, around 9:30 a.m. An argument broke out between the victim and his 15-year-old cousin, who reside at the same location.||During the confrontation, the younger teen allegedly armed himself with a broken glass bottle and inflicted several stab wounds to the older teen's neck, face, shoulder, and back.||The victim was rushed to the Chaguanas District Health Facility by a family member and later transferred to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex, where he was treated and subsequently discharged. Police arrested the 15-year-old suspect, who was taken for medical attention and conveyed to the Maracas St. Joseph Booking Centre.

Headline: Man shot by sibling in land dispute (Teran Rampersad, 60)
Street Address: 3 3/4mm Surrey Village, Lopinot (garage on parcel of land)
Summary: Teran Rampersad, 60, of Carapo Main Road, Arima, was shot in the neck during a family land dispute on Saturday, June 28, 2025, at approximately 2:20 p.m. in a garage at 3 3/4mm Surrey Village, Lopinot. His brother Richard Rampersad, 49, of Benny Road, Valencia, emerged from behind a parked vehicle armed with a firearm, pointed it at Teran and his son, and said "You will die for the land" before firing a shot that struck Teran in the right side of his neck.||Teran collapsed to the ground with blood oozing from the wound. Police responded and transported him to Arima General Hospital, where he was medically examined before being transferred to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex.||The shooting arose from a bitter land dispute between the two brothers.

Headline: Gunmen open fire in Diego Martin: One killed, three wounded (Tyrrell Mc Eachnie, 25)
Street Address: Bagatelle Road near the track opposite Pine Lane, Bagatelle
Location: PCMM+98F Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 9:30 p.m. on Saturday, June 28, 2025, three armed men exited a grey-coloured sedan on Bagatelle Road near the track opposite Pine Lane and opened fire indiscriminately at persons on the street. Four victims were struck by gunfire: 25-year-old Tyrrell Mc Eachnie of Bagatelle Road, a 24-year-old woman from El Dorado, an 18-year-old male resident of Bagatelle, and a 56-year-old woman from Queen Drive.||Mc Eachnie was pronounced dead at St. James Medical Facility. The 18-year-old male was treated for gunshot wounds to the back and legs and transferred to Port of Spain General Hospital in stable condition. The 24-year-old woman and 56-year-old woman were treated for leg and calf injuries respectively and listed in stable condition.||Police recovered 40 spent shells and 23 marked TTPS cartridges at the scene. The investigation is ongoing.

Headline: White Toyota Corolla Hatchback (PBP 8598) carjacked at gunpoint
Summary: A white Toyota Corolla Hatchback with registration PBP 8598 was taken at gunpoint from the Arima Old Road in Arima on Saturday, June 28th, 2025.||The vehicle was forcibly taken from its driver using a firearm as a threat.||No further details regarding the driver or recovery status were provided.

Headline: Man chopped in face during bar altercation (Rajindra Ramkissoon, 25)
Street Address: Danny Boys Bar, #1633 Fonrose Village, Rio Claro
Summary: Rajindra Ramkissoon, 25, of Poole, Rio Claro, was chopped in the face during an altercation at Danny Boys Bar on Saturday, June 28, around 6:00 a.m.||The incident occurred while Ramkissoon was liming at the bar when he became involved in a dispute with another man, who dealt him a chop to his face.||Suspect Sewchan Sookoo, 32, of Ecclescille, Rio Claro, was detained by police. Officers from Rio Claro Police Station responded and initiated investigations.

Headline: Security officer shot in leg during broad daylight attack in Cocorite (20-year-old)
Street Address: Waterhole area, Phase One, Powder Magazine, Cocorite
Location: MFH3+944 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 20-year-old security officer was shot in the leg during a broad daylight incident in the Waterhole area of Cocorite on Saturday, June 28, 2025, around 2:30 p.m. The victim was walking along the roadway when he heard several loud explosions and felt a sharp pain in his right leg, collapsing to the ground.||He was transported to St. James Medical Complex and treated for a gunshot wound to his upper right thigh. He was listed in stable condition and later transferred to Port of Spain General Hospital for further treatment.||Crime Scene Investigators processed the scene and recovered 18 spent 9mm shell casings, one of which bore TTPS markings.

Headline: Masked gunmen open fire in Santa Cruz; one dead, one wounded (Dillon Pakeera, 29)
Location: PG6C+CWV Sam Boucaud, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 29-year-old man (Dillon Pakeera) was shot and killed, and a 46-year-old man was wounded during a gun attack at a residence on Moraldo Trace, Upper Santa Cruz on Friday, June 27th around 6:45 p.m. The victim was speaking with a neighbor when three masked gunmen approached and opened fire before escaping through a nearby yard.||The 29-year-old was found dead lying on his back in a yard on the northern side of the road. The 46-year-old was shot in the right arm and was taken to Port of Spain General Hospital by a relative for treatment.||The District Medical Officer declared the man dead and ordered a post-mortem at the Forensic Science Centre. Officers retrieved 33 spent 5.56 calibre shells from the scene.

Headline: Pensioner abducted after man drained life savings and stole pension (72-year-old woman)
Summary: A 72-year-old woman was abducted from her Circular Road home in Ste. Madeleine on Friday afternoon, June 27th, 2025, by a man who had financially exploited her for months by emptying her bank account and collecting her monthly pension.||The suspect had gained her trust, used her savings to purchase a vehicle, and continued extracting her pension after her account was depleted. Good Samaritans alerted police, and with officer assistance, the woman closed the compromised account and opened a new one to protect future pension payments.||Enraged by the account closure, the suspect allegedly returned to the property on Friday afternoon and forcibly abducted the woman against her will. The woman lives with her blind sister; her husband had previously fled due to death threats from the suspect.

Headline: Pensioner assaulted, stripped and robbed during home invasion (69-year-old woman)
Summary: Around 10:30 PM on Friday, June 27, 2025, a 69-year-old woman was attacked during a home invasion at her residence in Princes Town. The intruder forced entry by breaking down her bedroom door after she barricaded it. The suspect, wearing brown three-quarter pants and a brown jersey, choked the woman, forcibly undressed her, beat her about the body, and attempted to force her onto the bed while instructing her not to scream.||The victim fought back using a baseball bat and nearby objects to defend herself. The assailant then stole her black Samsung A22 phone (valued at $1,500 TTD) and his own clothing before escaping through the front door.||Police are investigating the incident. The suspect remains at large.

Headline: 2 caught shoplifting from clothing store
Location: JHJF+623 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two women were caught shoplifting from a clothing store in Grand Bazaar on Friday, June 27th, 2025. CCTV footage shows the women examining clothing on the racks, then removing items and concealing them on their person.

Headline: Man shot dead while riding bicycle in Piparo (Carlon Bhola)
Summary: Carlon Bhola was shot dead while riding his bicycle in Piparo on Thursday, June 26th, 2025.||The victim was pronounced dead at the scene.||Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Firearms, ammunition, and drugs seized in Enterprise during IATF operation
Summary: Central Division officers conducted an anti-crime exercise in the Enterprise district on Thursday, June 26th, 2025, between 4:00 p.m. and 9:30 p.m., targeting a bushy area at Chrissie Terrance.||Officers discovered two bulletproof vests, 4.1 kilogrammes of cannabis, and 15 rounds of ammunition during the search.||The operation was part of a coordinated series of exercises led by ACP Collis Haze, Senior Superintendent Spence, Superintendent Ramsook, and ASP Singh of the IATF.

Headline: Revolver and ammunition seized in Port of Spain IATF operation
Location: MF2V+8QV Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: IATF officers conducted an anti-crime exercise in the Duncan Street Plannings area of Port of Spain on Thursday, June 26th, 2025, between 2:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m.||Officers recovered one revolver loaded with four rounds of ammunition, a quantity of cannabis, and nine additional rounds of 7.62 mm and 9 mm ammunition.||The operation was part of coordinated exercises led by ACP Collis Haze, Senior Superintendent Spence, Superintendent Ramsook, and ASP Singh of the IATF.

Headline: Beretta pistol seized from driver in La Horquetta; one arrested
Street Address: Phase 7, unoccupied parcel of land, La Horquetta
Summary: Officers from the North and South Task Force units conducted an anti-crime exercise in La Horquetta on Thursday, June 26th, 2025, between 3:30 p.m. and 6:30 p.m., during which they searched an unoccupied parcel of land at Phase 7 and recovered a quantity of cannabis.||Later in the same exercise, police stopped a Nissan X-Trail driven by a 35-year-old man and discovered a Beretta pistol with a magazine containing two rounds of ammunition.||The driver was arrested and taken into custody.

Headline: Over $1M in compressed cannabis seized in Tobago drug bust
Summary: An intelligence-led operation by the Tobago Gang and Intelligence Unit (TGIU) resulted in the seizure of over $1 million worth of compressed cannabis on Thursday, June 26, around 9:20 p.m. at Scarborough Port.||Officers intercepted a white Honda Civic driven by a 25-year-old suspect from Bon Accord and discovered a concealed, modified compartment in the trunk containing 61 packets of compressed cannabis weighing approximately 33 kilograms, with an estimated street value of $1,152,000.||The vehicle and drugs were seized, the suspect was taken into custody at Shirvan Road Police Station, and investigations are continuing under PC Pierre's direction.

Headline: Rudeboy bandits hit Tobago gas station, steal dozens of beverage cases
Street Address: Gas station compound, southern side, Bon Accord
Summary: A break-in occurred at a gas station in Bon Accord, Tobago around 2:00 a.m. on Thursday, June 26th, 2025. A security officer discovered that a storage container on the southern side of the compound had been forced open, with a single case of Rude-Boy drinks found on the floor with broken bottles.||Upon inventory check, 90 cases of Rude-Boy beverages valued at $40,704 were found missing. Later that day, 13 of those cases were recovered in a bushy area approximately 100 feet from the building.||The remaining 77 cases, worth $34,464, remain unaccounted for. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Naked Venezuelan man beaten with PVC pipe in Belmont
Location: MG82+W99 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A naked Venezuelan man was brutally beaten with a PVC pipe by a man and a woman on Davis Street in Belmont. The victim was heard crying out in Spanish during the assault. A second video later showed the same man lying motionless on the roadway, though his condition and the full circumstances of the incident remain unclear.

Headline: Fishing vessel 'Miss Angie' stolen from Richmond Bay
Summary: On Wednesday, June 25th, 2025, the fishing vessel Miss Angie was stolen from Richmond Bay, Tobago. The boat was critical to the family's livelihood.||On Thursday, June 26th, 2025, the vessel was found abandoned in the Hope area near Mt. St. George, without its engine.||This is the second boat theft from the same family in less than a month, with authorities investigating whether the fishing community is being systematically targeted.

Headline: Gold chain snatched from woman outside restaurant
Location: MF4R+P43 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A woman exiting Ocean's Chinese Restaurant on Frederick Street, Port of Spain, around 12:21 PM on June 25, 2025, was approached by a man of African descent. The suspect snatched the victim's gold Beera chain valued $5,000.00 TT and fled south along Frederick Street.||Police description: male, African descent, dark complexion, slim build, 5'11" tall, wearing grey vest, black hat, red and green slippers.

Headline: Woman defrauded of $5,500 and driver's permit by fake supermarket employee (32-year-old victim)
Street Address: Tru Valu Supermarket, Trincity Mall; Hauxing Supermarket, Eastern Main Road, Tacarigua
Summary: A 32-year-old woman from Chaguanas was contacted via Facebook on Tuesday, June 24, 2025, by a man identifying himself as "Glenn," who claimed to be employed at Tru Valu Supermarket in Trincity Mall and offered to supply discounted alcoholic beverages.||On June 25, 2025, around 11:30 AM, the victim met the suspect at the supermarket. He instructed her to purchase empty cases and accompanied her to Hauxing Supermarket on the Eastern Main Road in Tacarigua, where she bought the cases. They returned to Tru Valu, where the victim handed over $5,500 in cash and her driver's permit to the suspect, who claimed his supervisor would prepare an invoice.||When the suspect failed to return, the victim spoke to a supervisor and learned there was no employee named Glenn at the store. Subsequent attempts to contact the suspect were unsuccessful.||Investigations are ongoing.

Headline: White Nissan Wingroad stolen in La Romaine
Summary: A white Nissan Wingroad bearing registration PDD 3645 was stolen from a residence on Pond Street in La Romaine in the early hours of Tuesday morning, June 24th. The vehicle was last seen parked at the residence and was discovered missing around 4:00 a.m.||The owner's family has issued a public appeal for assistance in locating the vehicle and urging anyone with information to contact the nearest police station.

Headline: Armed robbery at Diego Martin mini mart; four employees and customer targeted
Street Address: St. Lucien Road, VML Mini Mart
Location: PCHR+MF8 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Four employees and a customer were at the VML Mini Mart on St. Lucien Road around 5:55 p.m. on Tuesday when a man posing as a customer drew a firearm and was joined by three other masked men. The assailants physically assaulted the employees and robbed them of cell phones, a gold chain valued at $3,000, approximately $2,000 in cash, alcohol, cigarettes, and two Republic Bank credit cards belonging to the business owners.||The robbers escaped in two stolen vehicles: a white Nissan NP300 taken from a customer and a gold Nissan Almera that had brought them to the scene.||Police set up roadblocks between 6:05 p.m. and 9:30 p.m. at Powder Magazine and Phase One in Cocorite. Officers recovered the NP300 abandoned at Farm Road, Cocorite, along with a .45 calibre pistol, four rounds of ammunition, and a mask. After a brief foot chase, two suspects—a 20-year-old from Diego Martin and a 22-year-old from Laventille—were arrested. The gold Almera was also recovered containing alcohol, cigarettes, and cash believed to be from the robbery.

Headline: Police recover stolen vehicle, firearm, and ammunition following armed robbery operation
Street Address: Farm Road, Cocorite; Powder Magazine and Phase One roadblocks
Location: MFH3+944 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: During police roadblock operations between 6:05 p.m. and 9:30 p.m. on Tuesday, officers from the Western Division recovered a white Nissan NP300 vehicle abandoned at Farm Road, Cocorite. A .45 calibre pistol with four rounds of ammunition and a mask were found nearby.||Officers also recovered a gold Nissan Almera containing alcohol, cigarettes, and cash believed to be from the robbery.||Two suspects—a 20-year-old from Diego Martin and a 22-year-old from Laventille—were arrested following a brief foot chase.

Headline: Teenager robbed and assaulted by two men near Morvant taxi stand (17)
Street Address: George Street, near Morvant taxi stand
Location: JFXV+QFC Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 17-year-old boy was robbed and assaulted by two men near the Morvant taxi stand around 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, June 24th, 2025. The victim was walking near George Street when approached by two men of African descent, both dressed in black jerseys and three-quarter pants. One suspect, described as stocky with short plaits and dark complexion, attempted to remove a gold band from the teen's left hand; when the victim resisted, a struggle ensued and he was punched in the face.||The suspects made off with a gold band valued at $2,000, a black Nike bag containing a Samsung cellphone valued at $900, a Republic Bank card, and the teen's national ID card. One suspect fled east with the jewelry while the other ran west with the bag.

Headline: Security officer robbed of firearm and belongings in Curepe (36-year-old)
Summary: A 36-year-old security officer from Tacarigua was robbed at gunpoint on Joyeau Street in Curepe around 6:15 p.m. on Tuesday evening. Two masked gunmen exited a white Nissan AD Wagon and announced a robbery, taking his service Glock 19 pistol, two magazines with 25 rounds of 9mm ammunition, precept ID, firearm documents, wallet containing $1,000 cash, and Samsung A14 cellphone worth $2,000.||The officer was en route to Arouca Police Station to lodge his firearm after completing his shift when the robbery occurred.||Police response and investigation status not detailed in article.

Headline: Gold Nissan Almera carjacked at gunpoint near Westmall
Location: MCHW+94J Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A gold Nissan Almera (registration PCP 5679) was stolen at gunpoint overnight near Westmall.||The vehicle was taken by force from its occupant(s).||Police are investigating the carjacking.

Headline: Black Hyundai carjacked at gunpoint in Success Village, Laventille
Location: JGX3+9RQ Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A black Hyundai (registration PDT 3721) was stolen at gunpoint overnight in Success Village, Laventille.||The vehicle was taken by force from its occupant(s).||Police are investigating the carjacking.

Headline: Two women found in shallow grave; police suspect Venezuelan nationals
Summary: Two female bodies were discovered buried in a shallow grave in a remote agricultural area off Ramsaran Street near the Warren Road/Bejucal Road district on Wednesday, June 25th, 2025. A farmer noticed disturbed earth on his land and contacted police; officers excavated the site and recovered both bodies.||Both victims bore injuries consistent with blunt force trauma, and police believe they were beaten to death before being buried. The bodies appeared fresh, and investigators suspect they were placed in the grave the night before discovery.||The victims are believed to be Venezuelan nationals. Police are investigating and appealing to the public, particularly the Venezuelan migrant community in Trinidad, for information.

Headline: Man found murdered in washroom of Enterprise home (Ronaldo Baptiste, aka Markie)
Summary: Around 6:20 a.m. on Monday, June 23rd, 2025, police received a report of a body discovered in the outdoor washroom of a residence at Charles Trace, off Goodwill Street, Enterprise, Chaguanas. The homeowner reported finding the body while using the washroom around 6:00 a.m.||Officers found the lifeless body of a male of African descent, approximately 5'7" tall, wearing blue jeans and a black hoodie, lying on his back with apparent stab wounds to the head, face, and neck. Several pieces of a broken bottle were found at the scene.||The washroom is described as an open, unsecured, unfinished concrete structure separated from the main house by a corridor. Police have launched a homicide investigation.

Headline: Woman arrested after injuring police officer with bottle during stone-throwing incident
Summary: Around 4:30 p.m. on June 23rd, 2025, police officers PC Daniel and PC Mohammed responded to a report of missile-throwing at Seon Drive, Tarodale. Approximately 10 individuals were gathered on the roadway, some armed with stones and concrete pieces, engaged in a hostile argument.||During the confrontation, 43-year-old labourer Sherelle Mc Intosh threw a bottle intended for another woman, but it struck PC Mohammed on the left side of his face, causing a visible mouth injury and bleeding.||Mc Intosh was arrested at the scene. The officer sustained injury requiring medical attention.

Headline: Attempted carjacking caught on CCTV (Brazil Village)
Street Address: Near church, just before entrance to nearby warehouse, Brazil Village
Summary: An attempted carjacking was caught on CCTV near a church in Brazil Village, just before the entrance to a nearby warehouse. Summary: On Saturday evening, May 24, 2025, around 8:15 p.m., 20-year-old Josiah Williams was socializing with friends on Goodwill Street in Enterprise, Chaguanas when a dispute erupted between him and one of his companions. During the heated argument, Williams was stabbed in the left side of his chest by his friend.||Williams sustained serious injuries including stab wounds to the upper left chest, an open fracture of the 4th rib, and moderate haemopneumothorax (collapsed lung and bleeding). He also suffered a deep laceration to his left forearm with torn flexor tendons.||Williams was rushed to the Chaguanas Health Facility where he received treatment for his injuries. The incident remains under investigation.

Headline: Lance Corporal stabbed multiple times by passenger (Adrian Khan, 42)
Summary: On Saturday, May 24, 2025, at approximately 12:30 p.m., 42-year-old Adrian Khan, a Trinidad and Tobago Regiment Lance Corporal, was driving a white Toyota Hilux along Polo Ground Road in Preysal, Couva with three other men inside the vehicle. An argument broke out between Khan and a passenger identified as Olston Floyd Khan, his relative, who was seated behind him.||During the altercation, the suspect pulled a knife and stabbed Khan multiple times about the body. Despite sustaining serious injuries, Khan managed to bring the vehicle to a stop and flee to safety. Another passenger exited the vehicle and provided aid to the injured Lance Corporal.||The suspect then jumped into the driver's seat and drove off with his father who had been seated in the front passenger seat. Khan was hospitalized for treatment of his injuries. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Attempted murder shakes Buccoo home in early morning raid (Kaylon Trim, 31)
Summary: In the early hours of Saturday, May 24th at approximately 3:20 a.m., two armed masked men forced their way into a home on Gala Street in Buccoo, invading the bedroom of Kaylon Trim, 31, a labourer, who was at home with his girlfriend. The suspects, armed with firearms, threatened the victim's girlfriend before confronting Kaylon, which sparked a desperate struggle during the chaos.||During the violent altercation, two gunshots were fired, striking Kaylon with gunshot wounds to his face and neck. The assailants then fled the scene in a black vehicle of unknown make and registration.||Kaylon was rushed to Scarborough General Hospital where he is currently receiving medical treatment for his critical injuries. Police are investigating the home invasion and attempted murder.

Headline: Santa Cruz homicide: Man shot and dropped at hospital (Joneilio Thomas)
Street Address: Sam Boucaud area, Santa Cruz district
Location: PG7F+G9F Sam Boucaud, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 8:00 p.m. on Saturday, May 24th, 2025, officers from the North Eastern Division Task Force responded to reports of loud explosions in the Sam Boucaud area of Santa Cruz. Initial searches and interviews in the Joropo, Juniper, and Moraldo Streets areas yielded no leads.||Joneilio Thomas was shot during the incident and dropped off at Port of Spain General Hospital by an unidentified individual at approximately 7:55 p.m. The victim was pronounced dead at 8:05 p.m. The unknown man who brought him to the hospital left without providing any details about the shooting.||Police are investigating the circumstances of the shooting and the identity of the person who transported the victim to the hospital. The motive for the homicide remains under investigation.

Headline: Taxi driver Sheraz Ali missing, stabbed during altercation (27)
Street Address: Isolated location near Mosquito Creek, Anand Low Price Supermarket vicinity
Summary: 27-year-old Kyle Belcon of Coora Road, Siparia stabbed taxi driver Sheraz Ali twice during an altercation inside Ali's vehicle on May 23, 2025. Ali had dropped off female workers at Anand Low Price Supermarket at Mosquito Creek that morning when Belcon, who was also at the supermarket looking for employment, became a passenger in the vehicle.||After stabbing Ali twice, Belcon exited the vehicle at an isolated location and contacted someone for a ride, abandoning Ali's car at the scene. Belcon later turned himself in to police on Friday, May 23rd, accompanied by his mother, and admitted to the stabbing during the altercation.||Police are treating the case as a homicide and are actively searching for Ali's body. Investigators believe Belcon had contact with another person who picked him up from the isolated location after he fled the scene.

Headline: Man fatally stabbed during domestic altercation (Akil Sylvester, 36)
Summary: Akil Sylvester, 36, of Old Trainline Marabella, was fatally stabbed by a 16-year-old teenager during a violent domestic altercation at a home in Isaac Settlement, Couva on Friday, May 23, 2025 around 4:30 p.m. The incident began when the teenager's mother, a 35-year-old driver, returned home with Sylvester after meeting him in the Couva area.||An argument erupted upon arrival, during which Sylvester allegedly choked and assaulted the woman while armed with a cutlass. The teenager, witnessing the attack on his mother, armed himself with a knife and stabbed Sylvester multiple times in defense.||Sylvester collapsed in the living room and was found unresponsive in a pool of blood with multiple stab wounds to the head and back. The woman and her son reported the incident to Couva Police Station, and officers responded to confirm the man's death. The District Medical Officer visited the scene and authorized removal of the body for post-mortem examination at the Forensic Science Centre.

Headline: Burglary at vacant home in St. James (unknown contents stolen)
Location: MFG7+3VR Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Three men, including two masked intruders, broke into a vacant home at No. 32 Ranjit-Kumar Street in St. James on Friday night between 8:15 p.m. and 8:45 p.m. Two suspects wore masks—one in white, one in black—while the third was barefaced. They arrived in a burgundy Nissan Almera, scaled the wall and burglar-proofing, and forced entry through the back of the unlit, unoccupied house on the northeastern side.||The trio ransacked the premises and fled with a box of unknown contents, heading west in the same vehicle. The house belongs to a couple who resides in Canada.||Witnesses observed the entire incident from a nearby gallery. Police are investigating the burglary and searching for the three suspects. A cell phone was reportedly left behind at the scene.

Headline: Man stabbed in the head during bar fight (Tony Mark, 47)
Summary: Tony Mark, a 47-year-old from Caratal Road, Gasparillo, was stabbed multiple times in the head during a violent altercation at Sea View Bar, Kings Wharf, San Fernando, on Friday evening around 6:00 p.m. on May 23rd. The incident began when Mark got into an argument with his girlfriend at the bar. Shortly afterward, 56-year-old Dexter Augustus, a security officer from Parforce Road, Gasparillo, approached Mark armed with a glass bottle and allegedly ordered him to leave or be beaten.||When Mark hesitated, a scuffle broke out during which Augustus reportedly broke the bottle and stabbed Mark several times in the head. Mark was left bleeding heavily and standing on the roadway.||While on patrol, officers Ag/Cpl Huggins, PC Ramsaroop, and PC Marcus of the San Fernando Operations Unit observed Mark bleeding and took his report. Mark identified Augustus as the suspect, who was seen attempting to flee into a crowd. Officers gave chase and apprehended Augustus a short distance away.

Headline: Haagen-Dazs workers robbed at gunpoint during late-night heist
Street Address: Corner of Queens Park West and Dundonald Street, Haagen-Dazs Ice Cream outlet
Location: MF7P+JJ6 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 10:51 p.m. on Friday, May 23rd, two male suspects entered the Haagen-Dazs Ice Cream outlet located at the corner of Queens Park West and Dundonald Street in Port of Spain and announced a robbery. The suspects ordered all workers to lie on the ground and demanded cash, stating 'We want no phones, we want money.' A victim from Belmont Valley Road was among those present at the establishment during the robbery.||Both suspects fled the scene through the front entrance and proceeded south along Dundonald Street, escaping on foot. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: PH driver robbed and injured in violent daylight attack (63-year-old)
Street Address: Milton Road, near Backstage Bar at Isaac Junction
Summary: A 63-year-old PH driver was robbed and assaulted on Milton Road, Couva on Thursday, May 22, 2025 at approximately 3:00 p.m. The victim was parked near Backstage Bar at Isaac Junction when two men approached, posing as passengers and requesting a ride to Milton Road.||Upon reaching the destination, one suspect seated in the front passenger seat produced a firearm and announced a robbery. Police intercepted the vehicle shortly after on the highway in Chaguanas and arrested five suspects in connection with the incident.

Headline: Three foreign nationals attacked at Corbin Wildlife Center Bungalow—one injured, robbed
Street Address: Belmont Farm Road, Corbin Wildlife Center Bungalow
Summary: Three foreign nationals—two Irish female designers and one British male artist—were victims of a violent home invasion at the Corbin Wildlife Center Bungalow on Belmont Farm Road, Mason Hall, Tobago, around 11:00 p.m. on Thursday, May 22, 2025. The assailant gained entry through the southern front door and attacked the man with a cutlass, striking him in the head. The attacker robbed the male victim of his wallet containing TT$3,000, a driver's permit, and a credit card.||The two suspects, both described as slim-built and approximately 5 feet 11 inches tall, wearing black beanie hats and face masks, fled through a bushy area on the western side of the property. Headline: Woman targeted in broad daylight robbery by bandits in black Toyota Aqua
Street Address: Aranguez Main Road, in front of Aranguez Plaza (PSI Drugs)

Summary: A brazen robbery occurred on Thursday, May 22nd, 2025 along Aranguez Main Road in front of Aranguez Plaza (PSI Drugs). Headline: Armed robbery at vegetable shop with shots fired (39-year-old woman)

Headline: Partially blind pensioner robbed at gunpoint in wheelchair (65)
Summary: A 65-year-old partially blind pensioner was robbed at his home in Preysal Village, Couva on Wednesday, May 21, 2025 at approximately 9:30 p.m. The victim was seated in his wheelchair in his bedroom watching television when two unidentified men entered through an open front door.||One intruder pressed a cold object believed to be a weapon against the victim's left hand and demanded a pouch hidden under his pillow. The suspects made off with approximately TT$17,000 in cash, two gold wedding bands, and a mobile phone valued at TT$250.||The suspects exited through the front door and escaped. Headline: Champions Bar burgled in early morning break-in
Summary: Champions Bar on Rochard Road, Barrackpore was burgled in the early hours of Wednesday, May 21st, 2025. Headline: Venezuelan man shot and robbed during evening attack (26)
Summary: A 26-year-old Venezuelan man was shot and robbed around 6:40 PM on May 21, 2025, while entering the yard of his apartment building on Independence Avenue. Headline: Gunmen carjack Toyota Aqua at traffic light in San Fernando (37-year-old man)

Headline: Violent robbery at Siparia home—pensioner assaulted (79)

Headline: Man's vehicle stolen at ATM (30-year-old victim)

Headline: Amar Rooplal found with throat slit
Summary: Amar Rooplal was discovered dead on Cedar Hill Estate Road in Ste. Madeleine early on Tuesday morning, May 20th, 2025. Headline: Aranguez man's apartment ransacked, valuables stolen (28-year-old victim)

Headline: Vehicle burglary: Hybrid battery and valuables stolen from Toyota Aqua (PEB 1004)
Summary: Two men broke into a Toyota Aqua vehicle (Registration PEB 1004) in the Tabaquite area at approximately 3:40 AM on Tuesday, May 20, 2025. The suspects stole a hybrid battery, cash, jewelry, and other items from the vehicle.||CCTV footage captured the incident, showing one suspect shifting the camera upon noticing it, indicating deliberate evasion of surveillance.||The theft was reported and documented with video evidence available to authorities.

Headline: Social media entertainer Starks robbed and assaulted after car rammed by bandits

Summary: Social media entertainer Starks was robbed and assaulted by bandits who deliberately rammed his vehicle from behind on the John John Flyover on Tuesday, May 20th, 2025. Headline: Shots fired at vehicle in Tunapuna (37-year-old man)

Headline: Man loses $75,000 to vehicle theft at Xtra Foods carpark
Summary: On Monday, May 19, 2025, at approximately 3:30 PM, a 59-year-old man from Cunupia parked his vehicle at Xtra Foods Carpark in Xtra Plaza, Endeavour, after withdrawing $75,000 cash from Scotia Bank at Price Plaza.||When he returned to his vehicle approximately one hour later, he discovered the right front passenger door glass had been shattered and the cash was missing from inside the vehicle.||The man reported the theft to police, and investigations are ongoing to identify the perpetrators and recover the stolen funds.

Headline: Man shot on Munroe Road (Mikhail John Pollai, 36)

Summary: At approximately 9:30 PM on May 19, 2025, 36-year-old Mikhail John Pollai was walking west along Munroe Road in Cunupia, heading to the Munroe Road Mosque for prayer. Upon reaching Marshall Trace, he heard a loud explosion and realized he had been shot.||Pollai ran to the nearby Low Cost Supermarket where he sought assistance from persons in the area. He was injured by the gunshot wound.||Police were notified and the injured man was conveyed to Chaguanas District Health Facility for medical examination before being transferred to Mt Hope Hospital for further treatment. Headline: Armed men rob passengers and driver in maxi taxi (41-year-old driver, multiple passengers)

He pointed the weapon at the driver and passengers, demanding money and valuables. The second suspect was identified as Ezekiel John, also of Upper 7th Avenue, Malick.||The victims surrendered various items including a black mobile phone ($800), $350 in cash, gold earrings, a Samsung S9+ ($2,000), and an additional $95 in cash. The suspects fled on foot through the tunnel.||Police responded and arrested both men moments later while they were heading home. A loaded firearm was recovered during the arrest.

Headline: Man gunned down in Belmont (Michael Duncan, 42)
Location: MGF2+243 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Michael Duncan, 42, was found slumped over the steering wheel of his silver Nissan Almera (registration PCE 2370) after police responded to reports of loud explosions in the Belmont Valley Road area around 9:55 PM on Monday, May 19, 2025. Duncan had parked in front of his home at #3 Lucien Road and was still seated in his vehicle when several gunshots were fired.||His 25-year-old common-law wife was inside their house when she heard the explosions. Upon checking outside, she discovered Duncan unresponsive in the driver's seat with gunshot wounds to his body.||Officers from the Belmont Police Station responded to the scene and the District Medical Officer examined Duncan and officially pronounced him dead. Headline: Shooting Incident near Tumpuna Road gas station (victim unidentified)
Summary: Shots were fired near Tumpuna Road gas station in Arima on Monday, May 19th, targeting a victim at the location. Headline: Armed robbery at Scarborough facility; firearm and jewellery stolen (Estate constable)

Headline: Armed robber targets panel van and teen in Petit Valley ($17,500 heist)

Headline: Four cutlass-wielding intruders assault and rob Penal family, steal valuables

One intruder, described as approximately 5 feet 6 inches tall and slim, dragged a 38-year-old occupant off his bed, declaring "I come to kill you!" before dealing him several blows and stealing a Stihl FS 85 grass trimmer worth $4,000 TT.||The other three suspects, also armed and masked, robbed the remaining victims, including a 62-year-old woman, a 31-year-old woman, and a 12-year-old girl, taking several cell phones, a wallet containing ID and cash, a tablet, and two laptops.||After the assault, the suspects escaped through a door on the southern side of the house and fled into a nearby bushy area. Headline: Armed robbery at tent rental business; seven family members assaulted and robbed (64-year-old delivery driver, 47-year-old boss, wife, four children)

Headline: Chaguanas couple bound and doused with gasoline in home invasion (65-year-old woman, 51-year-old farmer)

Police are continuing investigations into this violent robbery.

Headline: Hyundai Elantra stolen overnight in Diamond Vale

Summary: A silver/grey Hyundai Elantra with registration number PDD 4929 was stolen overnight from a residence on Semper Avenue in Diamond Vale, Diego Martin. Headline: Man gunned down inside car (Stefon Joseph, 33)

Headline: Attempted murder in Belmont caught on camera (Jakiah George, alias 'Georgie')

Headline: Man shot near home in Matura (Elvis Superville, 30)

Headline: Fruit vendor 'Boyie' killed during armed home invasion (Ville Junior Blair, 25)
Summary: Ville Junior Blair, 25, known as 'Boyie', was shot dead during a home invasion at his residence on 10th Street, Techier Village, Point Fortin around 11:55 p.m. on Saturday, May 17, 2025. Blair and his 33-year-old girlfriend were in the bedroom when three armed men wearing ski masks and dark clothing forced their way in, demanding cash and valuables.||The assailants robbed the girlfriend of a Cuban gold chain valued at $20,000, a gold slave band worth $15,000, and $140 in cash. One suspect reportedly said 'Spare she' before all three gunmen turned their firearms on Blair and shot him multiple times, leaving him fatally wounded.||The three suspects fled the scene on foot, heading east and then north along 10th Street. Police are investigating the incident and searching for the armed robbers.

Headline: Vendor arrested after chopping incident (Samuel Baptiste, 56)
Summary: On Saturday, May 17, 2025, at approximately 2:15 p.m., an argument erupted at Argyle Waterfall between vendor Shawn Parsienne and 56-year-old Samuel Baptiste over entrance fees. Parsienne objected to Baptiste crossing the river with approximately five other individuals without paying the required entrance fee, claiming it would negatively impact his livelihood.||The disagreement escalated into a physical altercation between the two men. During the incident, Parsienne allegedly grabbed his cutlass and inflicted several chops on Baptiste.||Parsienne claimed he acted in self-defense during the confrontation. He was subsequently arrested in connection with the assault.

Headline: Man stabbed multiple times in jealous rage attack (Daron Weeks, 44)
Summary: Daron Weeks, a 44-year-old labourer of 6th Company Road, New Grant, was walking along Bonne Aventure Road in Gasparillo around 1:20 p.m. on Friday when he was confronted by a man from Mappapire Road, Whiteland. The suspect accused Weeks of "watching his wife" before launching a knife attack, stabbing Weeks multiple times in the back.||Weeks managed to disarm the suspect and fled to the Gasparillo Police Station, where he reported the incident to police.||Responding officers, including PC Meah, later encountered the suspect walking along Bonne Aventure Road and arrested him. During the arrest, the suspect resisted and assaulted the officer, damaging his Motorola G5 cellphone valued at $2,500.

Headline: Woman stabbed in head after dispute over accidental foot injury (66)
Location: MF2R+PQP Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 66-year-old woman was stabbed in the head on Charlotte Street near Queen Street in Port of Spain on Friday night around 7 p.m. The incident began when a man accidentally stepped on her foot while she was walking; she informed him of the injury and requested an apology.||The man became angry at her complaint, drew a knife, and stabbed her in the head before fleeing on foot. The assault appeared to stem from a minor dispute that escalated unexpectedly.||The victim was hospitalized in serious condition following the attack. Police responded to the incident and are investigating the circumstances and searching for the suspect.

Headline: Bandits strike at KFC
Summary: A KFC fast food franchise in Montrose was robbed by two masked gunmen on Friday, May 16, 2025. The suspects made off with an undisclosed sum of money from the establishment.||The exact circumstances of the robbery and the amount stolen have not been disclosed by authorities.||Police are investigating the incident and searching for the two suspects involved.

Headline: Form 5 student Zwade Alleyne, 17, shot dead in Maloney
Summary: Zwade Alleyne, a 17-year-old Form 5 student from Arima North Secondary School, was shot in the head during a shooting incident at Building 12, Maloney on May 10, 2025 at approximately 10:45 pm. Armed men emerged from the southern side of the car park and fired multiple shots at the victim and others on the third floor. The victim was struck by a gunshot to the head and was transported to Arima General Hospital where he was placed on life support in critical condition.||Alleyne succumbed to his injuries on May 15, 2025, five days after the shooting. The severity of the head wound proved fatal despite medical intervention.||Police responded to the scene and recovered 15 spent 9mm shell casings during the crime scene investigation. A search of the area was conducted but the armed suspects fled on foot and were not apprehended. The motive for the shooting remains under investigation.

Headline: Businessman Mario Maraj fatally shot at Orange Field Road
Summary: A businessman identified as Mario Maraj was fatally shot at Mungal Trace on Orange Field Road on May 15, 2025. The incident occurred moments before police arrived at the scene.||Mario was pronounced dead at the location following the shooting.||Police are currently investigating the homicide and working to determine the motive and identify suspects responsible for the fatal shooting.

Headline: Man robbed of vehicle at casino (35)
Street Address: Royal Princess Casino, Price Plaza, Chaguanas / Narsaloo Ramaya Road, Chaguanas
Summary: A 35-year-old man from Lange Park was approached by four men outside Royal Princess Casino at Price Plaza, Chaguanas between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM. The suspects announced a robbery and forcibly took the victim's black Hyundai Tucson before fleeing the scene along Narsaloo Ramaya Road.||The victim's wallet containing his ID Card and driver's permit was inside the stolen vehicle at the time of the robbery.||Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: One injured in drive-by shooting in Union Village, Mayaro
Summary: A man was shot during a drive-by shooting at Union Village in Mayaro on Thursday, May 15th, 2025. The victim sustained gunshot wounds during the incident.||The victim was rushed to the Mayaro District Health Facility, where he was stabilized before being transferred to the Sangre Grande Hospital for further treatment. His condition and identity were not disclosed in the report.||Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the drive-by shooting.

Headline: Customer robbed of $50,000 after leaving Republic Bank (amount unknown)
Street Address: Republic Bank Center City branch, mall parkade
Summary: A customer was robbed of more than $50,000 immediately after leaving the Republic Bank Center City branch on May 15, 2025. The brazen robbery occurred in the mall's parkade, catching patrons off guard.||The victim lost cash totaling over $50,000 during the attack.||Authorities are actively investigating the incident to identify the perpetrators and recover the stolen funds.

Headline: Rio Claro man shot while riding bicycle (Fared Mohammed, 25)
Summary: Fared Mohammed, a 25-year-old man, was shot while riding his bicycle near a vegetable stall in Union Village, Rio Claro on Thursday night around 9 p.m. Mohammed heard a loud explosion and immediately felt a burning sensation in his back as he was struck by gunfire.||Despite sustaining a gunshot wound, Mohammed managed to ride home where he discovered he had been shot. He was quickly taken to the Mayaro Health Facility for emergency medical treatment.||Police are investigating the shooting incident. The motive and identity of the shooter remain unknown at this time.

Headline: Taxi driver robbed and assaulted by two men (53-year-old)
Street Address: Lord and Mucurapo Street, corner; Independence Avenue vicinity Rushworth Street; Corinth Junction
Summary: Around 9:30 PM on May 14, 2025, a 53-year-old taxi driver was robbed and assaulted while plying his car for hire at the corner of Lord and Mucurapo Street in San Fernando. Two men approached posing as passengers, with one entering the front seat and the other the back seat. They requested to be taken to Golconda by the traffic lights.||Upon reaching Independence Avenue near Rushworth Street, the rear passenger produced a firearm, pointed it at the driver's head, and ordered him to drive. As the victim turned onto Corinth Junction, the suspects immobilized the vehicle and a physical struggle erupted.||The suspects dealt the victim several blows about the body before forcibly removing him from the vehicle and fleeing the scene with the taxi. The victim reported the incident to police and used the vehicle's GPS tracking system to shut down the car remotely.

Headline: Five miscreants attempt home invasion in Kelly Village
Location: HJPM+3XM Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Five individuals attempted a brazen home invasion at a residential property in Kelly Village early on Wednesday, May 14th, 2025. CCTV footage captured the men canvassing the property and searching for entry points to gain unauthorized access to the home.||The residents became aware of the attempted intrusion and raised an alarm, which prompted the five suspects to immediately flee the scene without completing the invasion.||Police are investigating the incident. No arrests have been reported at this time.

Headline: Businessman's daughter narrowly escapes attempted assassination (Lisa Maharaj)
Summary: Lisa Maharaj, daughter of the owner of R&J Cell Store at Gulf City Mall in San Fernando, was targeted by armed men in a white vehicle who attempted to ram her SUV off the road on Tuesday, May 13th, 2025. As rain poured, the suspects struck her vehicle from behind, and when she began to reverse, the attackers' car reversed as well, indicating deliberate intent rather than an accident.||One of the armed suspects attempted to open her SUV door while two shots were fired at the vehicle, with one bullet entering the driver's door and narrowly missing Maharaj. She immediately locked her doors and drove directly to the police station to report the incident.||The nature of the attack—whether a kidnapping attempt or assassination attempt—remains unclear. Maharaj recounted the terrifying moments during a live phone interview with Crime Watch host Ian Alleyne just hours after the incident, describing her fear and the deliberate actions of the attackers.

Headline: Masked gunman opens fire in Santa Cruz (Burey Ghany, 45)
Street Address: Orange Field Road, La Pastora Road, Santa Cruz
Summary: A 45-year-old man, Burey Ghany, was shot and wounded outside his home on Orange Field Road, La Pastora Road, Santa Cruz on May 13th, 2025 at approximately 2:50 PM. The victim had just parked his silver-grey Kia Cerato and allowed his children to exit the vehicle when he heard several loud explosions and felt burning sensations in his left leg and right abdomen before falling to the ground.||Ghany sustained gunshot wounds to both his left leg and right abdomen. Family members immediately rushed him to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex where he was treated for his injuries.||Police responded to reports of loud explosions at Orange Field Road around 3:20 PM. The suspect is described as a male wearing a black T-shirt, black long jeans, and a black mask, armed with a firearm. The investigation is ongoing with no arrests reported at the time of publication.

Headline: Man shot in Cocoyea
Street Address: Corner of Allamby Street and Naparima Mayaro Road
Summary: A man from Ste Madeline was shot and wounded at the corner of Allamby Street and Naparima Mayaro Road, Cocoyea, around 10:25 pm on May 13th, 2025. The victim was discovered lying on the road with a single gunshot wound to his back.||Residents, including one named Everton, reported hearing a loud explosion and observed a silver Nissan Almera with partial registration PBJ speeding away eastward toward St. Clement's Junction immediately after the incident.||Emergency Health Services personnel responded and transported the victim to San Fernando General Hospital (SFGH) for medical treatment. Police are investigating the shooting and the circumstances surrounding the incident.

Headline: Body of alleged drug dealer discovered with gunshot wound (late 50s, unidentified)
Street Address: Western Main Road, Paragon Sports and Cultural Club #245, seashore behind compound
Location: MCHX+4R6 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police discovered the body of an unidentified man near the Paragon Sports and Cultural Club at #245 Western Main Road, Cocorite on Tuesday, May 13th, 2025 at approximately 10:20 am. The caretaker of the club found the body around 9:00 am while walking along the seashore behind the compound, lying motionless on his back with a gunshot wound.||The victim was described as a man of African descent appearing to be in his late fifties, slim-built with greying hair, dressed in a green jersey and black ¾ pants. Sources revealed the victim lived in a shack on the beach and was known to sell cocaine to high-class clients, raising suspicions of a possible drug-related killing.||Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death and the identity of the victim. The motive appears to be drug-related based on the victim's known activities.

Headline: Couple robbed and assaulted at salon (both 18)
Street Address: El Soccoro Main Road, Steamy Styles Salon and Barber Shop
Location: JGXX+W76 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 11:35 AM on Thursday, February 5, 2026, a couple both aged 18 were at Steamy Styles Salon and Barber Shop along El Soccoro Main Road, San Juan, when three men entered the establishment. One suspect stood at the doorway while the other two approached the 18-year-old male victim and snatched his $10,000 gold chain from his neck.||The suspects then assaulted the teen, dealing him several blows that caused him to fall off the salon chair. They subsequently robbed his girlfriend of her Samsung A33 cell phone.||The three suspects fled the scene on foot and escaped. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Vehicle shot at in drive-by attack (55-year-old woman)
Street Address: Paradise Heights Morvant, Building A (residential area near bushy area)
Location: MG3F+38V Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 5:50 pm on Tuesday, May 13, 2025, a 55-year-old woman was at her home in Paradise Heights, Morvant when she heard several loud explosions. She and her husband went onto the veranda and discovered their red Nissan Note parked opposite Building A near a bushy area had been targeted.||The vehicle sustained significant damage with the right front door glass and left rear passenger glass shattered by gunfire. A car was seen fleeing the area immediately after the gunshots were heard.||Spent shell casings were recovered at the scene. Police are investigating the incident and the motive behind the attack on the vehicle.

Headline: Woman shot in face at home (Crystal Rosalia, 38)
Summary: Crystal Rosalia, 38, of Building 15, 1-3 South Maloney was shot in the face while in her bathroom at approximately 9:50 PM on May 12, 2025. She felt a burning sensation to her face and realized she had been shot, immediately raising an alarm.||Rosalia was transported to Arima Hospital for initial treatment before being transferred to Mt Hope Hospital for further medical care.||Police from the Northern Division Task Force responded to the scene and initiated an investigation into the incident. The circumstances surrounding the shooting and identity of the shooter remain under investigation.

Headline: Valencia Woman sexually assaulted by ex-boyfriend (21)
Summary: A 21-year-old Valencia woman reported being sexually assaulted by her ex-boyfriend in the early hours of May 12, 2025, around 3:00 a.m. while she was asleep at her home. The suspect allegedly entered her bedroom and forced her to perform oral sex; the victim bit him in resistance, causing him to bleed. Despite this, he allegedly proceeded to have non-consensual sexual intercourse with her while choking her and making threats.||The victim reported the incident to police around 10:05 p.m. the same day. The District Medical Officer was contacted and arrangements were made for the victim to undergo a medical examination to document the assault.

Headline: Isaiah Sorzano "Pablo" shot and killed in Penal (19)
Summary: Isaiah Sorzano, also known as "Pablo," a 19-year-old labourer of Alvarado Avenue, Penal, was gunned down on Sunday morning, May 11th, 2025 at approximately 7:35 am on Sunrees Road, Penal. Officers from the Penal Police Station responded to reports of loud explosions at Harrilal Avenue and discovered Sorzano's body lying on his back in a pool of blood on the southern side of the roadway with apparent gunshot wounds.||Sorzano had left his home around 7:27 am, telling relatives he was going to a nearby supermarket. Shortly after, residents heard several loud explosions and saw two unidentified men picking up money near Sorzano's motionless body before fleeing the scene.||Crime Scene Investigators from Homicide Region Three photographed and processed the area, retrieving nine 5.56 spent shells. The investigation is ongoing as police search for the two unidentified suspects.

Headline: Male murdered in forested area (Adisa Marshall, 25)
Summary: An male (Adisa Marshall, 25) was discovered murdered on May 11, 2025, at approximately 4:45 PM along La Orange Trace in a forested area of Aripo Village. The body was found lying on his back on the roadway by a man who was hiking with his girlfriend and dog. The victim was a male of African descent, approximately 30 years old, with tattoos on both ankles and the length of his right arm.||The victim was dressed in a white vest, ¾ jeans with pockets turned out, dark-colored underwear, and mismatched slippers. A spent 9mm shell casing was recovered near the body, indicating the victim was shot.||The scene was processed by SERU officers and the District Medical Officer conducted a pronouncement at the scene. The victim remains unidentified and police continue their investigation into the circumstances and motive of the murder.

Headline: Two men robbed at gunpoint on Foster Road (ages 25, 34)
Street Address: Foster Road, St. Joseph Road, Laventille
Location: MF2X+4QH Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A robbery with aggravation occurred on Foster Road in Laventille on the evening of May 11, 2025, at approximately 7:30 PM. Two victims, ages 25 and 34, were driving a burgundy Toyota NZE when they stopped in an area along Foster Road after following GPS directions. Two men of African descent approached the vehicle, with one suspect armed with a firearm who ordered the victims out at gunpoint.||The victims complied with the armed suspect's demands. The suspect entered the vehicle and drove off with it, along with personal belongings including wallets containing cash totaling $2,500 TT, identification cards, and two Samsung cell phones valued at approximately $2,700 TT combined.||The stolen burgundy Toyota NZE, valued at $35,000 TT, was later recovered in Clifton Circular. Police are investigating the incident and searching for the two suspects.

Headline: Armed Robbery at Hakka Express - Two Employees Robbed at Gunpoint
Street Address: Corner of College and Watts Street, Hakka Ltd (Hakka Express)
Location: JJQ2+3CJ St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two employees were robbed at gunpoint on Sunday, May 11, 2025 at approximately 4:00 PM at Hakka Ltd, located at the corner of College and Watts Street, St. Augustine. The incident began when two men of African descent entered the establishment and became involved in a dispute with an employee over food. During the altercation, one suspect brandished an L-shaped object resembling a firearm and pointed it at both the employee and manager, announcing a robbery.||The two victims were forced to lie on the floor and complied with the robbers' demands. One suspect jumped over the counter and took $2,244 in cash from the register, along with the company's Redmi 9c cellphone and the manager's Samsung A20s cellphone.||Police are investigating the incident. The suspects were described as two slim-built men of African descent: one approximately 5'7" tall, 140 lbs, wearing a white hat and light-colored jersey; the other approximately 5'9" tall, 160 lbs, wearing a black T-shirt and long black jeans.

Headline: Woman stabbed to death in domestic dispute with ex-husband (Wendy Betrand)
Street Address: Bowen Trace, Snake Valley, St. Barb's, Laventille
Location: MG65+C5H Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Wendy Betrand was stabbed to death during a domestic altercation with her ex-common law husband, Roger, at Bowen Trace, Snake Valley, St. Barb's, Laventille on May 11, 2025, around 6:45 AM. Roger inflicted multiple stab wounds to her neck, chest, and arms before fleeing the scene.||The victim was found slumped on the floor in a room on the northeastern side of the house by responding officers Ag/Cpl Dennis and PC Lalla of the Besson Street Police Station. She was rushed to the Port of Spain General Hospital, where she was pronounced dead at 7:36 AM.||The suspect, Roger, was taken into police custody following the incident. The case remains under investigation.

Headline: Venezuelan woman kidnapped at Double Palm Inn (Anyeliz Maria Laverde Velasquez, 25)
Street Address: Double Palm Inn car park, Derrick Road, Chase Village; Carli Bay Road, Couva
Summary: On Sunday, May 11, 2025, at approximately 8:30 PM, 25-year-old Anyeliz Maria Laverde Velasquez of Deonarine Road, Mc Bean, Couva, was kidnapped from the Double Palm Inn car park along Derrick Road, Chase Village. Her driver dropped her off to meet a friend, but observed her entering a black Toyota Aqua and heard her calling for help as the vehicle sped away from the compound.||Shortly after the kidnapping, the driver received phone calls from two numbers (296-1621 and 705-1972) demanding a $5,000 ransom for Velasquez's release. Arrangements were made to pay the ransom.||Around 10:00 PM that same night, the driver went to Carli Bay Road, Couva, to deliver the ransom money, where he was confronted by two men, one armed with a firearm. The armed suspect pointed the gun at the driver and announced a robbery, taking the $5,000 cash before both suspects fled the scene. Subsequent attempts to contact the kidnappers and locate Velasquez have been unsuccessful.

Headline: Valencia man shot and wounded in early-morning attack (Anderson Weekes, 41)
Street Address: Oro Street, La Platta KP Lands
Summary: Anderson Weekes, 41, of Gill Street, Valencia, was shot and wounded in what police suspect was a targeted attack on Oro Street, La Platta KP Lands around 3:15 AM on Sunday, May 11th, 2025. Two masked individuals dressed in black hoodies approached Weekes as he sat in his vehicle and opened fire, striking him in the left ring finger.||Weekes managed to exit the vehicle and fled to the nearby Backstage Bar, where a friend assisted him and transported him to Sangre Grande Hospital for treatment of his gunshot wound.||Police officers attended the scene and initiated investigations into the incident. Weekes declined to provide a statement to police regarding the circumstances of the attack.

Headline: Couple robbed at gunpoint after arranging car purchase online
Street Address: Corner of Prince Street and Clarence Trace, Valencia
Summary: Two people were robbed at gunpoint on Sunday, May 11, 2025, at the corner of Prince Street and Clarence Trace in Valencia after arranging to purchase a car through Facebook. The victims arrived at approximately 2:15 PM to meet the seller when they were approached by a man who told them the car seller would arrive shortly.||A second man then approached brandishing a firearm and announced a robbery. The suspect stole $25,000 in cash and a white iPhone valued at $1,700 from the male victim, as well as a white Samsung Galaxy A15 valued at $1,300, a purse containing $350, and several bank cards from the female victim.||The suspect fled the scene immediately after the robbery. Officers PC Rattansingh, PC Harrinanan, and PC Glasgow from the Valencia Police District attended the scene and conducted inquiries into the incident.

Headline: Cell phone seller robbed and beaten in Facebook Marketplace transaction (Tunapuna resident)
Street Address: George Street Plannings (second floor apartment), near Prince Street
Location: MF3V+83X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A resident of Pasea Road, Tunapuna, arranged to meet a man known as 'Marcel' via Facebook Messenger to sell an iPhone 13 Pro Max on Saturday, May 10, 2025, at approximately 2:30 PM. The victim was lured to an apartment on the second floor of the George Street Plannings building in Port of Spain under the pretense of visiting Marcel's cellular store.||Once inside the apartment, the victim was accosted by four men, one of whom was armed with a firearm. The group violently beat the victim during the robbery.||The perpetrators stole jewelry valued at $8,870 TTD, $500 in cash, and two iPhones (a 13 Pro Max and a 12, each valued at $4,500 TTD), for a total loss of approximately $13,370 TTD. Police investigation into the incident is ongoing.

Headline: Santa Cruz teen robbed by three men (19)
Street Address: Old St Joseph Road, near Riverside Carpark, opposite Besson Street Police Station
Location: JGW4+MVM Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 19-year-old resident of Homeslead Gardens, Santa Cruz, was robbed with aggravation on Saturday, May 10, 2025, at approximately 9:40 pm while walking along Old St Joseph Road in Port of Spain. The teen was walking with two friends when he was accosted by three men near the Riverside Carpark, directly opposite the Besson Street Police Station.||The suspects announced a holdup and robbed the victim of his iPhone 12 Pro, valued at $8,000 TTD. The suspects then fled the scene in the direction of a nearby Plannings.||Police responded to the incident and are investigating the robbery.

Headline: Robbery suspect caught after chase in Arima (34-year-old woman)
Street Address: Sanchez Street near Naipaul Books store
Summary: A 34-year-old woman from Peytonville, Arima was robbed on Sanchez Street near Naipaul Books store at approximately 3:50 PM. As she exited her vehicle, a man of Spanish descent, described as light brown in complexion, medium build, and approximately 5 feet 5 inches tall, approached her aggressively. The suspect snatched her Samsung S10 Plus cell phone valued at $2,800.00 TTD and her purple purse containing identification card, driver's permit, bank cards, and $399.00 TTD in cash.||The suspect fled westward along Sanchez Street after the robbery. The victim immediately raised an alarm, and several bystanders gave chase to apprehend the suspect.

Headline: Two brothers stabbed in late-night altercation in Speyside (Daylon Crooks, 37; Aloy Crooks, 40)
Summary: Two brothers, Daylon Crooks (37) and Aloy Crooks (40), both residents of Speyside, Tobago, were stabbed during a violent altercation around 10:45 PM on Saturday, May 10, 2025. The incident began when a man known as "Leebeck" slapped 49-year-old Allan Taylor, who retaliated with a slap in return. After Leebeck left the scene, the Crooks brothers confronted Taylor and began pelting bottles at him.||In self-defense, Taylor, who was armed with a knife, stabbed Daylon under his left armpit and Aloy in the abdomen. Both injured men were transported to Roxborough Hospital where they were stabilized, then transferred to Scarborough General Hospital for further treatment.||A suspect was arrested in connection with the incident. Police are continuing their investigation into the circumstances surrounding the altercation.

Headline: Teenager fights off intruder during attempted robbery (19-year-old)
Street Address: Ibis Street, Fanny Village, Point Fortin
Summary: A 19-year-old resident of Ibis Street, Fanny Village, Point Fortin was awakened in his apartment at approximately 5:00 pm on May 10, 2025 by an unknown man demanding his belongings. The suspect, described as approximately 5 feet 8 inches tall with light brown complexion, wearing a grey t-shirt and short pants, pulled a knife from his back pocket and attempted to stab the victim.||A violent struggle ensued outside the apartment door during which the victim bit the suspect on the hand and managed to wrestle the knife away. The fight continued until the victim stabbed the suspect in the stomach, forcing the suspect to flee the scene.||The victim reported the incident to Point Fortin Police Station at approximately 5:45 pm the same day. Police are investigating the attempted robbery and assault.

Headline: Violent home invasion and rape in Claxton Bay (20-year-old female)
Summary: A 20-year-old woman was approached by two armed men around midnight on May 10, 2025, as she was returning to her apartment in Claxton Bay. The first suspect, described as dark-complexioned and mixed descent approximately 5'6" tall, was armed with a firearm. The second suspect was brown-complexioned, slim build, approximately 6 feet tall, and wore a face mask. The suspects announced a hold-up and forced the victim into her apartment at gunpoint.||Once inside, the suspects ransacked the apartment and tied the victim to a mattress. The first suspect then sexually assaulted the victim by forcibly having intercourse with her. After the assault, both suspects fled the scene with an undisclosed amount of cash, gold jewelry, and a Samsung Note 20 cell phone.||Police are investigating the violent home invasion, robbery, and sexual assault. The victim reported the incident to authorities, and the investigation is ongoing.

Headline: Man fatally shot in Pinto (Israel Assing, 25)
Street Address: Hoyte Avenue and 1st Avenue, Pinto Road
Summary: Israel Assing, a 25-year-old resident of Savannah Drive, Pinto, was fatally shot on the night of May 10, 2025 at approximately 11:20 pm. Police officers PC Gransom, PC Walters, and WPC Marcano arrived at Hoyte Avenue and 1st Avenue, Pinto Road after receiving a report of a shooting and found Assing lying on his right side with a gunshot wound to the right side of his head.||Residents in the area reported hearing loud explosions around 11:00 pm and discovered the victim lying motionless in an incomplete concrete structure. Assing was clad in a black long-sleeve hoodie, black joggers, and blue slippers at the time of discovery.||The District Medical Officer pronounced the victim dead at the scene and ordered the body's removal. Police investigation into the circumstances and motive of the shooting is ongoing.

Headline: Taxi driver's vehicle stolen during confrontation (49-year-old)
Street Address: Eleanor Street Extension, Couva Taxi Stand
Summary: A 49-year-old taxi driver from Las Lomas was plying for hire at the Couva Taxi Stand on Eleanor Street Extension, Chaguanas on Saturday, May 10th, 2025 around 11:45 AM. He left his white Nissan Tiida idling and unlocked while briefly searching for passengers.||During this time, a man known to the victim as 'Fat Boy' attempted to enter the driver's side of the vehicle. When the driver confronted the suspect, a struggle ensued, and the suspect managed to push the victim aside before driving off in the vehicle.||The stolen car was last seen heading south on Eleanor Extension and onto Ramsaran Street. 22-year-old Akil Mawusi, also known as Fatboy of Moonstone Crescent Edinburgh 500, was subsequently arrested and the vehicle was recovered.

Headline: Employee stabbed to death at El Socorro business (Maurice Grant)
Street Address: El Socorro Main Road, Super Wholesalers and Distributors Limited car park
Location: JGWX+CQX San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Maurice Grant, a 45-year-old labourer employed at Super Wholesalers and Distributors Limited, was fatally stabbed in broad daylight on Friday, May 9th, 2025 at approximately 12:35 pm in the car park on El Socorro Main Road. Grant was discovered lying on his back with visible stab wounds to his neck and chest. Around 11:50 am, Grant had been seen walking into the car park appearing agitated and arguing with himself, according to police reports.||Shortly after his arrival, several vehicles were observed speeding out of the area at high speed. Grant was found bleeding on the ground and was pronounced dead at the scene.||An anonymous caller contacted the Barataria Police Station to report the stabbing incident. Police responded and discovered Grant's lifeless body along with a black "Trans by Jansport" bag and a 20oz Schweppes Ginger Ale plastic bottle nearby. The investigation into the motive and identity of the perpetrator is ongoing.

Headline: Early morning robbery: couple accosted near Foreshore along Audrey Jeffers Highway
Street Address: Foreshore along Audrey Jeffers Highway, St James
Location: MF97+594 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 1:30 AM on Friday, May 9, 2025, a St. Joseph man and a woman were seated in a white Nissan Tiida (reg. PCX 3351) at the Foreshore along Audrey Jeffers Highway in St James when they were accosted by three armed men. The suspects announced a robbery and relieved the victims of the vehicle, a brown side bag containing $3,200 TTD, the man's wallet, and a Samsung A05 cell phone.||The suspects then fled the scene in the victim's vehicle, which appeared to be moving in convoy with a black Hyundai Tucson.||Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Two siblings assaulted with cutlass (Elija Jack, Atiba Jack)
Street Address: Mt. St George main road, near Dudes man Bar, Castara Road
Summary: On May 9th, 2025 around 10:00 PM, siblings Elija Jack and Atiba Jack were liming near Dudes man Bar along the Mt. St George main road when a man known as Joshua (aka Moody) and Abraham approached and started arguing with Elija about a bag of iguanas.||An altercation ensued during which Moody drew a cutlass from his waist and chopped Elija multiple times about his body. Atiba intervened to help his brother but was also attacked, sustaining chops to his head and right arm.||The injured duo fled the scene and sought medical attention at Scarborough General Hospital. Police are investigating the assault and the identities of the assailants.

Headline: La Horquetta man fatally stabbed after domestic dispute (Peter Dandass, 61)
Street Address: 2117 Winifred Atwell Drive, Phase 2, La Horquetta
Summary: Peter Dandass, 61, was fatally stabbed during a domestic altercation at his home on Winifred Atwell Drive, Phase 2, La Horquetta on Friday, May 9, 2025 at approximately 3:30 AM. Dandass had returned home in an intoxicated state and became aggressive during an argument with his wife, Althea Valerie James, and 28-year-old Ayinka Athea Dandass. During the dispute, Dandass armed himself with a cutlass, which led to an altercation resulting in a single stab wound to his chest.||Dandass was rushed to Arima Hospital at approximately 4:25 AM but was pronounced dead five minutes later while undergoing treatment.||The suspect was arrested at the hospital and remains under medical observation. Investigators recovered a brown-handled knife with a silver blade, a brown-handled cutlass, and a pair of blue jeans stained with blood from the scene.

Headline: Intruder attacks homeowner after being caught sleeping in car
Summary: A South Oropouche woman discovered a man sleeping inside her green motor car around 6:30 a.m. on Friday, May 9th, 2025, while preparing for work. Her stepfather alerted her to the intruder who was asleep in the driver's seat.||When confronted about his presence, the man responded defiantly with "Wah is all yuh problem?" before launching a physical attack on a male homeowner at the residence.||During the ensuing struggle, the woman struck the intruder three times with a piece of iron, causing a significant head injury. The intruder was subdued and the incident was reported to authorities.

Headline: Man robbed of gold chain and iPhone in Woodbrook (Shaun Cyrus)
Street Address: Ariapita Avenue near Rosalino Street, Woodbrook
Location: MF7F+2XR Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Shaun Cyrus was seated in his grey Hyundai Tucson parked on Ariapita Avenue near Rosalino Street, Woodbrook when he was robbed around 11:15 p.m. on Friday, May 9, 2025. A male suspect of dark complexion, wearing a grey jersey and black pants, snatched a gold chain valued at $30,000 TT from Cyrus's neck and an iPhone 16 valued at $8,000 TT from his hand.||The suspect then fled west along the roadway with the stolen items. The total value of items stolen was approximately $38,000 TT.||Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Man attacked with chopper by girlfriend's ex-boyfriend (38)
Summary: Around 8:20 a.m. on May 9, 2025, a 38-year-old man from Edinburgh Chaguanas was asleep with his 26-year-old girlfriend at her home on the second floor of Capildeo Block, Couva. They were awakened by Javed Solomon, the woman's ex-boyfriend, who was armed with a silver chopper with a brown wooden handle. Solomon grabbed the male victim and a physical altercation ensued as the terrified woman fled the room.||During the struggle, Solomon inflicted several chop wounds on the victim before fleeing the scene in his silver AD wagon, registration number PBX 6028. The victim was taken to the Couva Health Facility and then transferred to the San Fernando General Hospital, where he remained in stable condition.||Solomon was later arrested and taken to the Couva Police Station for questioning regarding the assault.

Headline: Man shot and wounded on St. Paul Street (Tiquan Williams, 20s)
Street Address: St. Paul Street East, East Dry River, Port of Spain
Location: MF2X+C4V Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Tiquan Williams of Clifton Hill, East Dry River, was shot and wounded at St. Paul Street in East Dry River, Port of Spain around 9:20 p.m. on May 9, 2025. A female motorist heard gunshots in the area and spotted Williams on the roadway, flagging down a police patrol team from the IATF who were patrolling Besson Street.||With assistance from Williams' mother, officers transported the wounded man to Port of Spain General Hospital where he was treated for gunshot wounds to his left hand and groin.||When questioned by police, Williams stated he did not know who shot him but described the suspect as a man of African descent with medium build and dark complexion, wearing a red and white striped jersey and blue three-quarter pants. The investigation into the shooting is ongoing.

Headline: Charred body of man discovered in Morvant (age ~30)
Street Address: Cipriani Extension (behind house #21, Cipriani Avenue Extension), Morvant
Location: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police discovered the partially burnt, lifeless body of a man of African descent lying in a bushy area near a bush fire off Cipriani Extension, Morvant, early Thursday morning, May 8, 2025.
