Officers from the San Juan substation responded to reports of a bush fire behind house #21, Cipriani Avenue Extension around 4:08 a.m. The victim, approximately 30 years old, slim-built with dark brown complexion, had his lower torso partially burnt.||Fire officers extinguished the blaze and alerted officers at the Morvant Police Station. The District Medical Officer examined the body, made an official pronouncement, and ordered its removal.||Police are investigating the death as a suspected homicide, though the exact circumstances and motive remain under investigation.

Headline: Woman stabbed by stepfather during altercation (Kensesha Thomas, 26)
Location: MCJR+HFV Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: On May 8th, 2025 around 9:30 PM, 26-year-old Kensesha Thomas was at her home on St. Anthony's Drive, West Moorings when she got into an argument with her stepfather, Kyle Procope of Maloney.||During the altercation, Procope armed himself with a knife and stabbed Thomas multiple times about her body, causing serious injuries.||Thomas was subsequently conveyed to St. James Medical Infirmary by her brother, where she was treated and listed in critical condition. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Young man robbed of car and valuables after Grindr meetup (23)
Location: MF3V+83X Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 23-year-old man from Diamond Vale, Diego Martin, drove his white Toyota Daihatsu to Prince Street in Port of Spain around 11:30 p.m. on Thursday to meet someone he had connected with on the Grindr dating app. Upon arrival, an unknown male suspect approached him, ordered him out of the vehicle at what the victim perceived as gunpoint, and the victim complied out of fear for his safety.||The suspect then entered the driver's seat and fled the scene with the vehicle valued at $25,000. Left inside the stolen car were the victim's Samsung S21 Plus phone worth $7,000 and his spectacles valued at $4,000, totaling approximately $36,000 in losses.||The victim walked westward and reached St. Christopher's Gas Station, where police officers assisted him and took him to Belmont Police Station to file a report. The suspect is described as a man of African descent, approximately 5'10" tall, slim build, brown complexion, with long unkempt hair, wearing a black T-shirt and black shorts. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Vehicle shot at during evening incident (37-year-old production worker)
Summary: Around 7:50 p.m. on May 7th, 2025, a 37-year-old production worker and her family were at their home along Richard Lane when several loud explosions were heard coming from the yard. Upon investigating, the victim discovered the rear windshield of her silver Nissan Versa riddled with bullets, indicating the vehicle had been deliberately targeted.||A man dressed in dark colored clothing was observed fleeing the scene on a bicycle immediately after the shooting. The incident occurred while the family was present at the residence.||Police responded to investigate the shooting. The motive for the attack remains unclear, and no arrests have been reported at this time.

Headline: Woman robbed of gold band on Queen Street (age unknown)
Street Address: Queen Street near Jimmy Aboud Textile Store
Location: MF2R+JF5 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A woman from Williamsville, Mayo Road, was walking along Queen Street in Port of Spain near Jimmy Aboud Textile Store around 1:00 p.m. on Wednesday, May 7, 2025, when a male suspect of African descent with a dark complexion and low haircut, wearing a black round-neck t-shirt, grabbed a gold band valued at $2,500 TT from her right hand.||The suspect immediately fled the scene by running north along Henry Street.||Police are investigating the robbery and searching for the suspect.

Headline: Policewoman charged with assaulting 11-year-old (11) at school
Location: MF6H+7W8 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago

Headline: Car stolen in Valencia (License Plate: PDZ 4983)
Summary: A vehicle was stolen in the Valencia area on May 6th, 2025 in the morning. The theft was captured on CCTV footage showing a man entering the vehicle, flashing a light, and then starting the car before reversing down the street. ||The stolen vehicle has license plate PDZ 4983. ||Police are seeking information on the incident and the suspect captured on surveillance footage.

Headline: Police Officer's Toyota Aqua Stolen from Bon Air West
Summary: A Toyota Aqua motor car with registration number PDX 1843 belonging to a police officer was stolen from Bon Air West in Arouca on Tuesday, May 6th, 2025. The vehicle was parked at the location when it was taken. ||Police are investigating the theft and working to recover the stolen vehicle. ||The incident highlights ongoing vehicle theft concerns in the area.

Headline: Man stabbed to death, robbed while inside his car (Byron Maharaj, 53)
Street Address: South Bank Road, outside Mambos Bar, Caroni
Location: HJQP+VJF Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Byron Maharaj, 53, was fatally stabbed and robbed by two men while asleep in his vehicle parked outside Mambos Bar on South Bank Road, Kelly Village, Caroni. CCTV footage captured the moment the two suspects approached Maharaj's car and attacked him, stabbing him fatally and robbing him inside the vehicle. Maharaj, a resident of La Solita Road, was discovered slumped in the driver's seat around 6 a.m. on Monday morning. Police initially suspected the murder resulted from a bar altercation but now believe it was a targeted robbery-homicide. The suspects remain at large and police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Maraval man gunned down in Cunupia (Anthony Subero)
Street Address: Bholai Trace, off Monroe Road, Cunupia
Summary: Anthony Subero, a Maraval resident, was shot to death in his white Nissan E24 van on Bholai Trace, off Monroe Road in Cunupia on Sunday, May 4th, 2025. He was discovered slumped inside the vehicle with multiple gunshot wounds around 8:48 a.m. Investigators believe Subero turned onto a dead-end street where he was ambushed by two gunmen who opened fire on the vehicle. The suspects reportedly escaped on foot through a nearby track, and CCTV footage showed one of the suspects taking a photo of Subero after he was murdered. This appears to be a targeted execution.

Headline: Man shot dead in vehicle at La Horquetta (Jamal Joseph, 37)
Street Address: James Crescent, James Circular, La Horquetta
Summary: Jamal Joseph, 37, of La Horquetta was shot and killed while driving his blue Toyota Aqua on James Circular in La Horquetta on Sunday, May 4th, 2025 at approximately 9:50 PM. Occupants of a grey Hyundai Tucson pulled alongside Joseph's vehicle and opened fire, striking him multiple times in the body before fleeing the scene. Passersby heard Joseph's alarm and rushed him to Arima Hospital, where he was pronounced dead on arrival. Police are investigating the circumstances and motive for the shooting. No arrests have been made at this time.

Headline: Man shot during family altercation over father's pension (Jason Thomas, 44)
Location: JGX3+9RQ Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: On Saturday, May 3, 2025, at approximately 8:20 p.m., 44-year-old Jason Thomas was shot at his residence in Success Village, Laventille following a heated altercation with his brother Junior Thomas over the spending of their father's Old Age Pension. During the argument, Junior threatened Jason and stated he would hire a gunman to shoot him. Junior then drove away in a blue Tucson and returned minutes later with a masked gunman who emerged from the vehicle. As Jason attempted to flee through the yard, the suspect fired multiple shots at him before both men fled the scene in the vehicle with Junior driving. Police responded to the incident and are investigating the circumstances and identities of those involved.

Headline: Woman robbed and stabbed during street attack (31)
Street Address: Churchill Roosevelt Highway walkover near DHL, Barataria
Location: JGPV+354 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 31-year-old woman was walking southbound on the Churchill Roosevelt Highway walkover near DHL in Barataria at approximately 2:15 p.m. when a male suspect approached her from the opposite direction. The suspect forcibly grabbed her green handbag containing her National ID card, $20 TTD cash, and a Redmi Note 9 Pro cell phone valued at $2,500 TTD. When the victim attempted to resist the robbery, the suspect violently attacked her, delivering multiple stab wounds to her back, neck, and scalp. The victim sustained serious injuries during the assault. Police responded to the incident and are investigating the attack.

Headline: Max Grill driver murdered in van after suspected robbery (Ambrose Borde, 54)
Summary: Ambrose Borde, a 54-year-old driver for Max Grills, was found shot dead in a white Kia K2700 van on the Southern Main Road in Warrenville, Cunupia on May 3rd, 2025. First responders arrived around 12:15 a.m. following a report of a robbery and discovered Borde lying motionless on the road with an apparent gunshot wound to his upper right arm. EMTs confirmed he was deceased at the scene. The incident occurred during heavy rainfall and poor visibility, and the van was found parked on the eastern side of the roadway with hazard lights flashing and engine running. Police are investigating the suspected robbery and murder, with co-workers from Max Grill discovering the vehicle.

Headline: Armed bandits rob business in Bamboo Settlement #2
Location: JHGF+G54 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Armed bandits staged a robbery at a business place in Bamboo Settlement #2 on Saturday, May 3rd, 2025. An undisclosed amount of cash and a cellphone were stolen from the victims during the incident. The business owners were present at the time of the robbery. Police responded to the scene following the incident. No arrests or suspect descriptions have been reported.

Headline: Highway Roti Shop heist: Four employees robbed at gunpoint
Summary: Four masked men ambushed four employees of Highway Roti Shop in Freeport around 4:00 p.m. on Saturday, May 3rd, 2025, as they were closing for the day. One suspect was armed with a firearm and announced a robbery. The victims were relieved of their belongings including purses, cell phones (Google Pro Max 7, Samsung A31, iPhone 16 Pro, iPhone 7 Plus, Samsung A16), cash ($600 TTD), and identification documents. One victim was struck in the head with a piece of wood during the incident. The total value of stolen items exceeded $11,600 TTD, and the suspects escaped with the stolen goods.

Headline: Elderly couple brutally attacked, robbed, and sexually assaulted during home invasion (63M, 65F)
Summary: An elderly couple, a 63-year-old stroke patient and his 65-year-old wife, were asleep at their home in the South Western Division when two masked men forced their way in by kicking down a door around 11:00 p.m. on May 3, 2025. One intruder was armed with a cutlass. The attackers beat the male victim on the left side of his face, demanded money, and ransacked the home, stealing over $54,000 TT, $300 US, gold jewellery, passports, and phones. The female victim was sexually assaulted twice—once in her home by one suspect, and again at an abandoned house nearby where the second suspect forced her to perform oral sex before raping her. The attackers escaped on foot, and police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Gunshot injury in roadway incident (Jaheim Patrick, 21)
Street Address: POS to Diego Martin route, corner of Savannah Terrace #1, Sea Trace, Bagatelle
Location: PCGV+W52 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: 21-year-old Jaheim Patrick of St. James was shot while driving his white Suzuki Ciaz along the POS to Diego Martin route on Saturday, May 3rd, 2025, at approximately 1:45 a.m. Patrick was returning from dropping off a female passenger at Sea Trace, Bagatelle, Diego Martin, and had a male passenger in the rear seat.||As Patrick proceeded east along the road and reached the corner of Savannah Terrace #1, a bright light shone towards him followed by several loud explosions (gunshots). The gunshot wound caused Patrick to lose control of his vehicle.||Patrick's vehicle collided with a parked white Nissan B14 (registration PBH 4130) on the southern side of the road and then crashed into a galvanize fence. Police investigation into the shooting incident is ongoing.

Headline: 62-year-old man shot during argument in Guapo (Eric Williams)
Street Address: Augustus Trace, Salick Trace, Gonzales Village, Guapo
Summary: Eric Williams, 62 years old, was shot during an argument in his yard at Augustus Trace, Salick Trace, Gonzales Village, Guapo on the evening of May 3, 2025 around 7:30 p.m. A man in a black hoodie identified as Errol, known as "Spidey", approached Williams and an argument ensued between them.||During the altercation, Spidey pulled a firearm and shot Williams once under the right arm before fleeing on foot. Williams was found bleeding on the ground by police who responded shortly after 8:00 p.m.||Williams was transported to Point Fortin Hospital and subsequently transferred to San Fernando General Hospital, where he remained in stable condition. Police are actively searching for the suspect known as "Spidey". No arrest has been made at the time of reporting.

Headline: Burnt remains found in Siparia believed to be missing man (Uagnan Ramjit, 55)
Summary: The charred remains of 55-year-old Uagnan Ramjit, also known as Phagoo, were discovered in Siparia on Tuesday, May 13th, 2025. Ramjit was last seen alive on Saturday, May 3rd, 2025, liming with friends on a property near Salt Mine Trace where his remains were later found.||The burnt human bones were discovered around 11:00 AM on May 13th under branches in a yard approximately 50 feet from the road during ongoing search efforts.||Officers of the Homicide Bureau of Investigations Region III are continuing their investigation into the circumstances surrounding Ramjit's death. The discovery of charred remains suggests foul play and a deliberate attempt to conceal evidence.

Headline: Gunmen rob UNC Constituency Office Staff in Arima (trio held at gunpoint)
Street Address: Corner of Guanapo Street and Thanno Lane, UNC Constituency Office
Summary: Three persons were robbed at gunpoint outside the UNC Constituency Office at the corner of Guanapo Street and Thanno Lane, Arima, around 5:45 p.m. on Saturday, May 3rd, 2025. A white AD Wagon pulled up in front of the office with three masked men inside. Two gunmen exited with firearms, announced a robbery, and held all three victims at gunpoint while demanding their valuables. A 61-year-old woman handed over a gold iPhone valued at $3,200, $5,000 in cash, and personal cards. A 39-year-old female was relieved of a Samsung Note 20 5G worth $3,800 and cards, while a 70-year-old man lost $1,200 in cash, a Samsung A11 phone worth $1,000, and reading glasses valued at $1,400. Police are investigating the armed robbery.

Headline: Coast Guard officer gunned down during robbery (Dacian John, 36)
Summary: Coast Guard officer Dacian John, 36, of Loblolly Drive, La Resource Road, D'Abadie, was shot and killed during an armed robbery on Cassia Street in Point Fortin early Friday morning around 1:15 a.m. John was seated in his Audi vehicle with a fellow female Coast Guard officer and another individual, waiting to pick up a Guyanese friend who had recently arrived in the country. Three armed men ambushed the group and announced a robbery, taking gold jewelry and valuables from the victims. Before John could draw his service-issued firearm, one of the attackers shot him fatally. The group had been planning to attend the Suave Fantasy All in White Borough Thursday party at Clifton Hill Beach later that day.

Headline: Bandits rob water company truck of cash sales (28-year-old driver)
Street Address: Southern Main Road, Chase Village, Hao Li Supermarket
Summary: A 28-year-old driver from Arouca was robbed at gunpoint while seated in a Blue Waters Company Limited truck (TDN 3154) parked at Hao Li Supermarket on Southern Main Road, Chase Village on Friday, May 2nd, 2025 at approximately 8:50 p.m. Two assailants accosted the driver and his coworkers, with one suspect pointing an object resembling a firearm at the occupants while demanding money. The victim surrendered $14,400 in cash representing the day's supermarket sales and one Samsung cellphone to the robbers. The suspects fled the scene with the stolen items. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Violent robbery at lotto booth; safe remains unopened (43-year-old operator)
Street Address: Diego Martin Main Road near Evergreen Drive, NLCB Lotto Booth
Location: PC6W+RX4 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 43-year-old female operator at the NLCB Lotto Booth on Diego Martin Main Road was preparing to close for the night around 7:10 p.m. on Friday when two suspects forced their way into the booth by kicking open an internal door. The suspects assaulted the woman and demanded cash, taking $89 from her person. Although the perpetrators attempted to access the business safe beneath the counter, they were unsuccessful in opening it. Police responded to the incident and are investigating the robbery and assault.

Headline: Attempted robbery at Tee Jay Supermarket ends in takedown
Street Address: Caroni South Bank Road, Tee Jay Supermarket car park
Location: HJMW+RH6 Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two employees of Tee Jay Supermarket were seated in a vehicle in the car park on Caroni South Bank Road, Kelly Village when a male suspect armed with a knife approached and announced a robbery at approximately 7:55 p.m. on Friday, May 2nd, 2025. The victims raised an alarm and one attempted to fend off the suspect, prompting a security officer from Tammin Security Services to rush to assist. During the struggle, the suspect attempted to flee but was successfully subdued by the security officer. The suspect, identified as 58-year-old Ricky Paul of Hummingbird Street Edinburgh 500 Chaguanas, was handed over to Caroni police. No injuries were reported during the incident.

Headline: Man robbed and assaulted at knifepoint in Montrose (40)
Street Address: Corner of De Verteuil Street and Penco Street
Summary: A 40-year-old man from Couva was robbed and physically assaulted by two suspects at the corner of De Verteuil Street and Penco Street in Montrose on Friday, May 2nd, 2025 at approximately 12:45 p.m. The suspects approached the victim, announced a robbery, and dealt him several blows during the assault. The attackers relieved the victim of $23,000 in cash that he was carrying to purchase a vehicle, as well as his iPhone 13 Pro Max. The suspects fled the scene on foot in the direction of the Uriah Butler Highway. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Businesswoman robbed of $27,000 on San Fernando Bypass
Street Address: San Fernando Bypass Road near old drive-in cinema, Marabella
Summary: A Marabella businesswoman was robbed of $27,000 in cash on Thursday, May 1st, 2025 at approximately 3:00 p.m. while driving her white Lexus south along San Fernando Bypass Road near the old drive-in cinema. The victim had just collected the money in rent from her tenants and was heading to Republic Bank to deposit it when a white vehicle overtook her and cut in front, forcing her to stop. An unarmed man of African descent with a muscular build and brown complexion, wearing a black cap, grey T-shirt, and disposable face mask, exited the vehicle and demanded the cash. The victim complied and handed over a black plastic bag containing the $27,000. Police are investigating the incident.

Headline: Fishing vessel 'Bachie 3' stolen from Richmond Bay
Summary: In late May 2025, a fishing vessel named Bachie 3 belonging to the same family was stolen from Richmond Bay, Tobago. The vessel was later located adrift by Ian Alleyne off the Mosquito Creek.||This theft is part of a pattern of boat thefts targeting the same fishing family in the area within a short timeframe.||Investigations are ongoing into both thefts to determine if the incidents are linked and whether the fishing community is being systematically targeted.

Headline: Man Known as 'Fish' Fatally Shot in Laventille Drive-By
Location: JGW6+V37 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A man identified as Gervon McBain, also known as "Fish," was killed on Wednesday during a drive-by shooting in Laventille. The incident occurred on William Street, where gunmen opened fire on the victim before fleeing the scene. Police were alerted to the gunfire and discovered McBain’s body at the location; he was later pronounced dead.

Headline: Man shot multiple times outside home (Mahase Ramsaran)
Street Address: #6 1/4 Mile, Penal Rock Road, junction of Hope Trace and Penal Rock Road (Zane Agro and Pet Supplies)
Summary: Mahase Ramsaran, a resident of #6 1/4 Mile, Penal Rock Road, was shot multiple times by a masked gunman on Wednesday, April 30th, 2025 at approximately 10:00 p.m. just outside his home. The suspect, wearing a black T-shirt, blue jeans, and ski mask, ambushed Ramsaran in his yard and fired several shots before fleeing on foot heading east along Penal Rock Road. Ramsaran sustained gunshot wounds to his right leg, left leg, and right hand. Police responded to reports of loud explosions in the area and found the victim lying on his back in front of Zane Agro and Pet Supplies at the junction of Hope Trace and Penal Rock Road. Emergency Health Services transported him to San Fernando General Hospital for treatment.

Headline: Man shot and forced to jump into river (Kenshie Aberdeen, 25)
Street Address: 2nd Street, near Point Fortin Fire Station and bridge by large drain
Summary: Kenshie Aberdeen, 25, a resident of 7th Street, Techier Village, Point Fortin, was shot and attacked while walking along 2nd Street near the Point Fortin Fire Station around 8:45 p.m. on April 30th, 2025. A man wearing an orange coverall and face mask emerged from nearby bushes with a gun and opened fire on Aberdeen without apparent provocation. Aberdeen was struck in the left calf and leapt into a nearby river to escape further gunfire as multiple additional shots rang out. He managed to climb out of the water and was transported to Point Fortin Hospital by police for treatment of his injuries. Investigations into the shooting are continuing with no arrests reported.

Headline: Retiree stabbed while intervening in neighbor dispute (Caldon Felix, 70)
Summary: Caldon Felix, a 70-year-old retiree also known as "Chinnee" from Stanley Street, Buccoo Point, was stabbed multiple times while attempting to intervene in a violent dispute between two neighbors at his residence on Shirvan Road. The incident occurred around 9:00 p.m. on Wednesday, April 30th, 2025, when Felix noticed one neighbor armed and attempting to attack another. In an effort to defuse the escalating confrontation, Felix stepped in and was stabbed multiple times in the upper body. He sustained a laceration to the arterial region of the neck and a puncture wound to the shoulder. Felix was taken for medical treatment to address his injuries.

Headline: Brazen daylight attempted kidnapping in Diego Martin (37-year-old male)
Location: PCGP+647 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 37-year-old man from Northwest Drive, Patna Village, Diego Martin, narrowly escaped an armed kidnapping attempt on Wednesday, April 30th, 2025, around 8:20 a.m. while purchasing breakfast at a shop near Salandy Street. Three armed suspects in a heavily tinted white Nissan AD Wagon approached him as he stood outside his parked black Toyota Rav4 SUV (registration #PDA 3383, valued at $120,000). Suspect #1 pointed a firearm at the victim and ordered him into their vehicle while suspect #2 grabbed him, initiating a struggle. During the altercation, the victim managed to escape and ran west along Salandy Street; a shot was fired at him as he fled. When he returned to the scene, his Toyota Rav4 had been stolen by the suspects.

Headline: Port of Spain Man Executed in Late-Night Ambush at San Juan Apartment Complex
Location: MG6R+X6Q San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: 43-year-old Kellon Hutchinson was killed in a barrage of gunfire early Tuesday morning at an apartment building in Nicholasville, San Juan. Residents alerted police after hearing loud explosions, and responding officers discovered Hutchinson lying on the ground with multiple gunshot wounds. Although rushed to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex, he was pronounced dead on arrival. Investigators recovered 16 spent .40 caliber shells and one live 9mm round at the scene.

Headline: School teacher's home burglarized, $230,000 in cash stolen
Summary: A school teacher returned to her New Grant home around 12:30 p.m. on Tuesday, January 28, 2026, and discovered the house had been ransacked. Thieves pried open a window and damaged the burglarproofing to gain entry. The intruders stole $230,000 in cash hidden under the mattress, along with a CCTV DVR system, a titanium watch valued at US$1,500, an iPad worth $6,000, and a PlayStation 5 valued at $7,500. The teacher contacted the Tableland Police Station, and officers documented the break-in and theft. Police are investigating the incident to identify and apprehend the suspects.

Headline: Point Fortin Woman Raped After Purchase Agreement Dispute
Summary: A 23-year-old woman was sexually assaulted at her downstairs apartment on Monday afternoon by a 19-year-old acquaintance from Egypt Village. The suspect reportedly visited the victim to finalize a deal regarding the sale of a television and a phone; however, when the victim stated she lacked the funds, the suspect proposed sex as payment. Despite her resistance, he forced his way into the apartment and raped her before fleeing the scene on foot.

Headline: Laventille Couple Targeted in Shooting Following Heated Argument
Location: MG56+6WM Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A young couple narrowly avoided injury after a gunman opened fire on their vehicle in Trou Macaque on Monday night. The incident followed a verbal altercation between Nicholas Burke and a known male acquaintance along Harlem Road. As Burke and a 20-year-old woman drove away, the suspect emerged from a yard and fired several shots, damaging the car. Burke drove directly to the Besson Street Police Station; both victims were examined at the hospital and treated for shock.

Headline: Body of unidentified man found off roadway in Gasparillo with chop injuries
Summary: The body of an unidentified man was discovered off Mayo Road in Gasparillo on April 28, 2025, at approximately 1:45 p.m. A passerby discovered the body lying motionless on his stomach, positioned four feet off the road behind two large concrete barriers. The victim was identified as a slim-built East Indian male, approximately 5 feet tall, brown in complexion, wearing a blue vest and brown ¾ pants with a black belt. The body showed signs of violence including a head wound and a wound to the neck, consistent with chop injuries. Police responded to the scene and initiated a homicide investigation, which remains ongoing.

Headline: Suspect arrested after attempting to flee with stolen vehicle at Piarco International Airport
Summary: At approximately 8:36 a.m. on Monday, 28th April, 2025, a man attempted to exit the carpark at Piarco International Airport in a black Volkswagen Touareg SUV. Security guards flagged the vehicle after noticing a discrepancy with the parking receipt and alerted Airport Authority Police, who contacted the TTPS.||The suspect attempted to flee by accelerating through the exit barrier but lost control and crashed into a fence on the western side of the airport, then abandoned the vehicle and fled on foot.||PC Byer of the Highway Patrol Branch's Roadway Surveillance Unit/Select Traffic Enforcement Project pursued and successfully apprehended the suspect without incident. The stolen vehicle was recovered.

Headline: Civilians and Off-Duty Officer Nab Thief After Violent Purse Snatching in San Juan
Location: JGXV+Q5J San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 55-year-old woman was assaulted and robbed of her purse on 5th Street shortly after withdrawing $380 from an ATM. During the struggle, the suspect struck the victim and pushed her to the ground before fleeing across the Priority Bus Route. Two bystanders and an off-duty police officer chased and apprehended the suspect; while the purse was recovered, the stolen cash was missing.

Headline: CCTV Captures Shoplifters Concealing Items at Maraval Supermarket
Location: MFRJ+PMV Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Surveillance footage from a supermarket in Maraval recorded multiple men engaged in shoplifting on Sunday. The video shows the suspects moving through the aisles and placing various store items into their pockets before leaving. Management has reportedly reviewed the footage to assist in identifying the individuals involved.

Headline: Barrackpore Family Brutalized and Robbed of $80K in Jewelry and US Travel Documents
Summary: A Barrackpore family was terrorized by three masked gunmen who ambushed them as they arrived home late Sunday night. The suspects assaulted a female resident and pistol-whipped a 54-year-old man before ransacking the house. The bandits made off with high-value gold jewelry, electronics, and a backpack containing a victim's US Green Card, Social Security card, and passport, fleeing the scene in a silver Toyota Aqua (PDK 2721).

Headline: Samaroo Village Resident Transferred to Mt. Hope Following Critical Neck Injury
Summary: Jermiel Freeman is in critical but stable condition after being wounded during an altercation with a known individual in Arima. The incident occurred late Sunday afternoon at Mendez Drive, resulting in Freeman sustaining a severe neck injury. He was initially treated at the Arima Health Facility before being transferred to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex for specialized care.

Headline: Longdenville Woman Hospitalized After Son Slits Her Throat During Property Dispute
Summary: 60-year-old Hamati Boodram survived a life-threatening attack at her home on Sunday after a verbal altercation with her son turned violent. During a dispute over property, 42-year-old Rajin Boodram allegedly used a bladed weapon to slit his mother's throat. The victim was rushed to the Chaguanas District Health Facility, where medical staff managed to stabilize her condition.

Headline: Woman found dead with visible marks about her body (Yvonne Marcano, 76)
Summary: The decomposed body of 76-year-old Yvonne Marcano, a US citizen, was discovered at her home on Main Road, Tabaquite on Sunday, April 27, 2025. Marcano was found lying on her back with her right hand clutching a pillow positioned close to her face, and visible marks were observed on her body.||Police are treating the death as a homicide based on the physical evidence and circumstances of discovery. Items reported missing from the residence include her cellphone, DVR, and house keys, suggesting possible foul play and theft.||Investigators are conducting a full homicide investigation to determine the cause of death and identify those responsible for the crime.

Headline: Man Beaten and Stabbed During Armed Robbery at Mon Repos Play Park
Street Address: Dick Street and Hilda Lazzari Terrace, Mon Repos
Summary: A 32-year-old man was violently assaulted by two armed suspects while seated in the pavilion of the Hazel Rogers Play Park. The assailants, one armed with a gun and the other with a knife, robbed the victim of his Samsung S20 smartphone. Following the theft, the suspects repeatedly struck the victim with the firearm and stabbed him in his arms before fleeing on foot along Hilda Lazzari Terrace.

Headline: Hospital Employee Escapes Injury After Gunman Opens Fire Inside Petit Valley Grocery
Location: PF53+7CW Petit Valley, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 32-year-old man narrowly escaped harm when a masked gunman entered Roots Grocery and opened fire while the victim was setting up music equipment. After the assailant fired a single shot, the victim fled toward a security gate for safety. Crime Scene Investigators recovered a 9mm spent shell with TTPS markings at the scene, and the suspect was seen escaping via a nearby track.

Headline: Couva Man Pistol-Whipped and Robbed of Vehicle on Besson Street
Location: MF2W+8C3 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 59-year-old man from Mc Bean Village was targeted by four armed assailants while waiting for a mechanic in Port of Spain. One suspect struck the victim repeatedly with the butt of a firearm before the group robbed him of TT$400 and stole his grey Toyota Corolla, valued at TT$30,000. The broad-daylight attack occurred near noon on a Saturday.

Headline: CCTV Footage Exposes Shoplifting Duo at Montrose Marketing Firm
Summary: Surveillance cameras at Kashé Marketing Limited captured two individuals stealing personal care items on Saturday. The footage shows a man in a red jersey concealing several tubes of Colgate toothpaste in his shorts. Moments later, a young female accomplice was filmed removing bottles of Listerine and other unidentified merchandise from the shelves before both suspects exited the premises without paying.

Headline: Missing PH Driver Naradh Ragoonanan Found Murdered in Debe
Summary: The body of 46-year-old PH taxi driver Naradh Ragoonanan was discovered in bushes off Dumfries Road, Debe, one day after he was reported missing. The victim's wrists were bound with rope, and he had sustained multiple gunshot wounds to the chest and abdomen. His blue Nissan Almera, PBM 521, was later recovered by police on Aster Street in Union Hall.

Headline: Sisters Brutalized and Sexually Assaulted During Violent Eastern Division Home Invasion
Summary: Three sisters, aged 19, 21, and 25, were targeted by an armed intruder who broke into their home after smashing a glass door. The suspect, masked with a green jersey and armed with a firearm, refused stolen goods and instead physically and sexually assaulted the women. One victim was raped, another was forced to perform oral sex, and two were physically battered—one struck in the head with a gun and another choked—before the assailant fled.

Headline: Armed Bandits Rob Church’s Chicken and Staff in Late-Night Port of Spain Raid
Location: MF2R+2F5 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Four men staged a robbery at the Church’s Chicken outlet located at Henry Street and Independence Square shortly before midnight on Friday. One suspect brandished a pistol at a cashier to secure cash from the registers, while the group also stormed the manager’s office to steal a Samsung A72 smartphone valued at TT$3,500. The assailants fled the scene immediately after the heist.

Headline: Los Bajos Man Arrested with Loaded Revolver in Arena Village
Street Address: S.S. Erin Road, Arena Village, Erin
Summary: Police officers on patrol in the Erin district intercepted a purple Nissan B13 near Shirley’s Roti Shop on Friday night. A search of the 29-year-old driver, Italo Trent Theodule, revealed a Taurus revolver with two rounds of .38 ammunition tucked into his waistband. The suspect was arrested and transported to the Siparia Police Station.

Headline: Woman sexually assaulted at home by known suspect (victim age unknown)
Street Address: King Street and Boundary Road, Aranguez
Location: JHW2+PP5 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Around 11:00 AM on Friday, April 25, 2025, a female victim was at her home alone when she heard a knock at the door. Upon opening it, she encountered Ricardo Ali (aka Gur), a man known to her who lives at King Street and Boundary Road in Aranguez. He entered her home, grabbed her hands, tied them with white cloth, and pushed her onto her bed.||The suspect forcibly engaged in sexual intercourse against her will. After the assault, he untied her and left the house.||A report was made to police and an investigation was initiated.

Headline: Valencia Woman Shot While Asleep During Early Morning Gun Attack
Summary: 30-year-old Jael Lewis was hospitalized after being shot in her bed during a targeted gun attack on her San Pablo home. The victim awoke to several loud explosions and realized she had been struck in the leg; investigators later discovered multiple bullet holes in the walls of the residence and recovered several 9mm shell casings at the scene.

Headline: Watchman Kassie Jugoon Brutally Hacked to Death in Rio Claro Attack
Summary: 62-year-old Kassie Jugoon was found murdered on North Boundary Road on Thursday morning after being hacked multiple times with a sharp object. Jugoon, who had been hired to guard an excavator in Eccles Village, suffered a severed wrist and other gruesome injuries during the violent overnight assault.

Headline: Two Young Men Robbed at Gunpoint During Facebook Marketplace Meet-up in San Juan
Location: JGRR+HP4 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 24-year-old and a 23-year-old were lured to the Jesus Elam Church car park under the guise of a vehicle sale coordinated via Facebook Marketplace. Two suspects, one armed with a firearm, robbed the men of multiple smartphones, bank cards, and cash before stealing their silver Nissan Almera, which was later found abandoned in Morvant.

Headline: Two Teens Wounded in Gun Attack Outside Champ Fleurs Convenience Store
Street Address: Mendez Drive and Quarry Drive, Champ Fleurs
Location: MH3G+8CC San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Marcus Rodriguez, 20, and Christopher Samuel, 19, were hospitalized after a masked gunman opened fire on them outside J&N One Stop Shop. The victims were seated at the corner of Mendez and Quarry Drive when the assailant approached and began shooting; both young men sustained leg wounds and are currently in stable condition at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex.

Headline: 77-Year-Old Grocery Owner Hospitalized After Brutal Beating and Robbery in Sangre Grande
Street Address: Corner of Picton Road and Good Hope Street
Location: HVR7+6J6 Sangre Grande, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A wholesale vendor was severely beaten and tied up by three intruders at his business at the corner of Picton Road and Good Hope Street on Wednesday night. After being ambushed while checking on his barking dog, the victim was assaulted and robbed of a quantity of cigarettes; he was later rushed to the hospital after losing consciousness during a police interview.

Headline: La Brea Shopkeeper in ICU After Being Stabbed with Knife and Ice Pick by Friend
Summary: Stephen Francois, a 39-year-old shop owner from Sobo Village, is in critical condition following a violent dispute with a friend at his home on Wednesday night. The altercation escalated when the suspect, identified as Bobby Collins, allegedly attacked Francois with both a knife and an ice pick, inflicting severe wounds to his chest and abdomen.

Headline: Felicity Pensioner Robbed of Over $70,000 in Cash and Jewelry During Mid-Morning Break-In
Summary: A 73-year-old man returned to his Lyle Lane home on Wednesday morning to find it ransacked just two hours after he had departed. Thieves forced entry and made off with a black safe containing $4,000 USD, an additional $16,000 TTD in cash, a significant quantity of gold jewelry, and various beverages.

Headline: Bank Worker Beaten and Robbed of Vehicle During Fake Phone Sale in Enterprise
Summary: A 20-year-old clerical assistant was lured to Nibblette Street under the guise of selling a Samsung S22 Ultra cellphone, only to be ambushed by two men. The victim was physically assaulted and robbed of his phone and his silver Nissan AD Wagon (PDG 6456) at gunpoint; the suspects subsequently fled the scene in the stolen vehicle.

Headline: Influencer Nigel "NCW" Watson Carjacked at Gunpoint Outside Diego Martin KFC
Street Address: Corner of St. Lucien Road and Sierra Leone Road
Location: PC5W+397 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Popular social media influencer Nigel Watson, known as NCW, was robbed of his blue MG (PEE 2498) while waiting for his wife in a KFC parking lot. A masked gunman entered the vehicle, demanded money, and threatened to shoot Watson before forcing him out and fleeing. The vehicle was recovered shortly after, abandoned in the Crystal Stream area.

Headline: Silver Nissan AD Wagon Stolen at Gunpoint in Enterprise Community
Summary: A silver Nissan AD Wagon with registration PDG 6456 was taken from its owner during an armed carjacking in Enterprise on Wednesday. The vehicle was stolen at gunpoint before the suspects fled the scene.

Headline: Cunupia Businesswoman Carjacked at Gunpoint Outside Her Restaurant
Street Address: Alexander Street and Munroe Road, Cunupia
Summary: A 41-year-old businesswoman was robbed of her TT$270,000 Toyota Yaris Cross and TT$5,000 in cash outside her restaurant on Wednesday night. A masked gunman accosted the victim as she sat in her vehicle, demanding her keys and handbag before fleeing in the SUV; the vehicle’s GPS was reportedly ripped out and later discarded in Morvant.

Headline: Man Hospitalized in Critical Condition After Stabbing on Fowler Street, Curepe
Summary: 44-year-old Marlon Grant remains warded at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex following a violent altercation in Curepe. Grant was stabbed multiple times by a suspect, identified as a man in a white hoodie, who fled the scene on foot. The victim is currently in critical but stable condition and remains heavily sedated while receiving treatment for his injuries.

Headline: Security Officer Bound and Robbed of Work Gear at Palo Seco Secondary School
Summary: A 39-year-old security guard was tied up and robbed by two men armed with shotguns while on duty early Tuesday morning. The intruders entered the school compound and stole the officer's cellphone along with her MTS-issued jacket and shoes before targeting a second guard.

Headline: Teenage Son Wounded and Hospitalized Following Deadly Ambush in Cunupia
Street Address: Corner of River Road and Mon Plaisir Road
Location: HJ7J+5FG Madras Settlement, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: 17-year-old Ricardo Joseph is in critical condition after being shot during a violent ambush that claimed the lives of his father and brother at the corner of Mon Plaisir and River Road. The teenager was traveling in a pickup van with his relatives to sell coconuts when gunmen opened fire with high-powered weapons; he was subsequently rushed to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex for treatment.

Headline: Motorist Kidnapped and Robbed of Honda Accord Near Delhi Road Roundabout
Summary: A 35-year-old man was intercepted and kidnapped by an armed suspect while driving along the Archibald-De Leon Highway on Tuesday morning. After being forced to stop by a silver wagon, the victim was ordered out of his blue Honda Accord (PCP 3687) and driven to La Romain, where he was abandoned while the suspect fled with his vehicle.

Headline: Thieves Target KC Candy Delivery Truck in Woodbrook; Over $14,000 in Goods Stolen
Location: MF6H+7WX Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A quantity of sweets and candies valued at $14,036 was stolen from a KC Candy delivery truck parked on French Street on Tuesday afternoon. The salesmen returned to the vehicle after a 40-minute absence to find the rear canopy door forced open and the high-value inventory missing.

Headline: Cunupia Woman's Toyota Aqua Stolen from Driveway and Found Stripped in Bamboo #2
Summary: A 52-year-old resident of Saleem Avenue discovered her silver Toyota Aqua (PDW 8594) missing from her driveway on Wednesday morning. Following a police investigation, the vehicle, valued at $90,000, was located partially scrapped along a riverbank near the Caroni Bridge in Bamboo #2.

Headline: T&TEC Meter and Audio Equipment Stolen in Chaguanas Temple Break-In
Summary: The Trymambakeshwar Mahadev Mandir was targeted by thieves who broke into the building between Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. The Pundit arrived to find the temple in darkness after the T&TEC meter was removed from the property; further inspection revealed a side door had been forced open and several items, including four speaker boxes and a wireless headset, were missing.

Headline: 17-Year-Old Venezuelan Teen Kidnapped After Responding to Facebook Job Ad
Summary: Joarlis Fernández Carolina Marin was reported missing after leaving her Diamond Village home to meet individuals regarding a job advertisement found on Facebook. Her family subsequently received ransom demands via WhatsApp for $2,000 USD. Despite changing instructions and the victim's boyfriend being sent to various KFC locations across South Trinidad with thousands of dollars in phone cards, no proof of life was provided by the abductors.

Headline: Armed Men Rob Second Security Officer of Vehicle and Personal Effects at School Compound
Summary: A 38-year-old security officer was accosted and tied up by two armed men while seated in her car at Palo Seco Secondary School. The suspects stole her silver Toyota Aqua, cash, jewelry, and various household items including kitchen appliances that were inside the vehicle.

Headline: Son of Coconut Vendor Killed Alongside Father in Cunupia Double Murder (Anthony John)
Street Address: Corner of River Road and Mon Plaisir Road
Location: HJ7J+5FG Madras Settlement, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Vickie Joseph was shot and killed while traveling in a pickup van with his father on Tuesday morning. The vehicle was boxed in at an intersection by attackers who unleashed a volly of gunfire, killing Joseph and his father instantly at the scene.

Headline: Tobago Woman Hospitalized After Cutlass Attack by Partner in Concordia Home Invasion
Summary: A woman was attacked and injured by her partner after he broke into her Cradley Trace home through a window early Monday morning. The suspect, who was found at the scene by Scarborough police, admitted to using a cutlass to assault the victim in her bedroom following a domestic dispute.

Headline: Teenager Emilio Lewis Fatally Stabbed in Grand Lagoon, Mayaro
Summary: 18-year-old Emilio Lewis died on Monday morning after being found with multiple stab wounds in the Grand Lagoon area. Police discovered the victim around 7:35 a.m., but he succumbed to his injuries shortly after the discovery.

Headline: Mayaro Resident Hospitalized After Cutlass Attack by Neighbor Following Altercation
Summary: 49-year-old Winston Jotis was seriously injured after being chopped several times by a neighbor on Begorat Hill. The victim confronted the suspect for entering his home without permission, leading to an argument where the suspect allegedly used a cutlass to strike Jotis in the forehead and back while threatening his life.

Headline: Decomposing Body of Missing Welder Damion Trim Found in Abandoned La Brea House
Summary: The decomposing body of 43-year-old Damion Trim was discovered in an abandoned building on Lagon Dor Street on Sunday afternoon. Trim, a welder who reportedly struggled with drug use, was found with multiple stab wounds days after allegedly receiving death threats; he was last seen alive on Friday after signing the bail register at the local police station.

Headline: Man Dies After Having Severe Head and Facial Injuries Following Mysterious Incident
Summary: Rasheed Choon was admitted to a medical facility in critical condition after being transported by a GMR ambulance with extensive traumatic injuries. The victim, who suffered multiple facial and nasal fractures along with a broken arm, was unable to provide a statement to police due to being heavily sedated.

Headline: Missing Rio Claro Man Found Murdered in Maloney; Victim's Toyota Hilux Stolen
Summary: 27-year-old Nicolas Edwards was found dead with gunshot wounds along Sapphire Avenue in Maloney, hours after being reported missing from the Mayaro district. Edwards, the son of a police officer, failed to report for work on Saturday morning, prompting a search. While his body has been recovered, his silver-grey Toyota Hilux (TCA 6120) remains missing and is believed to have been taken by his killers.

Headline: Violent Altercation Between Cousins in Barataria Leaves Both Hospitalized
Location: JGWQ+FGR San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two cousins, Keon Ian Reyes and Coreal Joseph, sustained serious injuries during a domestic dispute at their residence on Ninth Street. The confrontation began early Saturday morning when Joseph, armed with a cutlass, allegedly attacked Reyes. During the ensuing struggle, Reyes used a knife to stab Joseph multiple times. Both men were transported to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex for treatment of their respective wounds.

Headline: Moruga Farmer Gibbons Coker Shot Dead in Forest Near Newton Trace; Suspect at Large
Summary: A 58-year-old farmer was fatally shot while digging yams in a forested area near Newton Trace, Basse Terre. Police discovered the body of Gibbons Coker with multiple gunshot wounds after witnesses reported hearing explosions and seeing an armed man flee. Investigators believe the killing stems from an ongoing conflict and have identified a suspect.

Headline: Carapichaima Man Critical After Being Struck with Steel During Altercation with Brother
Summary: A 20-year-old man, Matthew Isaac, is in critical condition following a violent confrontation with his younger brother at their Perseverance Road home on Saturday night. The victim was struck in the head with a piece of steel and remains unresponsive at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex.

Headline: Couva Men Robbed at Gunpoint While Offloading Waste at Beetham Landfill
Location: JGR8+JGR Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Two men from Couva were robbed of their cellular phones, cash, and jewelry by three armed suspects at the Beetham Landfill on Saturday afternoon. The victims were offloading bulk waste when they were accosted; the suspects subsequently fled the scene by crossing the Beetham Highway on foot.

Headline: Man killed by brother on his 20th birthday (Matthew Isaac, 20)
Summary: Matthew Isaac, 20, was celebrating his birthday on Saturday, April 19, 2025, when he became involved in an argument with his 19-year-old brother, Peter Isaac, in the yard of their home on Perseverance Road in Carapichaima. Around 8:18 p.m., the argument escalated and Peter allegedly armed himself with a piece of steel and threw it at Matthew, striking him in the head. Matthew collapsed to the ground, bleeding and unresponsive, while Peter fled the scene.||Their father rushed Matthew to the Chaguanas Accident and Emergency Hospital, where he was later transferred to the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex. Matthew remained in critical condition until Thursday, April 24, 2025, when he succumbed to his injuries.||Peter Isaac was charged with murder in connection with the incident.

Headline: Couple Targeted in Armed Robbery During Instagram Sneaker Sale at Morvant Junction
Location: JGXJ+452 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 32-year-old businessman and his wife were robbed at knifepoint while attempting to complete a sale of high-end sneakers at the NP Quik Shoppe. After parking their vehicle, the couple was approached by two men who brandished a knife and demanded their valuables. The suspects stole an iPhone 14 Pro Max and a pair of Jordan 11 sneakers before unsuccessfully attempting to steal the couple's Toyota Hilux and fleeing on foot.

Headline: Kidnapped Point Fortin Woman Found Murdered After Violent Hijacking in Carlsen Field
Summary: 30-year-old Odelle Lalman-Baptiste was found dead with her throat slit and multiple stab wounds in Carlsen Field, hours after being abducted during a late-night robbery. The victim and her husband, Mathias Baptiste, were ambushed by armed men while traveling along Hospital Road. The suspects robbed the husband of his Hyundai H-100 van, cash, and mobile phones before kidnapping Lalman-Baptiste and fleeing in the stolen vehicle.

Headline: Morvant Woman Targets Ex-Boyfriend for Theft Following Domestic Dispute
Location: MG4H+G7C San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 43-year-old woman reported that her ex-boyfriend, Stephen Murray, stole $2,900 from her purse after returning to her residence on Second Caledonia Road. The incident occurred hours after police had initially responded to a domestic violence report at the same location. Murray, who had been asked to leave earlier in the day, allegedly returned, made abusive remarks, and fled with the cash.

Headline: Ten-Year-Old Girl Hospitalized After Sexual Assault and Attempted Hanging in Maraval
Location: MFWM+2M2 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A young girl is currently receiving medical treatment at the Sangre Grande District Hospital following a brutal sexual assault and an attempt on her life. The child was reportedly discovered hanging from a tree after the attack but survived the ordeal. The suspect involved in the incident died at the hospital after consuming a poisonous substance.

Headline: Female Bartender Assaulted and Robbed at Rum Paradise Restaurant and Bar in Penal
Street Address: Rum Paradise Restaurant & Bar, Clarke Road
Summary: A 23-year-old female bartender was reportedly assaulted by a prison officer at her workplace on Clarke Road on Friday night. The suspect allegedly seized the victim's iPhone 12 before slapping her, shoving her into an iron gate, and attempting to strike her with a hammer.

Headline: Cocaine Seized and Suspect Detained in Major Anti-Crime Exercise at Piarco Airport
Summary: Police seized over $470,000 worth of cocaine during a targeted anti-crime operation at Piarco International Airport on Friday afternoon. Officers from the Northern Division Task Force discovered the narcotics hidden inside a vehicle along BWIA Boulevard and took one suspect into custody.

Headline: Body of Missing 15-Year-Old Malini Persad Found in Barrackpore Forest
Summary: The body of 15-year-old Malini Persad was discovered in a forested area along G.P. Road four days after she was reported missing. Investigators had been following leads suggesting the teenager was sexually assaulted and killed by an acquaintance. Police remained on the scene throughout Thursday morning as homicide investigations continued.

Headline: Deadly Execution at Piarco International Airport Leaves One Dead and One Injured
Summary: 33-year-old Akim Quashie was fatally shot by rifle-toting gunmen moments after arriving on a flight from Panama. The assailants opened fire on a blue Hyundai Tucson at the airport's arrival area, killing Quashie and wounding a second passenger, Jeremy Diaz. The suspects managed to flee the scene in a silver Tiida, sparking major national security concerns.

Headline: Thieves Target Bunsee Trace Community Centre Stealing Water Tank and Pump
Summary: The Bunsee Trace Community Centre in Penal was targeted by thieves who stole a 1000-gallon water tank and a Gould water pump from the rear of the premises. The 66-year-old president of the centre discovered the theft on Thursday morning, noting that PVC fittings had been cut to remove the equipment. While the exterior fixtures were taken, the interior of the building remained secure and undisturbed.

Headline: Three Victims Beaten and Robbed of $30,000 in Fraudulent Facebook Car Sale
Location: MG96+4F7 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Three young adults were lured to Las Alturas under the guise of purchasing a Nissan Tiida advertised on Facebook. Upon arrival, their vehicle was intercepted by three men, one of whom was armed with a firearm. The victims were physically assaulted, including being struck on the head with the weapon and a stone, before being robbed of $30,000 in cash and three mobile phones. The suspects fled the scene via a nearby track.

Headline: Vehicle Stolen Overnight from Kelly Village
Location: HJMP+HW8 Kelly Village, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A vehicle with registration number PEC 1521 was reported stolen from the Kelly Village area during the early morning hours. The theft occurred between 1:00 a.m. and 3:00 a.m. while the vehicle was parked. Local authorities have been notified and are conducting investigations into the incident.

Headline: Delivery Driver Ambushed and Robbed of Cash and Goods in Arima
Summary: A 41-year-old delivery driver was targeted by three men while attempting to complete an order at Riverway Road. One suspect distracted the driver while two others, including one armed with a firearm, approached the vehicle to announce a robbery. The assailants escaped with the victim's side bag containing $200 and approximately $900 worth of pizzas.

Headline: Delivery Truck Targeted in High-Value Theft at Diego Martin Supermarket
Street Address: Kelly’s Supermarket, Diego Martin Main Road
Location: PCCP+VW6 Diego Martin, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: An A.S. Brydens & Sons delivery driver and his assistant were robbed of over $100,000 worth of goods while conducting sales at Kelly’s Supermarket. The victims were alerted by a witness who observed suspects offloading items from the secured vehicle parked along the Diego Martin Main Road. The perpetrators managed to seize the inventory and escape before they could be intercepted.

Headline: Morvant Man Shot Through Car Window After Refusing Gunman's Demands
Location: MH3C+9WX San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: 39-year-old Dennison Jack was shot in the neck while sitting in his parked vehicle with a companion on Industrial Road. A gunman approached the car and ordered the occupants to exit, but Jack locked the doors and refused to comply. The suspect fired a single shot through the window before fleeing the scene on foot.

Headline: Man Shot Outside Palo Seco Bar After Being Ambushed by Masked Gunmen
Street Address: Station 22 Bar, Los Charos Junction, Palo Seco
Summary: 54-year-old Victor Richards was shot in the ankle while standing outside Station 22 Bar at Los Charos Junction. Two masked men armed with firearms approached the victim, who was struck by gunfire while attempting to flee the scene. Police recovered a shotgun cartridge at the location, and the victim was transported for medical treatment.

Headline: 65-Year-Old Woman Choked and Robbed of $60,000 After Bank Withdrawal
Summary: A senior citizen was ambushed at her doorstep shortly after withdrawing a large sum of cash from a bank in La Romain. As she exited her vehicle at her San Fernando residence, a suspect from a silver Toyota Axio approached her, pressed an object against her back, and announced a robbery. During a struggle, the assailant choked the woman and pushed her to the ground before fleeing with $60,000 intended for a vehicle purchase.

Headline: Morvant Man Dies Following Fatal Shooting During Attempted Carjacking
Location: MG3G+XX5 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Dennison Jack, 39, has succumbed to his injuries after being shot in the neck while sitting in his vehicle on Industrial Road last Wednesday. The victim was attacked after he locked his car doors and refused to exit the vehicle as ordered by an armed suspect, who fired a single shot before fleeing.

Headline: Teen Footballer Fatally Shot at Phase 4 La Horquetta After Political Meeting
Street Address: Oscar Pyle Crescent, Silvia Hunte Avenue, Phase 4 La Horquetta
Summary: Seventeen-year-old Ezekiel Ramdialsingh was killed in a shooting at Oscar Pyle Crescent while liming with a group after a nearby political meeting. The victim was found with a gunshot wound to the chest and succumbed to his injuries shortly after arriving at the Arima Hospital. Investigators recovered 14 spent shell casings at the scene and noted damage to nearby vehicles.

Headline: Elderly Man Stabbed During Violent Altercation on Lower High Street San Fernando
Summary: 64-year-old David Lewis was stabbed during a physical confrontation with another man on the sidewalk in front of Republic Bank. The assailant, identified as Adam Williamson, reportedly refused to drop his weapon during the attack before being intercepted by authorities. Both men were transported to the San Fernando General Hospital for their respective injuries.

Headline: St. James Business Owner Assaulted and Robbed by Group of Armed Men
Location: MFF9+PFP Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 48-year-old proprietor was at Double A Budget Mart on Calcutta Street when he was targeted by four men, one of whom was armed with a firearm. The suspects physically assaulted the victim and forced him to the back of the store before stealing $1,500 in cash and a mobile phone. The group fled the scene in a blue Hyundai Accent toward Laventille.

Headline: Salesman Ambushed and Robbed at Gunpoint on Demerara Road in Wallerfield
Summary: A 42-year-old employee of Auto Care Enterprises Ltd. was intercepted by gunmen while driving his company vehicle along Demerara Road. Two suspects used a car to block the victim's path before pointing a firearm at him and demanding cash. The assailants escaped with both company sales money and the victim's personal funds.

Headline: Vistabella Resident Beaten and Bound During Violent Five-Man Home Invasion
Summary: A 31-year-old man was hospitalized after five suspects, some masked, stormed his residence and subjected him to a violent assault. The intruders tied the victim up and beat him before stealing cash and two mobile phones. The victim remained bound until the following day when he managed to free himself and seek assistance from a neighbor.

Headline: Carenage Man Hospitalized After Stabbing Over Domestic Dispute
Summary: 40-year-old Connel Sandy sustained multiple stab wounds during a violent confrontation with 36-year-old Neil Bailey near the Shiloh Pentecostal Tabernacle. The altercation, which reportedly stemmed from a dispute over the harassment of Sandy's common-law wife, escalated from a verbal argument to a physical attack. Sandy was treated for injuries to his arm, face, and back at the St. James Medical Complex.

Headline: 20-Year-Old Man in Critical Condition Following Shooting in Santa Rosa Heights
Location: JPGQ+J65 Santa Rosa Heights, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Isaiah Deroche was shot multiple times by two known assailants while walking along Pomegranate Drive in Santa Rosa Heights. The victim sustained serious injuries to his abdomen and leg and was transported to the Arima General Hospital in critical condition, while police recovered several spent shells and live rounds from the scene.

Headline: Victims Escape Uninjured After High-Speed Chase and Shooting in Morvant
Street Address: Ramier Trace / West Park Trace, Morvant
Location: MG6F+3W2 Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A driver and his passenger narrowly escaped injury after a gunman opened fire on their silver Nissan Sylphy from a grey Hyundai Accent near Ramier Trace. The driver led a high-speed chase through various streets in Morvant to evade the attackers, eventually stopping at West Park Trace where police observed multiple bullet holes in the vehicle.

Headline: Lifeguard Arrested After Striking Beachgoer with Metal Flagpole in Toco
Summary: A 34-year-old man was hospitalized after being struck in the head with a metal flagpole by a lifeguard during an argument at the beach. The dispute began over the proximity of the victim's children to the water; the victim lost consciousness and suffered bleeding from his ears before being stabilized at the Sangre Grande Hospital.

Headline: Man Wounded in Gunfire While Seated in Valencia Backyard
Summary: Adrian Kallicharan was shot in his left foot after hearing several loud explosions while sitting in the backyard of his Quare Road home. During the intrusion, one of the suspects grabbed a knife from the kitchen and attacked both the father and son. The trio then made their escape in a blue Toyota Aqua. Both victims were transported to the hospital for treatment.

Headline: Snatched out of taxi, woman abducted, raped
Summary: A 9:10 a.m. commute turned into a violent abduction when a suspect intercepted a taxi carrying his ex-girlfriend and her stepfather on Manahambre Road. The suspect used his vehicle to block the taxi near a tire shop, forcibly removed the woman, and pushed her into his silver Nissan B15. The victim was taken to a residence at Maingot Road, St. Julien Village, where she was sexually assaulted. Acting on a report from the victim's stepfather, officers from the Princes Town Police Station tracked the suspect to the location and arrested him for kidnapping and rape.

Headline: Common-law husband fires shots at fleeing woman; TTPS-marked ammunition found at scene
Summary: A 37-year-old woman narrowly escaped injury after her common-law husband allegedly opened fire on her during a domestic dispute. The incident occurred shortly before 2:00 a.m. when an altercation between the couple escalated into a physical assault. As the victim fled her home toward her mother's nearby residence for safety, the 41-year-old suspect reportedly fired several shots in her direction. Upon processing the scene, police officers discovered both spent and live ammunition bearing the marking "TTPS." Investigations are currently focusing on how the suspect came into possession of police-issued ammunition.

Headline: Arima man lured to house, beaten, and kidnapped in silver AD Wagon (PDX 1532)
Summary: A man was the victim of a violent setup after being invited by an acquaintance known as "Josh" to a residence at Printery Ville, O’Meara Road, Arima. Upon entering the house, the victim was ambushed by six masked men armed with a firearm and knives. The group beat the victim before robbing him of his wallet, Samsung cellphone, and vehicle keys. The assailants then bound and gagged the man, placed him in the trunk of his own silver Nissan Y12 AD Wagon (PDX 1532), and drove him to Carapo Main Road. He was thrown out of the vehicle near the Ministry of Works and Transport compound while the suspects fled with his car. The victim was treated for minor injuries at the Arima Health Facility.

Headline: Stolen vehicle discovered in Malick with blood and firearm; victim found at Mt. Hope with gunshot wound
Summary: Police discovered a black Suzuki Swift (Reg. No. PED 8084) abandoned with its engine and lights on between Seventh Street and Upper Sixth Avenue, Malick, containing a loaded Glock 19 pistol, blood, a spent shell, and a Samsung A32 phone. The vehicle had been reported stolen from Chaguanas on December 14, 2024, and was fitted with false plates. Simultaneously, a 35-year-old Arouca man arrived at Mt. Hope Hospital with a gunshot wound to the head. The victim claimed he was robbed of a gold chain and a Samsung S21 in Bon Air, Arouca, around 7:00 p.m.

Headline: Drive-by shooting reported at Upper 6th Avenue, Malick
Location: MG6R+3HJ San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: Police personnel processed a crime scene at Upper 6th Avenue, Malick, Barataria, following a drive-by shooting incident. The area was cordoned off as investigators searched for forensic evidence and interviewed potential witnesses. This location corresponds with the recovery site of a stolen black Suzuki Swift found idling in the roadway with ballistic evidence and blood inside. Authorities are working to determine if the drive-by shooting is directly linked to the 35-year-old male victim who appeared at Mt. Hope Hospital with a gunshot wound to the head shortly after the incident was reported.

Headline: Barataria man brutally assaulted with shovel and wood in home yard
Location: MG2P+6R5 San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A violent assault occurred just after 1:00 p.m. at a residence along the Eastern Main Road, Barataria. Two men entered the yard and launched a coordinated attack on a male resident, using a shovel, a knife, and a piece of wood to beat and stab him. During the intrusion, a female relative was also shoved to the ground as the assailants forced their way onto the property. The victim sustained multiple injuries during the attack. Police are investigating the motive behind the assault and are searching for the two suspects involved.

Headline: White Nissan AD Wagon (PDL 8495) stolen overnight from St. Augustine apartment
Summary: A resident of Coryat Street, St. Augustine, reported the theft of her vehicle which occurred during the late hours of Saturday or early morning Sunday. The vehicle, a white Nissan AD Wagon with registration number PDL 8495, was parked at Apartment #10 when it was taken by unknown suspects. The owner discovered the theft in the morning and immediately notified the authorities. Police are asking anyone with information regarding the location of this vehicle to contact the nearest police station.

Summary: Three armed men targeted Defiance Wholesalers in Preysal around 7:15 p.m., robbing a 38-year-old businessman of his licensed Glock 19 pistol, a magazine with 15 rounds, and TT$50,000 in cash. The suspects also seized six bottles of Hennessy, cigarettes, jewelry, a Samsung phone, and the store's Hikvision DVR to hinder identification. Following the initial robbery, the gunmen forced the victim into his residence, where they robbed a relative of jewelry and a Samsung A22 phone. The assailants fled in a white AD Wagon bearing registration PDG 1292, which was later found to be assigned to a Nissan Note.

Headline: Suspect arrested at police station after molesting woman in San Juan
Location: MH5H+C3H San Juan, Trinidad and Tobago
Summary: A 39-year-old man was taken into custody after he allegedly molested his common-law cousin's partner at her apartment in San Juan. The victim woke up around midnight to find the suspect on her bed caressing her thighs and grabbing her clothing. After the victim raised an alarm, the suspect fled the premises. In a bizarre turn of events, while the victim was at the San Juan Police Station formalizing her report, the suspect arrived at the same station and was immediately arrested by officers on duty.

Headline: Stolen electronics recovered after break-in at Stingray Bar and Lounge
Summary: A burglary at Stingray Bar and Lounge on King Sultan Street, Cunupia, was interrupted during the early hours of Saturday morning. The proprietor had secured the premises at midnight, but by 4:15 a.m., his son alerted him to suspicious noises coming from the business. Upon inspection, the owner discovered that a 65-inch JVC TV, a 45-inch TCL TV, and a mixer had been removed. Following a report to the police, responding officers conducted a search of the immediate area and successfully recovered all the stolen items on an empty parcel of land located on the eastern side of the building. The suspect apparently fled the scene empty-handed to avoid capture.

Summary: A shooting occurred on Stanmore Avenue in Port of Spain on New Year's Day, leaving one man dead. The victim was walking toward his parked vehicle when he was targeted by an assailant. The incident happened in broad daylight, adding to the list of violent occurrences in the capital city since the start of the year. Emergency services were notified, and the victim was transported for medical attention. Police have cordoned off the area to collect forensic evidence and are searching for the shooter who fled the scene.

Summary: The North Eastern Division has recorded its first homicide of 2025 following the fatal shooting of 39-year-old Kegan Barbour. The incident occurred around 1:30 a.m. on New Year’s Day at Barbour's residence on Laventille Road, San Juan. Reports indicate that a group of men breached the premises and opened fire on Barbour before fleeing the scene. This killing took place as the country remains under a State of Emergency, which was declared on December 30, 2024, to combat a surge in gang-related violence.
